articles.title: Beyond Scores: Understanding LLM-as-a-Judge Mechanisms in Summarization Evaluation
articles.abstract: LLM-based evaluators of natural language generation (NLG) quality are widely deployed as scoring tools and as automated training signals, yet the internal procedure by which they assign a rating remains poorly understood. We investigate this procedure mechanistically through an eight-attack perturbation taxonomy across the Readability and Adequacy dimensions of NLG quality, a generation pipeline that produces paired clean and corrupt summaries with controlled error intensity and explicit token-level modification maps, and a four-experiment battery of causal tracing, logit-lens vocabulary projection, and attention-head knockout applied to Themis (Llama-3-8B) and Prometheus (Mistral-7B). Both evaluators implement a structured, coherent evaluation pipeline operating in two stages: below layer 15, attention performs local error comparison and routes the result to the final input position; above it, the MLP cascade integrates the signal and writes the rating, with the decision crystallizing in the residual stream at a sharp late layer (L = 26 on Themis, L = 25 on Prometheus). Furthermore, a base-model control at the same scale (Llama-3-8B) reproduces the routing architecture and crystallization but not the stage separation, isolating the two mechanisms that fine-tuning specifically installs, suppression of below-L15 MLP contribution at the last position and a two-layer advance of the crystallization depth, indicating that fine-tuning sculpts an existing substrate rather than building the pipeline from scratch. We release the source code and data at https://github.com/himil-v/judge-mech
articles.titleCn: 超越分数：理解摘要评估中的LLM作为评判者机制
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的自然语言生成（NLG）质量评估器被广泛用作评分工具和自动化训练信号，但它们分配评分的内部流程仍不为人知。我们通过针对NLG质量的可读性和适当性维度的八种攻击扰动分类法，以及一个生成配对干净和损坏摘要的流水线（具有可控的错误强度和明确的标记级修改映射），对Themis（Llama-3-8B）和Prometheus（Mistral-7B）应用因果追踪、logit-lens词汇投影和注意力头移除的四实验电池，从机制上研究这一流程。两个评估器都实现了一个结构化、连贯的评估流水线，分为两个阶段：低于层15时，注意力执行局部错误比较并将结果路由到最终输入位置；高于此层时，MLP级联整合信号并写入评分，决策在残差流中在某个锐利的后期层（Themis上为L=26，Prometheus上为L=25）结晶。此外，同一规模的基线模型（Llama-3-8B）复制了路由架构和结晶过程，但未复制阶段分离，这隔离了微调专门安装的两个机制：抑制低于L15的MLP在最后位置的贡献，以及结晶深度提前两层，表明微调是在现有基础上进行塑形，而非从头构建流水线。我们已将源代码和数据发布在https://github.com/himil-v/judge-mech。

articles.title: Efficient SWE Agent Benchmarking via Trajectory-Aware Evaluation
articles.abstract: Evaluating software engineering agents on realistic benchmarks is costly, since each task may require multi-step code exploration, modification, and test execution. Existing efficient evaluation methods select representative subsets to estimate full-benchmark performance, but are largely result-only: they fit historical pass/fail response matrices or static task semantics, discarding how agents solve problems. We propose PTA-IRT, a Privileged Trajectory-Aware Item Response Theory framework that fuses process and outcome signals. Historical execution trajectories supply process-level evidence beyond pass/fail, such as explored context, attempted edits, and solving paths, which PTA-IRT uses as privileged information for calibration subset selection and ability estimation. Under low calibration budgets, PTA-IRT consistently outperforms prior IRT baselines on score and ranking recovery across four SWE benchmarks. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/PTA-IRT.
articles.titleCn: 基于轨迹感知评估的高效SWE代理基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 在真实基准上评估软件工程代理成本高昂，因为每个任务可能需要多步代码探索、修改和测试执行。现有的高效评估方法选择代表性子集来估计完整基准的性能，但基本上只关注结果：它们拟合历史通过/失败响应矩阵或静态任务语义，忽略了代理解决问题的过程。我们提出了PTA-IRT，一个具有特权轨迹感知的项目反应理论框架，融合了过程和结果信号。历史执行轨迹提供了通过/失败之外的过程级证据，例如探索的上下文、尝试的编辑和解决路径，PTA-IRT将其作为特权信息用于校准子集选择和能力估计。在低校准预算下，PTA-IRT在四个软件工程基准上始终优于先前的IRT基线，在得分和排名恢复方面表现出色。代码和数据可在https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/PTA-IRT公开获取。

articles.title: Adaptive Critical Token-Aware Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Generation
articles.abstract: The repository-level code generation task requires synthesizing code that satisfies task requirements while remaining consistent with the target repository context. Since real-world repositories often exceed the input length limits of LLMs, existing approaches commonly adopt retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to provide repository-specific context. Despite improving repository-context retrieval, existing methods typically provide context as task-level support, without explicitly identifying the critical tokens that require fine-grained repository context during generation. During the autoregressive generation process of LLMs, errors often concentrate at a small number of decisive positions: once such tokens are generated incorrectly, subsequent code may follow an incorrect semantic path and eventually lead to functional failure. We refer to these positions as "critical tokens". In this paper, we propose ACToR, an adaptive critical token-aware retrieval framework for repository-level code generation. ACToR identifies critical tokens during generation and triggers targeted retrieval on demand to provide repository context at these decisive positions. In addition, we design a position-aware weighting method for dense retrievers to prioritize context that is more informative for generation. We evaluate ACToR on two representative repository-level benchmarks, RepoExec and CoderEval. Experimental results show that ACToR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving relative improvements of 8.4% on RepoExec and 15.4% on CoderEval. Beyond performance gains, we systematically quantify the impact of critical tokens, revealing their central role in major generation failures and highlighting the necessity of targeted retrieval strategies. We provide the code and data at https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/ACToR.
articles.titleCn: 仓库级代码生成的自适应关键令牌感知检索
articles.abstractCn: 仓库级别的代码生成任务需要在满足任务需求的同时，保持与目标仓库上下文的一致性。由于现实世界的仓库通常超出大型语言模型（LLM）的输入长度限制，现有方法通常采用检索增强生成（RAG）来提供仓库特定上下文。尽管这些方法提高了仓库上下文检索的效率，但它们通常以任务级别的支持形式提供上下文，而没有明确识别在生成过程中需要细粒度仓库上下文的临界标记。在LLM的自回归生成过程中，错误往往集中在少数几个决定性位置：一旦这些标记生成错误，后续代码可能会遵循错误的语义路径，最终导致功能失败。我们将这些位置称为“临界标记”。在本文中，我们提出了ACToR，一个自适应临界标记感知检索框架，用于仓库级别的代码生成。ACToR在生成过程中识别临界标记，并按需触发针对性检索，以在这些决定性位置提供仓库上下文。此外，我们设计了一种位置感知加权方法，用于密集检索器，以优先考虑对生成更有信息的上下文。我们在两个代表性的仓库级别基准测试RepoExec和CoderEval上评估了ACToR。实验结果表明，ACToR始终优于现有最佳方法，在RepoExec上实现了8.4%的相对提升，在CoderEval上实现了15.4%的相对提升。除了性能提升之外，我们还系统地量化了临界标记的影响，揭示了它们在主要生成失败中的核心作用，并强调了针对性检索策略的必要性。我们提供了代码和数据，请访问https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/ACToR。

articles.title: CordisBench: Can Language Models Reason About Component Lifecycles in Dynamic Agent Harnesses?
articles.abstract: Dynamic agent harnesses let language models change the software that shapes their own execution. This flexibility brings a new reasoning burden: a local plugin change can propagate through dependencies and cleanup. We introduce CordisBench, a 1,200-question benchmark of this lifecycle reasoning. It combines a controlled formal setting with programs executed against Cordis, a runtime that manages component dependencies and cleanup, and asks models to identify affected components, predict state after a specified teardown order, determine which conditions hold under all or some orders, and choose reconfigurations that succeed when executed. Across these tasks, we evaluate three efficiency-oriented models at low reasoning effort with 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, or 32 relevant interactions, using deterministic task-specific scoring. Models usually handle small systems well but grow less reliable as more interactions become relevant, especially when predicting final state and when reasoning across teardown orders. Additional inference effort recovers marked gains for some models. The cost is nontrivial: on our 16-interaction subset, GPT-5.6 Luna uses nearly 3,000 reasoning tokens per question at medium effort. For these controlled instances, that cost is avoidable: an independent finite reference semantics agrees with Cordis execution on every observation and action outcome used for scoring across all 528 executable questions.
articles.comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/sileod/cordis-bench ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sileod/cordis-bench
articles.titleCn: CordisBench：语言模型能否在动态代理套件中推理组件生命周期？
articles.abstractCn: 动态代理 harness 允许语言模型改变塑造其自身执行的软件。这种灵活性带来了一种新的推理负担：本地插件更改可能会通过依赖关系和清理过程传播。我们介绍了 CordisBench，这是一个包含 1,200 个问题的生命周期推理基准测试。它结合了受控的正式环境与针对 Cordis（一个管理组件依赖关系和清理过程的运行时环境）执行的程序，并要求模型识别受影响的组件、预测在指定拆除顺序后的状态、确定在所有或某些顺序下哪些条件成立，以及选择在执行时成功的重新配置。在这些任务中，我们使用 2、4、8、16、24 或 32 次相关交互，以低推理努力评估了三个以效率为导向的模型，并采用确定性任务特定评分。模型通常能很好地处理小型系统，但随着更多交互变得相关，其可靠性会下降，尤其是在预测最终状态和跨拆除顺序进行推理时。额外的推理努力为某些模型带来了显著的收益。代价是不容忽视的：在我们的 16 次交互子集中，GPT-5.6 Luna 在中等推理努力下每个问题使用近 3,000 个推理标记。对于这些受控实例，这种代价是可以避免的：一个独立的有限参考语义在所有用于评分的 528 个可执行问题中的每个观察和动作结果上都与 Cordis 执行结果一致。

articles.title: The Rise of Verbal Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Natural language is emerging as a primary feedback channel for improving language agents, capable of conveying intent, preferences, and causal structure in forms interpretable by both humans and modern language models. We call this paradigm Verbal Reinforcement Learning (VRL) and offer the first unified account of it. We organize the field around a single axis, \textit{when} verbal feedback takes effect in an agent's lifecycle and \textit{what} it modifies, yielding three pillars: (1) \textbf{Language as Grounding Signal}, where language defines the task itself by specifying goals, states, and reward structures; (2) \textbf{Language as Deliberative Feedback}, where natural language guides reasoning at test time without the need to update model parameters; (3) \textbf{Language as Learning Signal}, where language-based feedback shapes model parameters through training. Within each pillar, we synthesize representative work, distinguish key subcategories of approaches, and outline the distinct role language plays in shaping agent behavior. Together, this taxonomy shows how verbal reinforcement is reshaping agent development, while also defining the challenges and opportunities for building more capable and aligned agents.
articles.titleCn: 言语强化学习的兴起
articles.abstractCn: 自然语言正逐渐成为改进语言智能体的主要反馈渠道，能够传达意图、偏好和因果关系，这些形式既可被人类理解，也可被现代语言模型解析。我们称这种范式为“语言强化学习”（VRL），并首次对其进行了统一的阐述。我们将该领域围绕单一维度进行组织，即“语言反馈在智能体生命周期中的生效时间”以及“它所修改的内容”，从而形成了三大支柱：（1）**语言作为基础信号**，其中语言通过指定目标、状态和奖励结构来定义任务本身；（2）**语言作为推理反馈**，其中自然语言在测试时指导推理过程，无需更新模型参数；（3）**语言作为学习信号**，其中基于语言的反馈通过训练塑造模型参数。在每个支柱中，我们综合了代表性工作，区分了关键的方法子类别，并阐明了语言在塑造智能体行为中的独特作用。这一分类体系展示了语言强化如何重塑智能体的发展，同时也界定了构建更强大、更协调的智能体的挑战与机遇。

articles.title: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
articles.abstract: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. Student simulators can provide this signal as a proxy, yet existing approaches are limited: state-tracking models fit student behavior but struggle to process explanations or corrections, while LLM role-play follows guidance fluently but does not reliably match the competence of the student being imitated. We present StudentSim, a training framework that turns sparse per-student data into individualized simulators through pooled training followed by per-student specialization. The resulting simulators both mirror a student's own responses and update them under tutor guidance. We also introduce StudentSimEval, a standardized protocol covering 60 students across chess, second-language English writing, and mathematics, using public learner datasets with de-identified records shared for research. StudentSimEval measures behavioral fidelity (F), or how well a simulator matches a student's responses, and guidance responsiveness (R), or how readily it updates under tutor guidance, with all methods fit and evaluated on the same records. Across all three domains, StudentSim outperforms GPT-5.4 on both metrics. In chess, StudentSim reaches F=0.51 and R=0.91, compared with 0.23 and 0.72 for GPT-5.4 and 0.45 and 0.27 for Maia2. As a proof of concept, using StudentSim as a reward model for tutor reinforcement learning produces a chess tutor that expert humans rate as more accurate, better-guided, and more personalized than a no-RL baseline and a tutor trained against a GPT-5.4 simulator reward. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/StudentSim.
articles.titleCn: StudentSim：基于LLM的学生模拟器训练
articles.abstractCn: AI助教在适应每个学生的优势、劣势和偏好指导时最为有效，但关于哪种指导方式适合哪个学生的证据稀少、收集缓慢且成本高昂。学生模拟器可以提供这种信号作为替代，但现有方法存在局限：状态跟踪模型能够拟合学生行为，但在处理解释或纠正时存在困难；而大型语言模型的角色扮演虽然流畅地遵循指导，却无法可靠地匹配被模仿学生的能力。我们提出了StudentSim，一个通过池化训练后进行个性化专门化的训练框架，将稀疏的每名学生数据转化为个性化模拟器。生成的模拟器既能反映学生的真实响应，也能在导师指导下进行更新。我们还引入了StudentSimEval，这是一个涵盖60名学生在国际象棋、第二语言英语写作和数学领域的标准化协议，使用带有去标识记录的公开学习者数据集，并共享用于研究。StudentSimEval测量行为保真度（F），即模拟器匹配学生响应的程度，以及指导响应度（R），即模拟器在导师指导下更新的便捷性，所有方法都在相同的记录上进行拟合和评估。在所有三个领域，StudentSim在两个指标上都优于GPT-5.4。在国际象棋领域，StudentSim达到F=0.51和R=0.91，而GPT-5.4为0.23和0.72，Maia2为0.45和0.27。作为一个概念验证，使用StudentSim作为导师强化学习的奖励模型，产生了一个在国际象棋领域被专家人类评为比无强化学习基线和使用GPT-5.4模拟器奖励训练的导师更准确、更受指导、更个性化的导师。代码可在https://github.com/microsoft/StudentSim获取。

articles.title: Designing Proactive Thought Partners for Writing
articles.abstract: Writing involves diverse cognitive activities, from ideation to revision, and writers' needs vary across individuals and moments. Proactive AI promises to provide the right support at the right time, yet existing proactive tools largely focus on generic textual assistance, such as autocomplete. This paper studies the design space of proactive thought partners: AI agents that proactively offer customizable, higher-level cognitive support during writing. We instantiated this concept in a technology probe and deployed it with 16 participants for one week. The probe allows users to create partners by configuring their roles and proactivity. As users write, relevant partners take the initiative at appropriate moments to offer suggestions. Our findings show that participants configured proactive support through prospective planning, used suggestions for both idea generation and self-monitoring, and valued lightweight visual representations alongside non-directive rhetorical framing for non-intrusive interventions. We derive implications for designing proactive writing assistants around customization, timing, engagement, and representation.
articles.titleCn: 设计写作的主动思维伙伴
articles.abstractCn: 写作涉及从构思到修改的多样化认知活动，而不同个体在不同时刻的需求各不相同。主动型人工智能承诺在恰当的时机提供恰当的支持，然而现有的主动型工具大多集中于通用的文本辅助功能，例如自动补全。本文研究了主动型思维伙伴的设计空间：即写作过程中主动提供可定制、更高层次认知支持的智能代理。我们将这一概念实例化于一项技术探查中，并让16名参与者使用了一周。该探查允许用户通过配置其角色和主动性来创建伙伴。当用户写作时，相关的伙伴会在恰当的时刻主动提出建议。我们的研究发现，参与者通过前瞻性规划来配置主动型支持，利用建议进行想法生成和自我监控，并重视轻量级视觉呈现与非指导性修辞框架相结合的非侵入性干预。我们据此推导出关于主动型写作助手设计的启示，涉及定制化、时机、参与度和呈现方式。

articles.title: The Structure of Quantization Damage in LLMs: Why the Next Bit Should Be Spent Globally
articles.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to reduce the cost of serving large language models (LLMs), but its accuracy cost is uneven and is often tuned per model. We study where quantization damage occurs and how to allocate a small additional precision budget. Using causal mixed-precision intervention as ground truth (raise each layer to 8-bit in turn and measure the accuracy it recovers) across 9 open-weight models in 4 architecture families, we test 3 intuitive hypotheses: that quantization damage lives in task circuits, where the model computes, or in weight statistics. None of them predicts which layers benefit from restored precision. Recovery is instead diffuse: for 8 of 9 models, recovering 75% of the gap takes roughly half the layers; the lone exception, Qwen3-8B, is sharply concentrated. At a matched precision budget, spending it globally on finer quantization granularity beats locally repairing the most recoverable layers for all 8 group-128-compatible models (all but OpenLLaMA, whose width rules out group-128), by 21-52 points, including the concentrated Qwen3-8B. We report 2 secondary findings: the residual is budget-limited (8-bit is near-lossless in our evaluation across RTN, GPTQ, and AWQ), and the location of peak recovery correlates with architecture within a family, though not across families. Within this budget setting, global granularity is a better default than selectively protecting critical layers. More broadly, cheap signals that correlate with quantization damage do not necessarily identify where restoring precision improves accuracy; this must be tested with causal intervention.

articles.titleCn: LLMs中量化损伤的结构：为什么下一个比特应该被全局使用
articles.abstractCn: 训练后量化（PTQ）被广泛用于降低大型语言模型（LLM）的服务成本，但其精度损失不均衡，通常需要针对每个模型进行调优。我们研究了量化损伤发生的位置以及如何分配少量额外的精度预算。通过将因果混合精度干预作为基准（逐层提升至8位并测量其恢复的精度）在4个架构家族中的9个开放权重模型上，我们测试了3个直观假设：量化损伤存在于模型计算的任务电路中，或存在于权重统计中。这些假设都无法预测哪些层能从恢复的精度中受益。恢复过程是分散的：在9个模型中的8个模型中，恢复75%的差距大约需要一半的层；唯一的例外是Qwen3-8B，其恢复过程高度集中。在匹配的精度预算下，将预算全局用于更细的量化粒度，比针对所有8个兼容group-128的模型（除OpenLLaMA外，其宽度规则排除了group-128）局部修复最可恢复的层，效果更好，提升幅度达21-52点，包括高度集中的Qwen3-8B。我们报告了2个次要发现：残差受预算限制（在我们的RTN、GPTQ和AWQ评估中，8位接近无损），峰值恢复的位置与家族内的架构相关，但跨家族不相关。在此预算设置下，全局粒度比选择性保护关键层是更好的默认选择。更广泛地说，与量化损伤相关的廉价信号并不一定指明恢复精度能提升准确性的位置；这必须通过因果干预进行测试。

articles.title: Closing Cost-Quality Gap in Document VLMs: Difficulty-Aware Data Curation and Quality-Adjusted Deployment Economics
articles.abstract: Extracting structured fields from hundreds of millions of documents annually remains costly in regulated industries: bespoke OCR cascades cover only a fraction of workflows, privacy rules preclude external models, and existing open-source VLMs that clear quality thresholds cost more to serve than human annotation. We present a deployed document-understanding system built on a Mixture-of-Experts VLM (35B total, 3B active), fine-tuned on in-house production data mixed with open-domain documents curated by a Difficulty-Aware pipeline for layout diversity, fact-extractability, and cross-model consistency. Fitting on a single H100 and serving heterogeneous workflows via prompting, the model leads all deployable (non-reasoning) baselines up to an order of magnitude larger. A quality-adjusted cost analysis, with confirmation and correction costs calibrated from production telemetry, shows it reduces expected costs by over 80% against the human baseline and by more than 50% against the best competing open-source model, while larger baselines remain economically unviable.
articles.titleCn: 文档视觉语言模型中的闭合成本-质量差距：难度感知数据策展与质量调整部署经济学
articles.abstractCn: 从数以亿计的文档中提取结构化字段在受监管的行业中仍然成本高昂：定制OCR级联流程仅覆盖部分工作流程，隐私规则禁止使用外部模型，而现有达到质量标准的开源视觉语言模型（VLM）的服务成本高于人工标注。我们提出了一种基于专家混合VLM（总参数量35B，激活参数量3B）的部署文档理解系统，该模型在内部生产数据与由难度感知流程筛选的开域文档混合数据上进行微调，以实现布局多样性、事实可提取性和跨模型一致性。该模型仅需单块H100即可部署，并通过提示服务异构工作流程，其性能超越了所有可部署（非推理型）的更大规模基线模型。根据生产遥测数据校准的、考虑质量因素的成本分析显示，该模型将预期成本比人工基线降低了80%以上，比最佳竞争开源模型降低了50%以上，而更大规模的基线模型在经济上仍不可行。

articles.title: Scaling Near-Optimal SFT-RL Annotation Budget Allocation from Small to Large LLMs
articles.abstract: How to divide a fixed annotation budget between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) during LLM post-training remains an open problem. Existing work characterizes only broad trends (e.g., SFT dominates in low-data regimes), lacks a principled allocation framework, and does not examine whether the optimal ratio transfers across model sizes. We frame this problem in terms of near-optimality: rather than seeking a single optimal SFT-RL ratio, we characterize the near-optimal region, the set of allocations within a specified tolerance of peak performance. Empirically, this region is wide even for small tolerances (2-10%), widens with model scale, and transfers reliably from small proxy models to large target models. This yields a practical strategy: small proxy-model experiments suffice to identify a transferable near-optimal region, eliminating the need for exhaustive large-scale search. Our results hold consistently across tasks, model families, and both preference-based off-policy and reward-supervision on-policy RL methods. We further analyze how the asymmetry in annotation costs between SFT and RL data shifts the near-optimal region.
articles.titleCn: 将近乎最优的SFT-RL标注预算分配从小型到大型的LLM进行扩展
articles.abstractCn: 在大型语言模型（LLM）的后续训练过程中，如何将固定的标注预算在监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）之间进行分配仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。现有工作仅描述了宽泛的趋势（例如，在低数据情况下SFT占主导地位），缺乏一个原则性的分配框架，并且没有检验最优比例是否适用于不同规模的模型。我们将此问题表述为近最优性：与其寻求单一的SFT-RL最优比例，我们表征了近最优区域，即在特定容差范围内的峰值性能对应的分配集合。实证表明，即使对于较小的容差（2-10%），该区域也相当宽，随着模型规模的增大而扩展，并且可以可靠地从小型代理模型迁移到大型目标模型。这产生了一种实用策略：小型代理模型的实验就足以识别可迁移的近最优区域，从而无需进行大规模的穷举搜索。我们的结果在任务、模型家族以及基于偏好的离线策略和基于奖励监督的在线策略RL方法中均保持一致。我们进一步分析了SFT和RL数据标注成本的不对称性如何影响近最优区域。

articles.title: From Production Traffic to Post-Training: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers the Corporate Request Mix
articles.abstract: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool. We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution. Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to production traffic and scored by deterministic verifiers or calibrated LLM judges. Rather than optimising all objectives jointly, which introduces cross-domain reward interference, we train a separate GRPO expert per axis and merge them via two-stage SLERP. Each expert's reward exposes a distinct failure mode, namely semantic collapse, over-calling, and verbosity hacking, each requiring a domain-specific fix. In non-reasoning mode the recipe surpasses a ${\sim}7\times$ larger by total parameters baseline on the in-house Arena with 69.6 to 65.8, instruction following with 0.85 to 0.83, and function-calling with 0.79 to 0.77, while lifting general dialogue benchmarks. The model absorbs 50% of platform traffic, 116M requests per month, at a fraction of the serving cost.
articles.titleCn: 从生产流量到训练后：构建一个满足企业需求混合的自托管LLM
articles.abstractCn: 数据驻留限制迫使企业自行托管大型语言模型，但不断采用新模型而不淘汰旧模型会扩大服务舰队，分散有限的GPU资源。我们将超过200个内部应用的流量整合到单个模型上，通过生产错误分析识别出的三个维度——指令遵循、函数调用和内部任务分配——关闭质量差距。质量通过分层匹配生产流量的离线基准测试进行跟踪，并由确定性验证器或校准的大型语言模型评委进行评分。我们不联合优化所有目标，因为这会引入跨域奖励干扰，而是为每个维度训练一个独立的GRPO专家，并通过两阶段SLERP将它们合并。每个专家的奖励暴露了不同的失效模式，即语义崩溃、过度调用和冗余攻击，每种都需要特定领域的修复。在非推理模式下，该方案在内部竞技场中总参数量比基准高出约7倍，指令遵循从69.6提升至65.8，函数调用从0.85提升至0.83，同时提升了通用对话基准。该模型吸收了平台流量的50%，每月116M请求，且服务成本大幅降低。

articles.title: Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy: Learning Autonomous Policies from Imperfect VLM Teachers
articles.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide useful priors for interactive decision-making, but using them directly as policies is expensive and brittle: they must be queried at every step, do not improve from environment interaction, and can repeat systematic errors. We study how to learn a cheap autonomous policy from an online, expensive, and imperfect but informative VLM teacher. We propose SAGE (Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy), a framework that queries a VLM only when the learner is uncertain, executes the suggested action during training, and distills guidance into a lightweight Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy. Because VLM advice is not always reliable, SAGE can weight teacher-action distillation using environment-derived advantages rather than treating all suggestions as equally useful. Across sparse-reward visual reasoning and navigation tasks, SAGE learns policies that act without VLM guidance at evaluation time and improves over unguided RL in several environments, including settings where the learned policy exceeds its VLM teacher. The results show that selective guidance is most beneficial when the VLM can help the agent discover high-reward trajectories, and less useful when unguided exploration already succeeds or teacher actions do not lead to informative experience. SAGE also reduces VLM usage by prompting the teacher only on a fraction of training steps and requiring no VLM calls at deployment. Overall, our results suggest that VLMs don't need to be used as fixed policies to be useful; they can instead act as temporary, imperfect sources of guidance whose value is tested and internalized through interaction.

articles.titleCn: 基于熵的选择性代理指导：从有缺陷的视觉语言模型教师中学习自主策略
articles.abstractCn: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）为交互式决策提供了有用的先验知识，但直接将其用作策略既昂贵又脆弱：它们必须在每一步进行查询，无法从环境交互中改进，并且可能重复系统性错误。我们研究了如何从在线、昂贵且不完美但信息丰富的VLM教师那里学习廉价的自主策略。我们提出了SAGE（选择性代理引导通过熵）框架，该框架仅在学习者不确定时查询VLM，在训练期间执行建议的动作，并将指导蒸馏为轻量级的强化学习（RL）策略。由于VLM建议并非总是可靠，SAGE可以使用环境派生的优势来加权教师动作蒸馏，而不是将所有建议视为同等有用。在稀疏奖励视觉推理和导航任务中，SAGE学习的策略在评估时无需VLM指导，并在多个环境中优于无引导的RL，包括学习到的策略超过其VLM教师的环境。结果表明，当VLM可以帮助代理发现高回报轨迹时，选择性引导最为有益，而在无引导探索已经成功或教师动作无法提供信息性经验时则不太有用。SAGE通过仅在部分训练步骤中提示教师并部署时无需VLM调用来减少VLM的使用。总体而言，我们的结果表明，VLM不必作为固定策略才能发挥作用；它们可以作为一种临时的、不完美的指导来源，其价值通过交互得到检验和内化。

articles.title: From Confusion to Clarity: Confusion-Aware Retrieval and Knowledge Injection for Text Classification
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) struggle to classify text into taxonomies with many semantically similar labels, as the distinctions are domain-specific and not captured by pre-training. To handle large label spaces, a common approach retrieves top-$K$ candidate labels by embedding similarity and prompt the LLM to choose among them. However, top-$K$ retrieval reduces the number of candidates but does not help the model tell similar ones apart. When two similar labels both appear as candidates, the model lacks the signal to choose correctly between them. We propose a framework that (1) identifies which label pairs the model struggles to distinguish, (2) expands the candidate set to include confusable labels, and (3) generates targeted rules to differentiate between similar candidates. The framework requires no fine-tuning, and the generated rules transfer to smaller, cheaper models. On three benchmarks (WOS, Flipkart, LEDGAR), our approach improves Macro F1 by up to 10.0pp over retrieval baselines, with smaller models (2B--20B) gaining up to 11.5pp via cross-model transfer.
articles.titleCn: 从困惑到清晰：面向文本分类的困惑感知检索与知识注入
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在将文本分类到具有许多语义相似标签的分类体系中时存在困难，因为这些区别是领域特定的，而预训练并未捕捉到这些信息。为了处理大规模标签空间，一种常见的方法是通过嵌入相似性检索前K个候选标签，并提示LLM从中选择。然而，前K检索减少了候选数量，但并未帮助模型区分相似的标签。当两个相似的标签同时作为候选出现时，模型缺乏选择正确标签的信号。我们提出一个框架，该框架（1）识别模型难以区分哪些标签对，（2）扩展候选集以包含易混淆的标签，以及（3）生成针对性规则以区分相似的候选标签。该框架无需微调，生成的规则可以迁移到更小、更便宜的模型。在三个基准测试（WOS、Flipkart、LEDGAR）上，我们的方法比检索基线将宏观F1提升了高达10.0个百分点，通过跨模型迁移，较小的模型（2B--20B）的F1提升了高达11.5个百分点。

articles.title: A systematic Approach to constructing a Chance-and-Risk Matrix for Semiconductor Supply Chains
articles.abstract: Semiconductor supply chains face escalating risks from geopolitical tensions, geographic concentration, and rapid technological shifts, yet no scalable system continuously extracts, structures, and prioritizes risk intelligence from public corporate disclosures. We present an end-to-end pipeline that retrieves corporate documents for semiconductor companies and uses large language models (LLMs) to extract the risks and opportunities they describe. It organizes these into a knowledge graph linking each item to its category, sources, and related events, then merges duplicates and ranks them with a three-layer mechanism combining an algorithmic formula, an LLM relevance adjustment, and expert validation. Applied to five companies across the value chain, the pipeline produces 76,207 scored items, of which an independent check finds 92.6% valid. The automated rankings match expert judgment at an average Spearman correlation of 0.55 for risks and 0.72 for opportunities, and the resulting matrices identify trade restrictions as the dominant cross-company risk.

articles.titleCn: 构建半导体供应链风险矩阵的系统方法
articles.abstractCn: 半导体供应链因地缘政治紧张局势、地理集中以及技术快速变革而面临日益加剧的风险，然而目前尚无可扩展的系统能够持续从公开的企业披露中提取、结构化并优先排序风险情报。我们提出一个端到端的流程，用于检索半导体公司的企业文件，并利用大型语言模型（LLM）提取其描述的风险与机遇。该流程将这些信息组织成一个知识图谱，将每个项目与其类别、来源和相关事件相链接，然后通过结合算法公式、LLM相关性调整和专家验证的三层机制合并重复项并对其进行排序。应用于价值链中的五家公司后，该流程生成了76,207个评分项目，独立核查发现其中92.6%是有效的。自动化排名在风险方面与专家判断的平均斯皮尔曼相关系数为0.55，在机遇方面为0.72，由此产生的矩阵识别出贸易限制是跨公司的主要风险。

articles.title: SDARE-Bench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Conversational Stigma Detection and Response in Dyadic and Group Dialogue
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in advice seeking and decision making that may affect social judgements. Despite stigma's profound effects on people and communities, benchmarks remain scarce. Existing general-domain evaluations typically rely on static prompts and fixed-format tasks, overlooking conversational contexts and audience effects in everyday communication. To address these gaps, we introduce SDARE-Bench, the first scenario-based benchmark evaluating both stigma detection and open-ended response generation in LLMs, comprising 1,138 dyadic queries and 1,388 group dialogue. Empirical results across 8 LLMs consistently demonstrate poor identification of stigma components, especially in group dialogues. In open-ended response generation, stigma expression was substantially higher in group settings than in dyadic, with weaker resistance to stigma and more unrealistic advice. Responses were evaluated using a classifier trained on 1,392 human annotated responses. In constructed group pressure settings, stigma expression rates further increased to a striking average of 97.5%. Our findings identify stigma response as a recurring LLM safety vulnerability, especially in socially complex conversational contexts.
articles.titleCn: SDARE-Bench：在二元对话和群组对话中的对话污名检测与回应方面评估大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在可能影响社会评判的建议寻求和决策制定中应用日益广泛。尽管污名化对个人和社区具有深远影响，但基准测试仍然稀缺。现有的通用领域评估通常依赖于静态提示和固定格式的任务，忽略了日常交流中的对话情境和受众效应。为解决这些不足，我们引入SDARE-Bench，这是首个基于场景的基准测试，评估LLMs在污名检测和开放式响应生成方面的能力，包含1138对查询和1388组对话。在8个LLMs上的实证结果一致表明，污名成分的识别能力较差，尤其是在组对话中。在开放式响应生成方面，组对话中的污名表达显著高于对查询，污名抵抗较弱，建议更加不切实际。响应评估使用了基于1392个人类标注响应训练的分类器。在构建的组压力情境下，污名表达率进一步增加到惊人的平均97.5%。我们的研究确定了污名响应为LLM安全漏洞的常见现象，尤其是在社会复杂的对话情境中。

articles.title: Knowledge Distillation During Mid-Training Favors Reasoning over Factual Recall
articles.abstract: Logit-based knowledge distillation (KD) is used to train smaller language models (LMs) via supervision from stronger teachers, but whether its benefits are consistent across training stages remains unclear. Through controlled experiments, we find that forward Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation--the standard KD formulation--with post-trained teachers behaves fundamentally differently during mid-training, an intermediate phase of self-supervised learning on curated corpora. Surprisingly, while forward KD simultaneously improves reasoning and factual recall during pre-training relative to standard next-token prediction (NTP), it instead slows factual recall acquisition during mid-training despite continued reasoning gains. We trace this stage dependence to an asymmetry in teacher confidence across data domains and the student's evolving knowledge state: teachers are more confident on procedural than knowledge-intensive data, while students acquire low-entropy factual knowledge earlier in training. To mitigate this imbalance, we propose Switch Distillation, a simple mid-training objective that distills on tokens where the teacher is confident, using teacher predictive entropy as a lightweight routing signal, and otherwise falls back to cross-entropy. Switch Distillation consistently outperforms existing distillation objectives across teacher sizes. Relative to standard NTP, it achieves 1.61-1.71x the reasoning performance and 1.13-1.19x the knowledge and commonsense performance while preserving 96.7-96.8% of factual recall. Crucially, these benefits persist after post-training: Switch Distillation closes the factual recall gap while maintaining 1.25-1.32x and 1.13-1.20x gains in reasoning and knowledge and commonsense, respectively.

articles.titleCn: 训练中期知识蒸馏更倾向于推理而非事实回忆
articles.abstractCn: 基于Logit的知识蒸馏（KD）通过强教师的监督来训练更小的语言模型（LMs），但其优势是否在训练的不同阶段都保持一致尚不明确。通过受控实验，我们发现正向Kullback-Leibler（KL）蒸馏——即标准的KD公式——在自我监督学习的中期阶段表现与经过预训练的教师截然不同，中期阶段是针对精选语料库进行自我监督学习的中间阶段。令人惊讶的是，虽然正向KD在预训练阶段相对于标准下一词预测（NTP）同时提升了推理能力和事实召回能力，但在中期训练阶段，尽管推理能力持续提升，它却减缓了事实召回能力的获取。我们将这种阶段依赖性归因于教师在不同数据域上的置信度不对称性以及学生知识状态的演变：教师对程序性数据比知识密集型数据更自信，而学生在训练早期更容易获取低熵的事实知识。为了缓解这种不平衡，我们提出了切换蒸馏（Switch Distillation），这是一种简单的中期训练目标，它在教师自信的token上进行蒸馏，使用教师预测熵作为轻量级的路由信号，否则则回退到交叉熵。切换蒸馏在所有教师规模上都优于现有的蒸馏目标。相对于标准NTP，它在推理能力上实现了1.61-1.71倍的提升，在知识和常识能力上实现了1.13-1.19倍的提升，同时保留了96.7-96.8%的事实召回率。关键在于，这些优势在预训练后依然存在：切换蒸馏缩小了事实召回率的差距，同时分别保持了1.25-1.32倍和1.13-1.20倍的推理能力与知识和常识能力的提升。

articles.title: GlossoGen: Emergent Language in Complex Multi-Agent LLM Interactions
articles.abstract: The growing rate at which LLM agents interact with one another raises key questions about language evolution in multi-LLM-agent settings, with implications for safety and monitorability as well as for linguistic accounts of LLMs. To address these questions, we introduce GlossoGen, a novel platform for studying multi-agent language evolution in complex scenarios. Within GlossoGen, we build the SaveVeyru scenario, which requires agents with partial information to communicate under pressure. We find that language evolution does occur between LLM agents, that the resulting languages are compositional and morphologically productive, and that they deviate from the LLMs' English prior in ways that render them incomprehensible to humans. Moreover, we identify several qualities essential to this evolution: pressure towards efficiency; the strength of the models backing the agents; and access to a "postmortem" stage in which agents can agree on linguistic conventions. Importantly, we observe that different conditions govern the transmission of language to new agents. Specifically, we find that agents learn new languages from usage alone, take an active role in this learning, and that while stronger models are required for novel language emergence, weaker models can learn an existing language once it has emerged. Taken together, our results indicate that current LLMs have the potential for cumulative cultural evolution -- previously attested only in humans -- with mixed populations of agents developing capacities that go beyond their lowest common denominator.
articles.titleCn: GlossoGen：复杂多智能体LLM交互中涌现的语言
articles.abstractCn: LLM智能体之间交互的增长速度引发了对多LLM智能体环境下语言演化的关键问题，这对安全性、可监控性以及LLM的语言学解释都具有重要影响。为解决这些问题，我们引入了GlossoGen平台，这是一个用于研究复杂场景下多智能体语言演化的新型平台。在GlossoGen中，我们构建了SaveVeyru场景，该场景要求智能体在信息不完全的情况下进行高压沟通。我们发现，LLM智能体之间确实发生了语言演化，演化出的语言具有组合性和形态可产性，并且与LLM的英语先验知识存在差异，导致人类无法理解。此外，我们确定了语言演化所必需的几个关键因素：效率压力、支持智能体的模型强度，以及智能体能够就语言规范达成共识的“死后”阶段。重要的是，我们观察到不同的条件影响着语言向新智能体的传播。具体来说，我们发现智能体仅通过使用就能学习新语言，并在学习过程中发挥主动作用；虽然需要更强的模型才能产生新语言，但较弱的模型一旦新语言出现就能学习该语言。综合来看，我们的结果表明当前的LLM具有累积文化演化的潜力——此前仅在人类身上得到证实——混合智能体群体发展出了超越其最低共同标准的能力。

articles.title: AutoConcept: Training-Free Concept-Guided Reranking for Metadata-Available Composed Image Retrieval
articles.abstract: Composed image retrieval (CIR) retrieves a target image from a reference image and a text modification. This paper studies metadata-available CIR reranking, where a fixed CIR model first returns a candidate pool and gallery metadata is then used for second-stage concept-guided scoring. We introduce AutoConcept, a training-free reranker that converts concept evidence into an interpretable memory. AutoConcept filters noisy concepts, activates query-relevant positive constraints with an auxiliary negative penalty, and combines base retrieval scores with metadata-based concept-candidate alignment through inference-time calibration. On FashionIQ, AutoConcept yields significant early-rank improvements over WeiMoCIR and consistent plug-in gains on LinCIR candidate pools. Metadata-aware controls show that structured concept memory adds signal beyond direct query-text and extracted-attribute matching, while a query-only variant further supports the effectiveness of concept-level reranking. A supplementary real-human concept-label study indicates that the same memory interface can consume participant-provided evidence. These results position AutoConcept as an interpretable concept-memory reranker for product-style CIR galleries with available metadata.

articles.titleCn: AutoConcept：无需训练的概念引导重新排序，适用于元数据可用的组合图像检索
articles.abstractCn: 组合图像检索（CIR）从参考图像和文本修改中检索目标图像。本文研究元数据可用的CIR重新排序，其中固定的CIR模型首先返回候选池，然后使用图库元数据进行第二阶段的概念引导评分。我们引入了AutoConcept，这是一种无需训练的重新排序器，它将概念证据转换为可解释的内存。AutoConcept过滤噪声概念，通过辅助负惩罚激活与查询相关的正向约束，并通过推理时校准将基础检索分数与基于元数据的概念候选对齐相结合。在FashionIQ上，AutoConcept在WeiMoCIR和LinCIR候选池上实现了显著的早期排名提升，并表现出一致的插件增益。元数据感知控制表明，结构化的概念内存除了直接查询-文本和提取属性匹配外，还能增加信号，而仅查询的变体进一步支持了概念级别重新排序的有效性。一项补充的真实人类概念标签研究表明，相同的内存接口可以消耗参与者提供的证据。这些结果将AutoConcept定位为一种可解释的概念内存重新排序器，适用于具有可用元数据的商品风格CIR图库。

articles.title: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?
articles.abstract: As agents move from research prototypes to deployed tools, their capability increasingly depends on model-external execution infrastructure, commonly termed the agent harness. Changing this harness while holding model weights fixed can substantially alter task performance. Current agent evaluations typically report downstream performance under a chosen harness, leaving a model's ability to develop the harness itself comparatively underexplored. We introduce HarnessDev, a benchmark that shifts the unit of evaluation from task outputs to runnable infrastructure. HarnessDev covers two stages. In Creation, the agent starts from a minimal seed and a small number of cases, then builds a complete execution system. In Evolution, it starts from its own created harness and iteratively revises it using downstream execution feedback, with the goal of improving benchmark performance. We then evaluate each constructed harness on capability (task success on held-out benchmarks) and efficiency (execution-token cost). The reported Creation results cover six creator LLMs, four domains, and five downstream benchmarks totaling 2,207 unique downstream instances, with hidden evaluation tasks withheld from development. We find that generated harnesses remain substantially behind mature human-engineered references on code and on search and research, while matching or exceeding the selected references on writing and machine-learning experimentation, with large variation in execution cost. Evolution produces some performance gains, but they are unstable and transfer only partially to held-out tasks. Experiments with a fixed runtime model further show that the gains depend strongly on the model executing the harness, indicating limited transfer across models.
articles.titleCn: HarnessDev：大型语言模型能否创建和发展自己的代理框架？
articles.abstractCn: 随着代理从研究原型转向部署工具，其能力越来越依赖于模型外部的执行基础设施，通常称为代理框架。在保持模型权重不变的情况下更改此框架可以显著改变任务性能。当前的代理评估通常报告在选定框架下的下游性能，而模型自身开发框架的能力相对较少被探索。我们引入HarnessDev，一个将评估单元从任务输出转移到可运行基础设施的基准。HarnessDev涵盖两个阶段。在创建阶段，代理从一个最小种子和少量案例开始，然后构建一个完整的执行系统。在进化阶段，它从自己创建的框架开始，并使用下游执行反馈迭代地修改它，目标是提高基准性能。然后我们对每个构建的框架在能力（在保留的基准上的任务成功率）和效率（执行令牌成本）上进行评估。报告的创建结果涵盖六个创建者LLM、四个领域和五个下游基准，共计2,207个独特的下游实例，其中隐藏的评估任务被排除在开发之外。我们发现生成的框架在代码和搜索与研究方面仍然远落后于成熟的人工设计参考，但在写作和机器学习实验方面与所选参考相当或超过，执行成本差异很大。进化产生了一些性能提升，但这些提升不稳定，并且只能部分转移到保留的任务。使用固定运行时模型的实验进一步表明，这些提升强烈依赖于执行框架的模型，表明模型之间的迁移能力有限。

articles.title: Citing Less Critically: LLMs Reshape the Rhetoric and Reach of Scientific Citation
articles.abstract: Scientific citations carry rhetorical intent. Scholars may cite prior work positively (supporting), negatively (contrasting), or neutrally (mentioning). As large language models (LLMs) increasingly assist scientific writing, whether they reproduce citations with the same rhetorical intent as humans remains unclear. We introduce a masked-citation task to compare human and LLM-generated citation behavior. For each citation context, an LLM generates a replacement citation sentence, producing a counterfactual corpus directly comparable to human citation. We analyze what, whom, and how models cite, using an LLM-as-a-judge to classify citation intent and a 20-million-edge coauthorship network to measure social distance between cited authors. Across six popular LLMs and 1,746 top NLP conference papers (63k+ contexts, 132k+ citations), three patterns emerge: (1) Compared with human citation, LLMs cite significantly less critically; (2) LLMs over-cite popular and older papers, a tendency amplified for contrasting citations where human writing more often draws on recent, niche work; (3) Whereas humans often cite within their close social network, especially for supporting citations, LLMs tend to draw on more socially distant authors. Together, these differences are double-edged: LLM citation reaches beyond a scholar's close collaborators while being less critical and amplifying visibility bias, reshaping the rhetoric and reach of scientific citation.

articles.titleCn: 批判性引用减少：大型语言模型重塑了科学引用的修辞和影响力
articles.abstractCn: 科学引文具有修辞意图。学者可能对先前工作进行正面引用（支持）、负面引用（对比）或中性引用（提及）。随着大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地辅助科学写作，它们是否与人类以相同的修辞意图进行引用尚不明确。我们引入了一个掩码引文任务，用于比较人类和LLM生成的引文行为。对于每个引文语境，LLM生成一个替代引文句子，从而产生一个可直接与人类引文进行比较的对照语料库。我们分析模型引文的内容、对象和方式，使用LLM作为裁判者来分类引文意图，并利用一个包含2000万边的合作网络来衡量被引作者之间的社交距离。在六个流行的LLM和1746篇顶级NLP会议论文（63k+语境，132k+引文）中，出现了三种模式：（1）与人类引文相比，LLM的批判性引用显著减少；（2）LLM过度引用热门和较旧的论文，在对比引用中这种倾向更为明显，而人类写作更常借鉴近期、小众的研究；（3）人类通常在紧密的社交网络内引用，尤其是在支持性引用中，而LLM倾向于引用社交距离较远的作者。这些差异具有双刃剑效应：LLM的引文范围超出了学者的紧密合作者，但批判性减少并放大了可见性偏差，重塑了科学引文的修辞和影响力。

articles.title: From Rollouts to Recipes: Self-Contained Post-Training for LLMs
articles.abstract: Post-training large language models usually applies a single training recipe to all samples, even though the model's own rollouts reveal different sample-level learning states. We propose Self-Routing, a behavior-conditioned post-training framework that uses rollout correctness and confidence to decide how each sample should be optimized. Depending on its behavior state, a sample is routed to GRPO, on-policy self-distillation, regularization, or skipping, allowing training to adapt without external teachers, extra annotations, or additional sampling. Experiments on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 backbones show that Self-Routing consistently improves over uniform GRPO, uniform OPSD, fixed mixtures, and simpler routing baselines. Further analyses show that the routing distribution changes over training and reduces unnecessary updates on low-signal or already stable samples.
articles.titleCn: 从推演到食谱：LLM 的自包含式训练后处理
articles.abstractCn: 训练后的语言模型通常对所有样本应用单一的训练策略，尽管模型的自身推演揭示了不同样本级别的学习状态。我们提出了Self-Routing，一个行为条件化的训练后框架，它利用推演正确性和置信度来决定每个样本应如何优化。根据其行为状态，样本会被路由到GRPO、在线自蒸馏、正则化或跳过，使训练无需外部教师、额外标注或额外采样即可自适应。在Qwen3和Qwen3.5主干模型上的数学推理实验表明，Self-Routing始终优于均匀GRPO、均匀OPSD、固定混合以及更简单的路由基线。进一步分析显示，路由分布随训练过程变化，并减少了低信号或已稳定样本的不必要更新。

articles.title: EdiTikZ: Scientific Figure Editing from Revision Trajectories
articles.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance in generating scientific figures from text or images. However, producing publication-ready figures requires iterative refinement, making scientific figure editing an important yet largely unexplored task. Existing approaches rely on costly proprietary agentic systems, focus primarily on evaluation, or construct training supervision from synthetically generated edits. Instead, we leverage naturally occurring scientific revision and development trajectories as a scalable source of supervision. To this end, we introduce DaEdiTikZ, the first large-scale dataset of revision-derived scientific figure edits, constructed by mining 391K plausible TikZ edit pairs from arXiv, GitHub, and TeX SE and inferring 781K directed edit instructions with a VLM conditioned on rendered figures and TikZ code. We further introduce DaEdiTikZ-Bench, a human-refined benchmark with 790 instances, and train two compact Qwen3.5-based EdiTikZ models (4B and 9B) by jointly learning reconstruction and editing, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) with complementary rewards for rendered fidelity and edit application. Automatic evaluation places our 9B model above all tested baselines, while human evaluation with 9 annotators and 4,320 ratings places it above GPT-5.6-Sol and on par with Gemini-3.1-Pro. Under severe out-of-distribution shifts, it remains competitive with GPT-5.6-Sol near its 2K training sequence-length regime. Models and datasets will be released.
articles.titleCn: EdiTikZ：基于修订轨迹的科学图形编辑
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在根据文本或图像生成科学图表方面表现出色。然而，生成适合发表的图表需要迭代优化，使得科学图表编辑成为一个重要但尚未充分探索的任务。现有方法依赖于昂贵的专有代理系统，主要关注评估，或从合成生成的编辑中构建训练监督。相反，我们利用自然发生的科学修订和发展轨迹作为可扩展的监督来源。为此，我们引入了DaEdiTikZ，这是首个基于修订的科学图表编辑的大规模数据集，通过挖掘arXiv、GitHub和TeX SE中的391K个合理TikZ编辑对，并利用在渲染图像和TikZ代码上条件化的VLM推断出781K个有向编辑指令。我们进一步引入了DaEdiTikZ-Bench，这是一个包含790个实例的人工精炼基准，通过联合学习重建和编辑，并使用渲染保真度和编辑应用互补奖励的强化学习（RL）训练了两个基于Qwen3.5的紧凑型EdiTikZ模型（4B和9B）。自动评估将我们的9B模型置于所有测试基线之上，而9名标注员和4,320个评分的人工评估显示其优于GPT-5.6-Sol，并与Gemini-3.1-Pro相当。在严重的分布外偏移下，它在接近其2K训练序列长度的范围内仍与GPT-5.6-Sol保持竞争力。模型和数据集将公开发布。

articles.title: When Tokenization is Secretly Output Supervision
articles.abstract: Tokenization in language models is treated by default as an input preprocessing decision. We argue that this framing is incomplete: in autoregressive models, tokenizer granularity determines what the model must resolve in a single forward pass, and therefore the supervision signal it receives. This affects both the difficulty of the learning problem and the representations that emerge inside the model. We test this in a controlled experiment on numeric reasoning with a novel decoupling of input and output tokenization. As the output supervision view predicts, differences in task performance, training dynamics, and model internals are induced by output tokenization and largely invariant to input tokenization. This may matter in practice, because models with different tokenization strategies differ not only in input representation but in the task they were trained on. Comparisons between models may thus partly reflect task definition rather than ability. A survey of 120 recent *CL papers on numeric reasoning confirms that this is rarely acknowledged: only about 10% report the numeric tokenization of the models they evaluate, while 69% compare across tokenization, and thus supervision, regimes without reporting it. While prior work documents that tokenization consistently affects model performance, there is no principled account of why. We argue that framing tokenization as output supervision provides that account.
articles.titleCn: 当分词被秘密地输出为监督信号时
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型中的分词默认被视为输入预处理决策。我们认为这种框架是不完整的：在自回归模型中，分词粒度决定了模型在单次前向传播中必须解决的问题，从而也决定了它接收的监督信号。这既影响了学习问题的难度，也影响了模型内部产生的表示。我们在一个受控实验中测试了这一点，该实验在数值推理上采用了新颖的输入和输出分词解耦方法。正如输出监督视图所预测的那样，任务性能、训练动态和模型内部的变化是由输出分词引起的，并且很大程度上不受输入分词的影响。这在实践中可能很重要，因为采用不同分词策略的模型不仅在输入表示上不同，而且它们所训练的任务也不同。因此，模型之间的比较可能部分反映了任务定义，而不是能力。对120篇最近的数值推理CL论文的调查证实，这一点很少被认识到：只有大约10%的论文报告了它们评估的模型数值分词情况，而69%的论文在比较不同分词（即监督）机制时并未报告。尽管已有研究记录分词始终会影响模型性能，但还没有关于为什么的原理性解释。我们认为，将分词视为输出监督提供了这种解释。

articles.title: InSight: A Benchmark for Agentic Claim Verification in Interactive Visualizations
articles.abstract: Vision Language Models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in interpreting static visual artifacts, but modern data analysis is inherently dynamic, requiring the active interrogation of interactive environments. Existing benchmarks are predominantly constrained to static imagery and one-shot question answering and fail to capture the epistemic demands of this domain, where evidence is frequently occluded, distributed across linked views, or conditionally revealed through user agency. In this paper, we introduce InSight, a benchmark for agentic claim verification over interactive visualizations. The dataset consists of 21,349 claims derived from human-authored analytical narratives and grounded in fully interactive web-based environments. Agents must navigate these environments to determine whether a natural language claim is supported, refuted or not verifiable given the available evidence. Unlike traditional evaluations, InSight treats interaction traces as intrinsic proxies for reasoning, enabling a rigorous audit of how models seek and synthesize visual evidence. We evaluate state-of-the-art models, revealing that interactive verification remains a non-trivial challenge. We release InSight at https://github.com/maevehutch/insight.
articles.comment: To be presented at EMNLP Main Conference
articles.titleCn: InSight：交互式可视化中自主声明验证的基准
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型在解释静态视觉文物方面表现出色，但现代数据分析本质上具有动态性，需要主动查询交互式环境。现有基准主要局限于静态图像和一次性问答，未能捕捉该领域的认知需求，其中证据经常被遮挡、分布在关联视图中，或通过用户行为条件性揭示。在本文中，我们介绍了InSight，一个用于交互式可视化中自主性声明验证的基准。该数据集包含21,349个声明，源自人类编写的分析性叙述，并基于完全交互式的基于网络的 环境。智能体必须导航这些环境，以确定自然语言声明是否得到支持、被反驳或无法验证，基于可用的证据。与传统的评估不同，InSight将交互轨迹视为推理的内在代理，从而能够严格审查模型如何寻求和综合视觉证据。我们评估了最先进的模型，揭示交互式验证仍然是一个非平凡的挑战。我们在https://github.com/maevehutch/insight上发布了InSight。

articles.title: Polish ModernBERT: The Long and Short of Polish Language Understanding
articles.abstract: Encoder-only Transformers remain effective for discriminative and representation-learning tasks, yet Polish encoders still largely rely on BERT/RoBERTa-style architectures. We introduce \textbf{Polish ModernBERT}, a family of four Polish encoders available at Base and Large scales, each with 512-token and 8K context variants. We adapt the ModernBERT pretraining recipe through staged selection experiments and release a long-context benchmark covering legal topic classification, ideological decision-direction prediction, factual-consistency assessment over literary plot summaries, and human-rights violation assessment. Across 30 tasks, Polish ModernBERT achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated Polish encoders, reaching 83.99 and 85.11 for the Base-8K and Large-8K models, respectively. On long-context tasks, the 8K variants improve over matched Polish RoBERTa-8K baselines from 67.47 to 77.15 and from 75.88 to 78.49 at the Base and Large scales, respectively. The Base-8K model achieves this gain with 22\% fewer parameters (149M vs.\ 190M). Efficiency measurements in representative inference setups show lower peak memory usage and latency than matched Polish RoBERTa baselines in both 512-token and 8K settings. Polish ModernBERT-8K-Base additionally achieves the best result on a Polish retrieval benchmark among the evaluated encoders below 300M parameters.
articles.titleCn: 波兰现代BERT：波兰语言理解的长与短
articles.abstractCn: 仅编码器式的Transformer在判别和表征学习任务中依然有效，但波兰编码器仍主要依赖BERT/RoBERTa风格的架构。我们引入了\textbf{波兰现代BERT}，这是一系列四个不同规模的波兰编码器，包括基础版和大型版，每个版本都有512个token和8K上下文变体。我们通过分阶段的筛选实验调整了现代BERT的预训练配方，并发布了一个长上下文基准，涵盖法律主题分类、意识形态决策方向预测、文学情节摘要的事实一致性评估以及人权侵犯评估。在30项任务中，波兰现代BERT在所有评估的波兰编码器中表现最佳，基础版-8K和大型版-8K模型分别达到了83.99和85.11的性能。在长上下文任务中，8K变体在基础版和大型版上分别将匹配的波兰RoBERTa-8K基线的性能从67.47提升到77.15，从75.88提升到78.49。基础版-8K模型通过减少22%的参数（149M vs.\ 190M）实现了这一提升。在代表性的推理设置中的效率测量显示，在512个token和8K设置下，与匹配的波兰RoBERTa基线相比，峰值内存使用和延迟更低。波兰现代BERT-8K-Base在评估的参数低于300M的编码器中，在波兰检索基准上取得了最佳结果。

articles.title: IntroConformal: Conformal Factuality Guarantees for Large Vision-Language Models via Introspective Signals
articles.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved strong multimodal performance, yet ensuring the factual correctness of generated content remains challenging. Existing methods that provide statistical guarantees on factuality typically rely on external verifiers or generation-time confidence signals, which introduce auxiliary dependencies or often fail for confident but incorrect outputs. We argue that reliable factuality control can instead be achieved through introspective signals derived from the model itself. We introduce IntroConformal, a training-free Conformal Risk Control (CRC) framework that provides finite-sample, distribution-free factuality guarantees. We first instantiate it with layer-wise semantic stability, a conformity score derived from hidden-state representations, and then propose verification probability, a stronger score capturing the model's self-administered judgment on claim factuality. Across multiple LVLM architectures, IntroConformal satisfies the conformal risk guarantee while substantially reducing abstention and achieving competitive or superior claim-level discrimination relative to external verifier-based baselines.
articles.titleCn: 内省一致性：通过内省信号为大型视觉语言模型提供一致性事实保证
articles.abstractCn: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）已取得优异的多模态性能，但确保生成内容的客观真实性仍具挑战。现有在客观真实性方面提供统计保证的方法通常依赖外部验证器或生成时置信信号，这会引入辅助依赖性或常对自信但错误的输出失效。我们认为，可靠的客观真实性控制可通过模型自身产生的内省信号实现。我们引入IntroConformal，这是一种无需训练的符合性风险控制（CRC）框架，提供有限样本、分布无关的客观真实性保证。我们首先将其实例化为基于层级语义稳定性的符合性分数，该分数源自隐藏状态表示，然后提出验证概率，这是一种更强的分数，捕捉模型对主张客观真实性的自我管理判断。在多种LVLM架构中，IntroConformal满足符合性风险保证，同时显著减少拒绝行为，并相对于基于外部验证器的基线实现竞争性或更优的主张级区分。

articles.title: Behaviorally Effective LoRA Writes Are Sparse and Structured
articles.abstract: Low-rank adaptation fixes the rank of the update, but it does not identify which parts of a trained write actually carry behavior. We study that question directly and show that behaviorally effective LoRA writes are sparse, structured, and far more concentrated than the raw low-rank parameterization suggests. We use Learned-Basis LoRA, a learned-basis continuation recipe, to expose that structure. The recipe warms up an unconstrained adapter, converts its learned write columns into a module-wise orthonormal basis, freezes that basis, and continues training inside the constrained parameterization. Across 14 exact switches from unconstrained to constrained form, held-out accuracy is unchanged at the conversion step and reconstructed write matrices differ by at most 0.25% relative Frobenius error. Same-state continuation then shows that the same trained checkpoint develops differently under different write subspaces, establishing write geometry as a causal state variable. A no-retraining projection test shows that useful write signal stays inside the learned write space and largely disappears from random or frozen-activation PCA controls. The concentration pattern is strong at both local and global scales. Across GSM8K, MathQA, and AQuA, per-module top-k continuation reaches its optimum at k in {2, 4} in all twelve seed-level cases we test. A stricter global ranking test shows that learned top-16 and top-32 subsets outperform matched random subsets, especially on GSM8K/Qwen and MathQA/Qwen. Single-direction ablations further reveal a sparse set of late q_proj, o_proj, and down_proj components with outsized behavioral impact.
articles.titleCn: 行为有效的LoRA写入是稀疏和结构化的
articles.abstractCn: 低秩适配固定了更新的秩，但它无法识别训练好的写操作中哪些部分携带了行为。我们直接研究该问题，并证明行为有效的LoRA写操作是稀疏的、结构化的，并且比原始低秩参数化所暗示的更加集中。我们使用Learned-Basis LoRA，一种基于学习基的延续配方，来揭示这种结构。该配方先对无约束适配器进行预热，将其学习到的写列转换为模块级的正交基，冻结该基，并在受限参数化内部继续训练。在从无约束到受限形式的14次精确切换中，转换步骤的保留准确率保持不变，重建的写矩阵的相对Frobenius误差最多为0.25%。相同状态延续实验表明，相同的训练检查点在不同写子空间下表现出不同的发展，确立了写几何作为因果状态变量。无再训练投影测试表明，有用的写信号保留在学习的写空间内，而随机或冻结激活的PCA控制中则基本消失。集中模式在局部和全局尺度上都很显著。在GSM8K、MathQA和AQuA上，每个模块的top-k延续在所有12个种子级测试案例中均达到最优，k取值为{2, 4}。更严格的全球排名测试表明，学习的top-16和top-32子集优于匹配的随机子集，尤其是在GSM8K/Qwen和MathQA/Qwen上。单方向消融实验进一步揭示了一组稀疏的晚期q_proj、o_proj和down_proj组件，它们对行为具有显著影响。

articles.title: How Correct Is Your Answer? A Semantic Correctness Framework for Open QA Evaluation
articles.abstract: Reliable evaluation of open-ended question answering remains a bottleneck for measuring answer correctness of modern LLMs. Unlike multiple-choice tasks, free-form answers may be correct in many surface forms and may fail in qualitatively different ways, including incompleteness, contradiction, overgeneration, and endorsement of false premises. Existing judgment-based and similarity-based metrics often collapse these distinctions. We address this gap with three reusable contributions. First, we introduce a semantic correctness taxonomy that assigns open-ended answers to eight ordered classes, separating verbose-but-correct answers from those contaminated by hallucinated content. Second, we release CAP-Correctness, an 8.8k-example benchmark spanning widely used QA datasets, and CAP-Statements, an 11k-example dataset for converting question-answer pairs into declarative statements for natural language inference (NLI) training and statement-based evaluation. Third, we introduce CAP (Context-Aware Precision), a reference-based metric that scores question-conditioned statements using bidirectional NLI. Under a monotonicity protocol testing whether metrics respect the taxonomy's intended ordering, CAP outperforms established baselines.
articles.titleCn: 你的答案有多准确？面向开放问答评估的语义正确性框架
articles.abstractCn: 对开放式问答进行可靠的评估仍然是衡量现代大语言模型答案正确性的瓶颈。与选择题不同，自由形式的答案可能有多种表面形式的正确性，也可能以质地上不同的方式失败，包括不完整性、矛盾、过度生成以及对错误前提的认可。现有的基于判断和基于相似度的指标往往会忽略这些区别。我们通过三个可重用的贡献来解决这个问题。首先，我们引入了一个语义正确性分类法，将开放式答案分配到八个有序类别中，将冗长但正确的答案与被幻觉内容污染的答案区分开来。其次，我们发布了CAP-Correctness，一个包含8800个例子的基准，涵盖了广泛使用的问答数据集，以及CAP-Statements，一个包含11000个例子的数据集，用于将问答对转换为用于自然语言推理（NLI）训练和基于陈述的评估的声明。第三，我们引入了CAP（上下文感知精确度），一种基于参考的指标，使用双向NLI对问题条件下的陈述进行评分。在单调性协议测试中，该协议用于测试指标是否尊重分类法预期的排序，CAP的表现优于既定的基线。

articles.title: Investigating Linear Probe Robustness to Linguistic Register, Medical Specialty, and Corpus Shifts in Medical QA
articles.abstract: Linear classifiers trained on hidden states of a large language model (LLM), linear probes, can flag factual errors from a single forward pass. Geometrically, that implies that true and false statements separate along a stable direction in hidden state space, i.e., the truth direction. Prior work disagrees on whether this generalises across input shifts, but the disagreement is hard to interpret because cross-dataset probe transfer experiments confound several kinds of input change at once. We isolate three such variables in medical question-answering (QA): writing style (register), domain (medical specialty), and corpus (dataset). We build a benchmark using 500 MedQA entries, each rewritten into four styles (textbook, patient, clinical note, colloquial), annotated with clinical specialty, and grouped with two other exam corpora, MedMCQA and MMLU-medical, for cross-dataset evaluation. Probing four open-weight LLMs (2--8B), we find that the truth direction is largely robust to writing style (mean $Δ_\text{register} \approx 0.10$ AUROC on held-out facts) and to medical specialty ($Δ_\text{specialty} \approx 0.03$), but degrades unevenly across corpora: by $0.12$ AUROC on MMLU-medical and by $0.21$ on MedMCQA, roughly twice the register gap. The register result replicates with a second generator and carries over to human-written patient questions. The truth direction is therefore largely stable within the medical domain but breaks under some corpus shifts, and question format does not explain the break, which suggests that the signal a linear probe recovers is partly bound to dataset structure rather than to medical knowledge alone.
articles.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 9 pages, 4 figures (main text); 28 pages total, including appendix. Code and data: https://github.com/mnishant2/MedProbe_release
articles.titleCn: 探究医学问答中线性探针对语言语域、医学专业和语料库变化的鲁棒性
articles.abstractCn: 在大型语言模型（LLM）的隐藏状态上训练的线性分类器（线性探针）可以通过单次前向传递标记事实性错误。从几何角度来看，这意味着真实和错误陈述在隐藏状态空间中沿着一个稳定方向（即真理方向）分离。先前的研究对于这一特性是否适用于输入变化存在分歧，但由于跨数据集探针迁移实验同时混淆了多种输入变化类型，因此这种分歧难以解释。我们在医学问答（QA）中隔离了三个此类变量：写作风格（语域）、领域（医学专科）和语料库（数据集）。我们使用500个MedQA条目构建了一个基准，每个条目被改写成四种风格（教科书、患者、临床记录、口语），标注了临床专科，并与另外两个考试语料库MedMCQA和MMLU-medical组合进行跨数据集评估。我们对四个开放权重LLM（2B至8B）进行探针测试，发现真理方向在很大程度上对写作风格（在保留事实上的平均$Δ_\text{register} \approx 0.10$ AUROC）和医学专科（$Δ_\text{specialty} \approx 0.03$）具有鲁棒性，但在不同语料库中的退化程度不均：在MMLU-medical上退化0.12 AUROC，在MedMCQA上退化0.21 AUROC，大约是写作风格差异的两倍。写作风格的结果通过第二个生成器得到了验证，并扩展到了人类编写的患者问题。因此，真理方向在医学领域内基本稳定，但在某些语料库变化下会失效，且问题格式无法解释这种失效，这表明线性探针恢复的信号部分与数据集结构相关，而不仅仅是医学知识本身。

articles.title: Separating Syntax from Language: A Mechanistic Account of Translation in Multilingual LLMs
articles.abstract: Multilingual large language models (mLLMs) achieve strong performance in machine translation, yet our understanding of the mechanisms by which they transform representations from one language to another remains incomplete. Prior work suggests that translation decomposes into separable processes within an mLLM, where conceptual content is first represented independently, followed by a production into language-specific form. In this work, we show that translation is even more modular than previously assumed and that the output language production in translation processes is actually further separable into a syntax and a surface language process. We construct controlled multilingual datasets that isolate cross-linguistic differences in word-order and use causal interventions and probing to track how representations are transformed during translation. We find that models first construct target-side word-order before realizing the target language surface form. We identify individual attention heads that are selectively sensitive to syntactic transformations while remaining largely invariant to language identity. These results establish the commitment to a syntactic structure as an independent stage in translation, extending prior decompositions and showing how translation is implemented by functionally different components within mLLMs.
articles.titleCn: 将句法与语言分离：多语言大型语言模型中翻译的机制性解释
articles.abstractCn: 多语言大型语言模型（mLLMs）在机器翻译方面表现出色，然而我们对它们如何将一种语言的表示转换为另一种语言的机制的理解仍不完整。先前的研究表明，翻译是在mLLM内部分解为可分离的过程，其中概念内容首先独立表示，然后转化为特定语言的形式。在这项工作中，我们表明翻译比之前认为的更加模块化，并且翻译过程中的输出语言生成实际上可以进一步分解为句法和表层语言过程。我们构建了受控的多语言数据集，以隔离词序的跨语言差异，并使用因果干预和探测来追踪表示在翻译过程中的转换方式。我们发现模型首先构建目标语言的词序，然后才实现目标语言的表层形式。我们识别出对句法转换具有选择性敏感性而对语言身份基本不变的个别注意力头。这些结果确立了句法结构作为翻译中一个独立阶段，扩展了先前分解，并展示了翻译如何在mLLM内部由功能不同的组件实现。

articles.title: Where the Verifier Fails: A Category-Level Audit of Reward Signals in RLVR
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and standard benchmark evaluation both rely on an automatic verifier that turns a free text answer into a binary reward. Prior work reports that one evaluation harness accepts only about 94% of its own ground truth answers, blaming LaTeX parsing. That is an aggregate: it does not say which answer forms consume the error budget. We supply the decomposition. We apply metamorphic testing to the verifier rather than the model, generating certified equivalent answer variants, that is, rewrites that preserve mathematical meaning by construction, so that any rejection is a provable false negative needing no human adjudication. We then measure rejection per answer category across four widely used verifiers over 307,420 verdicts. We find three things. (1) Self validation ranges from 53.8% to 95.2% on identical inputs, a spread of 41.3 points. The published figure describes one implementation, not the task; two configurations of the same library disagree on 49.9% of pairs. (2) The residual is not spread across parsing categories but concentrated in whitespace and punctuation, which account for 93.0% of in contract failures for the default LaTeX configuration. A trailing period or newline dominates the budget. (3) Separating rejection from execution failure shows that verifiers with similar aggregate error fail for opposite reasons, and that a reference numeric cascade accepts off by one wrong answers as a step function of magnitude, from 0% below 10^4 to 100% at or above, because its relative tolerance is scale invariant.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code, transform suite, contract matrix, and per-sample verdict records at https://github.com/ethxin0011/verifier-error-budget
articles.titleCn: 验证者失败之处：对RLVR中奖励信号的类别级审计
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）和标准基准评估都依赖于一个自动验证器，该验证器将自由文本答案转换为二元奖励。先前研究报道，一个评估框架仅接受其自身真实答案的约94%，并将此归因于LaTeX解析。这是一个总体数据：它并未说明哪些答案形式消耗了错误预算。我们提供了分解。我们不对模型而是对验证器应用变形测试，生成经过认证的等价答案变体，即通过构造保留数学意义的重写，因此任何拒绝都是一个可证明的假阴性，无需人工裁决。然后，我们测量了四个广泛使用的验证器在307,420个裁决中的每个答案类别的拒绝率。我们发现了三点。(1) 自我验证在相同输入上范围从53.8%到95.2%，差异为41.3个百分点。已发表的数字描述了一个实现，而不是任务；同一库的两个配置在49.9%的对中意见不一。(2) 残差并未分布在解析类别中，而是集中在空格和标点符号上，这些占默认LaTeX配置合同失败的93.0%。一个尾随句点或换行符主导了预算。(3) 将拒绝与执行失败区分开来表明，具有相似总体误差的验证器因不同原因失败，并且参考数字级联将“差一”的错误答案作为阶跃函数接受，幅度从10^4以下0%到10^4及以上100%，因为其相对容差是尺度不变的。

articles.title: CHARM: Character Hallucination for Multicultural Role Play Benchmark
articles.abstract: Role-playing large language models (LLMs) are expected to adopt a character's style while also respecting that character's knowledge boundaries. Prior evaluations detect character hallucination but rarely distinguish whether errors arise from failure to recognize a boundary or from failure to comply despite recognition. We introduce CHARM, a multicultural benchmark of 40 real and fictional characters drawn from five cultural-linguistic regions, and validated by native reviewers. It probes two boundary types, Temporal (historical vs. modern) and Cross-Universe (entities outside a character's narrative or historical universe), using abstention-enabled multiple-choice questions. We propose a two-stage evaluation that separates Boundary-Awareness (explicit recognition that a query is out of scope) from Boundary-Compliance (abstention when answering concrete questions). Evaluations across six LLMs show that hallucination is driven predominantly by compliance failures. Models frequently acknowledge that a query lies outside the character's knowledge yet still provide factual, out-of-character answers. By re-posing the same questions to the target character, we confirm that a large fraction of these cases are verified parametric overrides; the model stores the relevant fact but fails to suppress it. We also observe systematic cultural variation in these failures, consistent with imbalances in how characters from different regions are represented in model knowledge.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: CHARM：多元文化角色扮演基准的多角色幻觉
articles.abstractCn: 角色扮演的大型语言模型（LLMs）被期望在采用角色风格的同时，也尊重角色的知识边界。以往的评估能够检测角色幻觉，但很少区分错误是由于未能识别边界，还是由于在识别边界后未能遵守。我们引入了CHARM，这是一个包含40个真实和虚构角色的多文化基准，这些角色来自五个文化语言区域，并由母语者进行验证。该基准通过启用回避选项的选择题，探测两种边界类型：时间边界（历史与现代）和跨宇宙边界（角色叙事或历史宇宙之外的实体）。我们提出了一种两阶段评估方法，将边界意识（明确识别查询超出范围）与边界遵守（在回答具体问题时回避）分开。对六个LLM的评估表明，幻觉主要由遵守失败驱动。模型经常承认查询超出角色的知识范围，但仍提供与角色不符的事实性回答。通过向目标角色重新提出相同的问题，我们确认了其中很大一部分是经过参数覆盖的验证案例；模型存储了相关事实，但未能抑制它。我们还观察到这些失败中存在系统性的文化差异，这与不同地区的角色在模型知识中的代表性不平衡一致。

articles.title: Probing Factual Knowledge Transfer with Training Data Interventions
articles.abstract: Do multilingual language models transfer factual knowledge across languages during continued pretraining, or do they mostly recall facts learned directly from the target-language data? To answer this question more reliably, we propose an intervention-based framework: starting from an English-pretrained model, we continue pretraining on Persian data from which specific facts have been systematically removed at varying levels of granularity. We construct SIFT, a resource of 500 triples across 20 relations, stratified by the cultural origin of each fact's subject into general (globally prominent) and Persian-related entities, designed for both systematic fact removal from training data and evaluation, with natively written Persian cloze templates. Our results show that fact transfer is very limited: under the strictest removal condition, a large majority of English-acquired facts fail to transfer into Persian. We further show that sentence-level co-occurrence removal is insufficient to eliminate fact signal, and that easier (randomly selected) negative candidate sets substantially inflate apparent transfer by rewarding shallow associative heuristics, while performance on a harder candidate set that allows for less reliance on heuristics is much lower. Finally, we show that source-language entity frequency has a large influence, with Persian-related facts, which are orders of magnitude rarer in the English corpus, hardly transferring.
articles.titleCn: 通过训练数据干预探测事实性知识迁移
articles.abstractCn: 多语言语言模型在持续预训练过程中是否能够跨语言传递事实性知识，还是主要回忆从目标语言数据中直接学习到的事实？为了更可靠地回答这个问题，我们提出了一种基于干预的框架：从英语预训练模型开始，我们在从中系统性地移除特定事实的波斯语数据上进行持续预训练，这些事实在粒度上有所不同。我们构建了SIFT，这是一个包含20种关系的500个三元组的资源，根据每个事实主体的文化来源分为一般（全球突出）和波斯相关实体，旨在用于从训练数据中系统性地移除事实以及评估，并配有原生波斯语的完形填空模板。我们的结果表明事实传递非常有限：在最严格的移除条件下，大部分英语习得的事实未能传递到波斯语中。我们进一步表明，句子级别的共现移除不足以消除事实信号，而较容易（随机选择）的负样本集会显著夸大传递效果，通过奖励浅层关联启发式方法，而在一个允许较少依赖启发式的更难样本集上的表现则要低得多。最后，我们表明源语言实体频率有巨大影响，波斯相关事实在英语语料库中极为罕见，几乎无法传递。

articles.title: VerTox: Verifiable Reward-Guided Corpus Poisoning Against Neural Ranking Models
articles.abstract: Neural ranking models have become core components of modern information retrieval systems and important building blocks of AI systems such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. However, their robustness remains insufficiently understood in the presence of large language models (LLMs), which can generate fluent and deceptive content at scale. This work investigates the vulnerability of neural ranking models to corpus poisoning attacks, in which an adversary injects a small number of maliciously crafted documents into the corpus to distort ranking behavior. We propose VerTox, the first framework to formulate corpus poisoning as a verifiable reward-guided reinforcement learning (RLVR) problem. By explicitly coupling ranking distortion with factual corruption through specialized reward shaping, we fine-tune compact LLMs into adversarial generators. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves near-perfect attack success rates, producing adversarial documents that frequently rank higher than target documents across major neural ranking architectures, as well as a proprietary commercial embedding model. The generated adversarial documents are fluent and exhibit low perplexity, making them difficult to detect. Furthermore, by explicitly encouraging factual corruption, our adversarial documents significantly degrade the performance of a downstream RAG application.
articles.titleCn: VerTox：可验证的奖励引导语料污染针对神经排序模型
articles.abstractCn: 神经排序模型已成为现代信息检索系统的核心组件，也是检索增强生成（RAG）等AI系统的重要构建模块。然而，在大型语言模型（LLM）存在的情况下，它们的鲁棒性仍未能得到充分理解，因为LLM能够大规模生成流畅且具有欺骗性的内容。本研究探讨了神经排序模型在面对语料库中毒攻击时的脆弱性，攻击者通过向语料库中注入少量恶意构造的文档来扭曲排序行为。我们提出了VerTox，这是首个将语料库中毒问题形式化为可验证奖励引导强化学习（RLVR）问题的框架。通过借助专门设计的奖励塑形，我们将排序扭曲与事实污染明确关联，从而将紧凑型LLM微调为对抗性生成器。实验表明，我们的方法实现了近乎完美的攻击成功率，生成的对抗性文档在主要的神经排序架构以及一个专有的商业嵌入模型中，其排名经常高于目标文档。生成的对抗性文档流畅且困惑度低，难以检测。此外，通过明确鼓励事实污染，我们的对抗性文档显著降低了下游RAG应用的性能。

articles.title: Exploring Sparse Autoencoders in Text-Based Causal Confounding Adjustment
articles.abstract: In many settings, studying causal questions based on text data requires adjusting for confounding information within texts. Yet there is a tradeoff in constructing text representations for adjustment: they must be sufficiently large and/or dense to preserve the confounding variables necessary for unbiased effect estimation, but sufficiently small and/or sparse to satisfy finite-sample overlap and yield low-variance estimates. To address this tradeoff, we turn to sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and propose a novel causal adjustment pipeline that iteratively selects a minimal set of SAE features via conditional independence tests. We find that SAE representations achieve better adjustments (lower bias and and higher coverage) than alternative representations in standard semi-synthetic evaluations with binary confounders, and their interpretability offers opportunities for falsification. We also introduce a more realistic semi-synthetic evaluation that uses multi-label data as the unobserved confounders and find off-the-shelf adjustment methods require increased investigation for these more complex settings. Code: https://github.com/mianzg/sae-text-confounder
articles.comment: Long paper accepted at EMNLP 2026 main conference, 25 pages, 16 figures
articles.titleCn: 基于文本的因果混杂调整中稀疏自编码器的探索
articles.abstractCn: 在许多场景中，基于文本数据研究因果关系问题需要调整文本内部的混杂信息。然而，在构建用于调整的文本表示时存在权衡：它们必须足够大和/或密集以保留无偏效应估计所需的混杂变量，但又必须足够小和/或稀疏以满足有限样本重叠并产生低方差估计。为了解决这种权衡，我们转向稀疏自动编码器（SAEs），并提出了一种新的因果调整流程，该流程通过条件独立性检验迭代选择一组最小的SAE特征。我们发现，在具有二元混杂变量的标准半合成评估中，SAE表示比替代表示实现了更好的调整（更低的偏差和更高的覆盖率），并且它们的可解释性为证伪提供了机会。我们还引入了一个更现实的半合成评估，该评估使用多标签数据作为未观察到的混杂变量，并发现现成的调整方法需要对这些更复杂的场景进行更多研究。代码：https://github.com/mianzg/sae-text-confounder

articles.title: Reliability Challenges in Diffusion Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion-based Large Vision-Language Models (dLVLMs) have recently emerged as a compelling alternative to autoregressive (AR) LVLMs, offering advantages in parallel decoding, bidirectional context, and controllable generation. Despite rapid progress, their reliability properties remain largely uncharacterized. We present the first systematic reliability evaluation of hallucination and bias in dLVLMs, benchmarking six diffusion models against competitive AR baselines across four dimensions. Our key findings are: (1) dLVLMs reverse the yes-bias of AR models in binary visual queries; (2) they achieve competitive hallucination rates yet exhibit degraded linguistic quality; (3) they collapse to near-zero accuracy on underrepresented racial groups with opposite-polarity gender bias; and (4) they exhibit accuracy collapse in multiple-choice settings when the correct option is shorter than its distractors, associated with a length prior that emerges at the first denoising step. Tokens committed at late denoising steps with low confidence further correlate with hallucinated content, pointing to a mechanistic signal unique to diffusion generation. These patterns vary across model families, suggesting reliability is shaped by the generative paradigm together with training data.
articles.titleCn: 扩散视觉语言模型的可靠性挑战
articles.abstractCn: 基于扩散模型的视觉语言模型（dLVLMs）近期已成为自回归（AR）LVLMs的一种引人注目的替代方案，在并行解码、双向上下文和可控生成方面具有优势。尽管取得了快速进展，但其可靠性特性仍基本未得到表征。我们首次对dLVLMs中的幻觉和偏差进行了系统可靠性评估，在四个维度上对六个扩散模型与具有竞争力的AR基线进行了基准测试。我们的主要发现是：（1）dLVLMs逆转了AR模型在二元视觉查询中的“是”偏差；（2）它们实现了具有竞争力的幻觉率，但语言质量有所下降；（3）在性别偏向相反的代表性不足的种族群体上，它们的准确率接近于零；（4）在正确选项比干扰项短的多项选择设置中，它们表现出准确率崩溃，这与在第一次去噪步骤中出现的长度先验相关。在低置信度下，在后期去噪步骤中确认的标记进一步与幻觉内容相关，这表明扩散生成具有独特的机制信号。这些模式在不同模型家族中有所不同，表明可靠性是由生成范式和训练数据共同塑造的。

articles.title: MIDR: Enrichment-Augmented Indexing for Multimodal Document Retrieval
articles.abstract: Retrieval over visually rich documents has a representation problem: important content often lives in tables, charts, figures, and layout relations that plain OCR linearizes, corrupts, or omits. ColPali-family visual retrievers address this with patch-level multi-vector indexes and late-interaction scoring, keeping image-derived retrieval on the query-time serving path. We introduce MIDR (Multimodal Indexing for Document Retrieval), a training-free framework for enrichment-augmented indexing that shifts multimodal reasoning to index time. During ingestion, a multimodal LLM converts rendered pages into verified textual fields that are indexed with BM25F and optionally fused with dense retrieval, enabling text-centric serving over multimodally grounded evidence. On ViDoRe V3, MIDR Hybrid achieves 0.6219 average nDCG across five English domains, a 23.0% relative gain over BM25, remaining competitive with ColQwen2.5. On two French-document domains, enrichment bridges English queries and French page text, lifting BM25 from 0.1532 to 0.5448 nDCG and outperforming ColQwen2.5. Across all seven domains, MIDR leads ColQwen2.5 on four while using approximately 9x smaller index memory and approximately 2x lower query latency. These results establish index-time multimodal reasoning as a compelling accuracy-deployment alternative to serving-time visual late interaction.
