articles.titleCn: MIDR：用于多模态文档检索的富集增强索引
articles.abstractCn: 在视觉丰富的文档中检索存在表示问题：重要内容通常存在于表格、图表、图形和布局关系中，而传统OCR会将这些内容线性化、损坏或遗漏。ColPali系列视觉检索器通过基于图像块的多向量索引和后期交互评分来解决这一问题，将基于图像的检索保留在查询服务路径上。我们介绍了MIDR（文档检索的多模态索引），这是一个无需训练的框架，用于增强型索引，将多模态推理转移到索引时间。在数据导入过程中，多模态大型语言模型将渲染页面转换为经过验证的文本字段，这些字段使用BM25F进行索引，并可选择与密集检索融合，从而实现以文本为中心的服务，基于多模态证据。在ViDoRe V3上，MIDR混合检索在五个英文领域实现了0.6219的平均nDCG，相比BM25提升了23.0%，与ColQwen2.5保持竞争力。在两个法文文档领域，增强功能将英文查询与法文页面文本连接起来，将BM25的nDCG从0.1532提升至0.5448，并超越了ColQwen2.5。在所有七个领域，MIDR在四个领域领先ColQwen2.5，同时索引内存使用量约为9倍更小，查询延迟约为2倍更低。这些结果确立了索引时间多模态推理作为服务时间视觉后期交互的一种具有吸引力的精度部署替代方案。

articles.title: Explore Before Committing: Hypothesis-Guided Search for Deep Research Agents
articles.abstract: Deep-research agents answer complex questions by interacting with search and browsing tools, yet they often search along a single evolving trajectory. Our trajectory-level analysis reveals a common failure mode in which the agent may encounter an early search state with several plausible directions, but follow one direction before collecting enough comparative evidence. Once this happens, subsequent tool calls tend to reinforce the same path, increasing the chance of failure when the initial direction is misleading. We further find that successful trajectories reduce this risk through two behaviors: grounding vague exploration in concrete candidates and shifting directions when the current path is weak or incomplete. Based on these findings, we propose HypoSearch, which generates lightweight hypotheses as soft search hints, explores them through bounded independent branches, and compares branch-level evidence before commitment. Across four deep-research benchmarks and three backbone models, HypoSearch consistently outperforms single-trajectory search and standard parallel baselines, improving Qwen3.5-122B from 46.7 to 60.0 on BC-small while using fewer tool calls than five independent trajectories. A pilot supervised fine-tuning study further shows that these behavioral signals can curate compact training trajectories and reduce degradation from unfiltered data.
articles.titleCn: 在提交前探索：针对深度研究智能体的假设引导式搜索
articles.abstractCn: 深度研究代理通过交互式搜索和浏览工具来回答复杂问题，但它们通常沿着单一的演化轨迹进行搜索。我们的轨迹级分析揭示了一种常见的失效模式：代理可能在早期搜索状态遇到多个合理方向，但在收集到足够的比较证据之前就选择了其中一个方向。一旦发生这种情况，后续的工具调用往往会强化相同路径，从而增加初始方向具有误导性时的失败风险。我们进一步发现，成功的轨迹通过两种行为来降低这种风险：将模糊探索锚定在具体候选方案上，并在当前路径薄弱或信息不完整时转换方向。基于这些发现，我们提出了HypoSearch方法，该方法生成轻量级假设作为软搜索提示，通过有界的独立分支进行探索，并在做出承诺前比较分支级证据。在四个深度研究基准和三种主干模型上，HypoSearch始终优于单轨迹搜索和标准并行基线，在BC-small数据集上将Qwen3.5-122B的性能从46.7提升至60.0，同时使用的工具调用次数少于五个独立轨迹。一项初步的监督微调研究进一步表明，这些行为信号可以筛选出紧凑的训练轨迹，并减少未过滤数据带来的性能退化。

articles.title: Some Emotions Run Deeper: Layer-wise Probing and Causal Intervention in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Emotion is expressed in text along a wide spectrum, from surface lexical cues to inferences entangled with content. Most layer-wise analyses of emotion in LLMs use a single corpus, leaving open whether the depth at which emotion becomes accessible is a property of the model or also of the text source. We investigate this across three datasets spanning different degrees of explicitness and contextualization in emotion expression (Twitter posts, Reddit comments, and autobiographical narratives) and eight 1B--9B open-weight LLMs from the Llama, Qwen, and Granite families. We combine layer-wise probing with offline feature scaling and online forward interventions, transfer analyses, and an early-exit classifier. We find that (i) the best probing layer shifts systematically across corpora, from input-adjacent layers to over half model depth, and this ordering persists after matching label-by-length-bin distributions; (ii) across the evaluated settings, forward-pass interventions on probe-selected bands reduce test accuracy by 5--6 points more than same-width random bands ($q < 0.01$); (iii) selected bands transfer across datasets and emotion categories, suggesting partially shared affective information rather than strictly per-emotion substrates; and (iv) probe-selected early-exit representations outperform full-depth exits by $6.9$ percentage points on average.
articles.titleCn: 某些情感更为深沉：大型语言模型中的逐层探测与因果干预
articles.abstractCn: 文本中的情感表达呈现出广泛的光谱，从表层词汇线索到与内容交织的推断。大多数对大型语言模型（LLMs）中情感的多层分析都使用单一语料库，这留下了情感变得可及的深度是模型属性还是文本来源属性的问题。我们在三个涵盖情感表达显式程度和情境化程度不同的数据集（推特帖子、Reddit评论和自传体叙事）以及来自Llama、Qwen和Granite系列的八个1B--9B开放权重LLMs上进行了研究。我们结合了分层探测、离线特征缩放和在线前向干预、迁移分析和早期退出分类器。我们发现：(i) 最佳探测层系统地跨语料库变化，从输入相邻层到超过模型深度的一半，这种顺序在匹配按长度分箱的标签分布后仍然存在；(ii) 在评估的设置中，对探测选定的频段进行的前向传递干预比同宽度的随机频段降低了5--6个百分点的测试准确率（$q < 0.01$）；(iii) 选定的频段在数据集和情感类别之间迁移，表明存在部分共享的情感信息，而不是严格按情感划分的子结构；(iv) 探测选定的早期退出表示平均优于全深度退出6.9个百分点。

articles.title: From Base Rollouts to RL Reasoning: A Budgeted Search Perspective
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but how these gains relate to inference-time decoding and search remains unclear. Does RL create reasoning the base model lacks, or shift the rollout distribution toward trajectories it can already reach but rarely samples? We study this behaviorally with a Unified Decoding Framework (UDF), which expresses token-level sampling, beam-like search, tree search, and sequence-level resampling as executable policies over a shared budgeted operating space, scored post hoc with pass@$k$, self-consistency, best-of-$N$, and first-finish success. Using paired Base/RL checkpoints from SimpleRL-Zoo, we ask whether an RL default-policy curve can be approximated by a structured path of Base operating points. On Math500, AIME, GPQA, and IFEval, the pass@$k$ recovery path follows a Budgeted Operating-Point Transition Rule (BOPTR), $N_{\mathrm{Base}} \approx αN_{\mathrm{RL}}^β$, with benchmark-conditioned exponents. On Qwen2.5-7B, BOPTR gives the lowest transfer error among the non-oracle rules we test, 3.41 pp (95% CI [2.32, 5.53]); a three-seed replication gives 3.07 $\pm$ 0.39 pp. The rule extends to ten models across four families (3.28 to 4.87 pp on checkpoints added after fitting), to four benchmarks it was never fitted on (5.03 pp vs. 4.44 pp in fit), and holds without an RL checkpoint for the target model (4.19 pp) or without RL supervision of any kind (5.08 pp). These results support a qualified internalized-search reading: under the recipe we test, much of the measured RL gain corresponds to a change in sampling efficiency toward operating points the base model can already reach under search. We treat the scaling patterns as descriptive of this recipe and cohort, report where they break down, and use UDF and BOPTR as behavioral diagnostics rather than evidence of parameter-level equivalence.
articles.titleCn: 从基础策略扩展到强化学习推理：预算搜索视角
articles.abstractCn: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提升了语言模型的推理能力，但这些提升如何与推理时的解码和搜索相关联尚不明确。强化学习是创造了基础模型所缺乏的推理能力，还是将策略分布向基础模型已经能够达到但很少采样的轨迹转移？我们通过统一解码框架（UDF）从行为角度研究这一现象，该框架将标记级采样、束状搜索、树搜索和序列级重采样表达为在共享预算操作空间上的可执行策略，并使用pass@$k$、自洽性、最佳-$N$和首次完成成功进行事后评分。使用SimpleRL-Zoo的成对基础/RL检查点，我们探究RL默认策略曲线是否可以由基础操作点的结构化路径近似表示。在Math500、AIME、GPQA和IFEval上，pass@$k$的恢复路径遵循预算操作点转换规则（BOPTR），$N_{\mathrm{Base}} \approx αN_{\mathrm{RL}}^β$，具有基准条件下的指数。在Qwen2.5-7B上，BOPTR在所测试的非神谕规则中具有最低迁移误差，为3.41 pp（95% CI [2.32, 5.53]）；三种子复制实验结果为3.07 $\pm$ 0.39 pp。该规则扩展到四个家族中的十个模型（拟合后添加的检查点上的误差为3.28至4.87 pp），扩展到四个从未拟合过的基准（拟合误差为5.03 pp vs. 4.44 pp），并且无需目标模型的RL检查点（4.19 pp）或无需任何RL监督（5.08 pp）。这些结果支持一种有限度的内化搜索解读：在所测试的配方下，大部分测量的RL增益对应于基础模型在搜索下已经能够达到的操作点上的采样效率变化。我们将这些缩放模式视为对该配方和群体的描述，报告它们失效的情况，并将UDF和BOPTR作为行为诊断工具，而非参数级等价的证据。

articles.title: What Does an Agentic Software Engineering Benchmark Measure? Profiling Task Demands and Agent Behaviour Beyond What Category Labels Reveal
articles.abstract: Agentic software engineering benchmarks are typically summarized by nominal category labels such as "bug fix" or "feature implementation," yet benchmarks carrying the same label are built through very different curation pipelines. A label thus reveals little about the engineering work a benchmark demands. We introduce the Spread--Novelty--Centrality (SNC) profile, a three-axis characterization of the demands of repository-level coding tasks, grounded in empirical software engineering research. We apply the profile to five widely used benchmarks and 14,922 trajectories of two model families at three scales, and report three findings. (1) A label is an unreliable proxy for task demands, as every pair of benchmarks is statistically separated on at least two SNC axes, and the separations trace back to specific curation decisions. (2) Agent behaviour reveals demands that the human-written gold solution cannot. Agents produce larger solutions than the gold where problem statements withhold hints and smaller ones where curation inflates the gold. How a task is phrased shapes what an agent produces. (3) Task demands correlate with success uniformly, with resolved runs concentrating in the low-SNC region for every family and scale, whereas the behavioural signatures of success are family-specific. Claude succeeds by matching the scope of the gold solution, and its parity share on files rises from $0.17$ at the smallest scale to $0.54$ at the largest. Qwen succeeds by exceeding the gold scope at every scale, and editing too little marks failure for both families.
articles.titleCn: 一个代理式软件工程基准衡量什么？分析任务需求和代理行为，超越类别标签所揭示的内容
articles.abstractCn: 代理式软件工程基准通常通过诸如"错误修复"或"功能实现"的名义类别标签进行总结，然而具有相同标签的基准是通过非常不同的策展流程构建的。因此，标签很少能揭示基准所需的工程工作。我们引入了传播-新颖性-中心性（SNC）配置文件，这是一种基于实证软件工程研究的、对存储库级编码任务需求的三轴表征。我们将该配置文件应用于五个广泛使用的基准以及两个模型家族在三个尺度上的14,922条轨迹，并报告了三个发现。（1）标签是任务需求的不可靠代理，因为每对基准在至少两个SNC轴上都是统计上分离的，而这些分离可追溯到具体的策展决策。（2）代理行为揭示了人类编写的黄金解决方案无法体现的需求。当问题描述隐藏线索时，代理产生的解决方案比黄金方案更大；当策展夸大黄金方案时，代理产生的解决方案更小。任务如何表述决定了代理会产生什么。（3）任务需求与成功普遍相关，已解决的运行在每个家族和尺度上都集中在低SNC区域，而成功的行为特征是家族特定的。Claude通过匹配黄金方案的范围而成功，其在文件上的配对份额从最小尺度的0.17上升到最大尺度的0.54。Qwen通过在所有尺度上超越黄金范围而成功，而对于两个家族来说，编辑过少都标志着失败。

articles.title: Ready to Speak: Aligning LLMs for TTS-Friendly Text Generation
articles.abstract: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) are primarily optimized for written text, often producing outputs that are grammatically correct and helpful yet poorly suited for spoken delivery via Text-to-Speech (TTS). In this work, we study how to make LLMs natively generate TTS-friendly text, which we frame as a preference alignment problem: instead of relying on downstream rewriting modules, we directly align LLMs to generate text optimized for spoken delivery. We introduce two preference datasets spanning different target domains, CORA and Recipe, which contain paired TTS-friendly and TTS-unfriendly responses. We further propose an evaluation suite combining a pattern-based heuristic metric, a TTS$\to$ASR evaluation pipeline, and a MUSHRA listening study with human judges. Our experiments compare the recently proposed Feature-aware Sampling and Tuning (FaST) framework -- leveraging interpretable features instead of a black-box reward model -- against an array of alignment baselines on the TTS-friendly generation task. Notably, we found that FaST achieves the best overall tradeoff between TTS-friendliness and helpfulness across various settings. We also identified a strong correlation between our different metrics, highlighting the ability to reliably assess TTS-friendliness via an efficient heuristic.
articles.titleCn: 准备好发言：为语音合成友好型文本生成而对大型语言模型进行对齐
articles.abstractCn: 当前的大型语言模型（LLMs）主要针对书面文本进行优化，其输出通常在语法正确性和助益性上表现良好，但并不适合通过文本到语音（TTS）进行口语化表达。在本工作中，我们研究了如何使LLMs原生生成适合TTS输出的文本，将其定义为一种偏好对齐问题：我们不再依赖下游重写模块，而是直接对齐LLMs以生成针对口语化表达的优化文本。我们引入了两个跨不同目标领域的偏好数据集，CORA和Recipe，其中包含成对的适合TTS输出和不适合作TTS输出的响应。我们进一步提出了一套评估方案，结合了基于模式的启发式度量、TTS到语音识别（ASR）的评估流程，以及由人类评委参与的主观质量评价（MUSHRA）研究。我们的实验比较了最近提出的特征感知采样与微调（FaST）框架——该框架利用可解释特征而非黑盒奖励模型——与一系列对齐基线在适合TTS输出的生成任务上的表现。值得注意的是，我们发现FaST在各种设置下在适合TTS输出和助益性之间实现了最佳的综合平衡。我们还发现，我们的不同度量之间存在强相关性，这突显了通过高效启发式方法可靠评估适合TTS输出的能力。

articles.title: Post-Training Science for Supervised Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: Every supervised fine-tuning run forces the same chain of decisions, such as learning rate, batch size, LoRA or full fine-tuning, how many epochs, which optimiser, and what data to feed the model. Each of these is typically rediscovered from scratch for every new model and dataset. Here we measure them under one instrument: a sweep that varies one lever at a time, and spans dense and mixture-of-experts models in two families (Qwen3 and Llama), on four real-world customer SFT datasets, for both LoRA and full fine-tuning. These datasets give a controlled testbed: each task carries an evaluation built with the customer, and its training data is produced by iterative supervised fine-tuning that refines model outputs until they pass that evaluation, so the supervised target is internally consistent and the task judge we report against is the criterion the data was built to satisfy. We ask how the optimal learning rate and batch size move with model scale, family, and data, and whether one selection rule transfers across them; what LoRA trades against full fine-tuning, and how its rank and alpha set what the adapter can learn; whether validation loss (or other metrics, such as loss landscape flatness) faithfully ranks downstream quality; whether post-training gains scale with model size and data volume, on a model ladder extended through mixtures-of-experts to 235B parameters; how many epochs to train before general instruction-following erodes; and whether a geometry-aware optimiser improves on AdamW. Each recommendation is paired with a measure of its uncertainty.
articles.titleCn: 训练后科学用于监督微调
articles.abstractCn: 每次有监督微调运行都会强制执行相同的决策链，例如学习率、批处理大小、LoRA或完整微调、训练多少个epoch、使用哪个优化器以及向模型提供什么数据。对于每个新的模型和数据集，这些通常都需要从头开始重新发现。在这里，我们使用一个工具来衡量这些参数：一次只改变一个杠杆的扫描，涵盖了Qwen3和Llama两个家族的密集模型和专家混合模型，在四个真实的客户SFT数据集上进行，包括LoRA和完整微调。这些数据集提供了一个受控的测试平台：每个任务都包含客户构建的评估，其训练数据是通过迭代有监督微调产生的，直到模型输出通过该评估，因此监督目标在内部是一致的，我们报告的任务评判标准是数据构建时需要满足的标准。我们探究最佳学习率和批处理大小如何随模型规模、家族和数据变化，以及一个选择规则是否可以跨它们迁移；LoRA与完整微调之间的权衡是什么，以及它的排名和alpha如何决定适配器可以学习的内容；验证损失（或其他指标，如损失景观平坦度）是否忠实地排序下游质量；训练后收益是否随模型大小和数据量增加而扩展，在一个通过专家混合扩展到2350亿参数的模型阶梯上；在训练多少个epoch后通用指令遵循能力会退化；以及一个几何感知优化器是否优于AdamW。每项建议都配有其不确定性的度量。

articles.title: Towards AI-Assisted Clinical Trial Matching: Practical Considerations, Multicenter Evaluation, and Real-World Deployment
articles.abstract: Clinical trials are essential for advancing cancer care and drug development, but many fail because of insufficient patient enrollment. While there is growing interest in using AI to support patient recruitment, existing systems largely perform eligibility assessment alone and have rarely been evaluated in real-world oncology workflows. Here we present TrialGPT 2.0, an AI-assisted clinical trial recommendation system designed for real-world deployment. Rather than asking only whether a patient may qualify, the system also assesses which trials warrant further consideration given the patient's current clinical needs and local workflow priorities, and provides structured, inspectable explanations for expert review. Importantly, we evaluated TrialGPT 2.0 retrospectively and prospectively across multiple oncology-focused settings, spanning government, academic cancer-center, patient-advocacy, and NIH referral workflows. In retrospective multicenter cohorts comprising 288 cases, TrialGPT 2.0 retrieved at least one clinician-recommended trial in its top 10 recommendations for approximately 91% of cases while reducing clinician screening time by 55.0%. In a six-month prospective evaluation embedded in an active precision oncology tumor board, TrialGPT 2.0 contributed additional trial opportunities missed by the routine workflow, expanding patient access to clinical trial participation by 90.9%. To support scientific reproducibility, we also introduce NIH-TrialBench, a clinician-authored dataset comprising 126 diverse synthetic patient vignettes and matching scenarios from 11 NIH Institutes and Centers. Together, these results support the value of AI to assist clinical trial matching by improving clinician efficiency and identifying frequently overlooked trial opportunities, ultimately helping to expand and accelerate accrual to cancer trials.
articles.titleCn: 面向AI辅助临床试验匹配：实践考量、多中心评估及真实世界部署
articles.abstractCn: 临床试验对于推动癌症治疗和药物研发至关重要，但许多试验因患者入组不足而失败。尽管利用人工智能支持患者招募的兴趣日益浓厚，但现有系统主要仅执行资格评估，且很少在实际肿瘤学工作流程中进行评估。在此，我们介绍了 TrialGPT 2.0，这是一个专为实际部署设计的 AI 辅助临床试验推荐系统。该系统不仅评估患者是否可能符合资格，还会根据患者的当前临床需求和本地工作流程优先级，判断哪些试验值得进一步考虑，并为专家审查提供结构化、可审查的解释。重要的是，我们在多个以肿瘤学为重点的背景下，对 TrialGPT 2.0 进行了回顾性和前瞻性评估，涵盖政府、学术肿瘤中心、患者倡导和 NIH 转诊工作流程。在包含 288 个病例的回顾性多中心队列中，TrialGPT 2.0 在其前 10 项推荐中为约 91% 的病例检索到至少一项临床医生推荐的试验，同时将临床医生筛选时间缩短了 55.0%。在一个嵌入在活跃精准肿瘤学肿瘤委员会的六个月前瞻性评估中，TrialGPT 2.0 补充了常规工作流程遗漏的试验机会，将患者参与临床试验的比例扩展了 90.9%。为支持科学可重复性，我们还引入了 NIH-TrialBench，这是一个由临床医生创建的数据集，包含来自 11 个 NIH 机构中心的 126 个多样化合成患者简述及其匹配场景。这些结果共同支持了人工智能在临床试验匹配中的价值，通过提高临床医生效率并识别经常被忽视的试验机会，最终有助于扩大和加速癌症试验的入组。

articles.title: FinLifeBench: Exhaustive Life-Event History and Financial-State Reconstruction from Longitudinal Banking Dialogue
articles.abstract: Repeated banking interactions require assistants to maintain complete, current, and traceable customer records as life changes emerge incidentally in routine requests. Existing benchmarks emphasize question answering, bounded episodes, or targeted recall rather than exhaustive longitudinal reconstruction. We introduce FinLifeBench, which evaluates two tasks over the same cumulative dialogue: reconstructing every life-event instance with its first-establishing session and reconstructing a complete 34-path financial state at consecutive checkpoints. The benchmark contains 6,000 eight-turn Korean banking sessions from 20 independent synthetic trajectories, with deterministic, exhaustive gold for 24 event types and 34 state paths and consensus quality assurance. Across eleven LLMs under a full-context condition, event-anchor recall falls from 0.591 at 15 sessions to 0.445 at 300. Errors are driven primarily by omitted events rather than poor anchor localization, while financial-state reconstruction frequently treats superseded or potentially outdated information as current; the best GCA@15 reaches 0.470. Performance on the two reconstruction tasks is only weakly associated. These results show that models can localize evidence for recovered events while still failing to maintain complete and temporally valid longitudinal records.
articles.titleCn: FinLifeBench：基于纵向银行对话的详尽人生事件历史与财务状态重建
articles.abstractCn: 频繁的银行业务交互需要助手维护完整、最新且可追溯的客户记录，因为生活中的变化会偶然出现在日常请求中。现有的基准更侧重于问答、有限场景或目标回忆，而非详尽的纵向重建。我们引入了FinLifeBench，它对同一累积对话评估两个任务：重建每个生活事件实例及其首次建立会话，以及重建连续检查点处的完整34路径财务状态。该基准包含来自20个独立合成轨迹的6,000个八轮韩国银行业务会话，具有确定性、详尽的24种事件类型和34种状态路径的黄金标准，并采用共识质量保证。在完整上下文条件下，针对11个LLM，事件锚点召回率从15个会话的0.591降至300个会话的0.445。错误主要由遗漏事件驱动，而非锚点定位不佳，而财务状态重建频繁将已被取代或可能过时的信息视为当前；最佳GCA@15达到0.470。这两个重建任务的性能仅弱相关。这些结果表明，模型虽然能够定位已恢复事件的证据，但仍无法维持完整且时间有效的纵向记录。

articles.title: CaRL-EM: Cost-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Entity Matching with LLMs
articles.abstract: Entity matching (EM) requires fine-grained contextual understanding and domain knowledge. Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can serve as strong matchers across domains, but most methods either make independent pairwise decisions or rely on manually designed composite pipelines, thus lacking flexibility in realistic multi-candidate settings. At the same time, they typically ignore inference cost at scale. We formulate LLM-based EM with candidates as a cost-aware sequential decision problem and propose CaRL-EM, a reinforcement learning controller that manages LLM operations. Given the state of an anchor record, its candidate set, and the cost, CaRL-EM adaptively chooses among different operators (Match/Compare/Select/Decide) and model capacities to maximize a quality-cost objective. The policy interacts with abstract operators, allowing the same controller to be reused with different underlying LLM backends at inference time without retraining. Experiments on 7 benchmarks show that CaRL-EM (i) learns to dynamically plan the usage of inexpensive and expensive operators based on task complexity, (ii) achieves robust zero-shot transfer across diverse datasets and domains, and (iii) consistently achieves a better quality-cost trade-off than strong LLM-based baselines and manually designed pipelines, yielding a lower inference cost at comparable or higher quality.
articles.titleCn: CaRL-EM：基于大型语言模型的成本感知强化学习实体匹配方法
articles.abstractCn: 实体匹配（EM）需要细粒度的上下文理解和领域知识。近期研究表明，大型语言模型（LLM）可以作为跨领域的强匹配器，但大多数方法要么做出独立的成对决策，要么依赖手动设计的复合流程，因此在现实的多候选设置中缺乏灵活性。同时，它们通常忽略了大规模推理成本。我们将基于LLM的EM与候选集问题表述为成本感知的序列决策问题，并提出CaRL-EM，这是一种强化学习控制器，用于管理LLM操作。给定锚记录的状态、其候选集和成本，CaRL-EM自适应地选择不同的操作符（匹配/比较/选择/决定）和模型能力，以最大化质量-成本目标。该策略与抽象操作符交互，允许在推理时使用相同的控制器与不同的底层LLM后端，而无需重新训练。在7个基准测试上的实验表明，CaRL-EM (i) 学会根据任务复杂度动态规划低成本和高成本操作符的使用，(ii) 实现了跨多样化数据集和领域的鲁棒零样本迁移，以及 (iii) 持续实现了比强LLM基线和手动设计流程更好的质量-成本权衡，在可比或更高的质量下产生了更低的推理成本。

articles.title: PersuaRL: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Multi-Expert Selection for Persuasive Dialogue Generation in Insurance
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are revolutionizing digital communication by powering conversational agents deployed across domains such as customer service, digital sales, and insurance. These agents, built on LLMs, can understand user input, retrieve relevant information, and generate coherent responses. However, while they excel at factual communication, they often lack the ability to engage in truly persuasive, context-sensitive dialogue, especially in domains like insurance, where trust and clarity are critical. Building on this need within the insurance domain, our work focuses on improving the persuasiveness of digital agents, aka LLMs. To support this, we introduce InsureDial, a Persuasive Insurance Dialogue dataset, designed to capture the nuances of persuasive communication specific to motor insurance interactions. We introduce PersuaRL, a reinforcement learning-based framework that equips LLM-driven dialogue agents with the ability to adaptively explore, select, and coordinate strategies across multiple expert modules, guided by the evolving dialogue context, to achieve more effective persuasion. We conduct extensive automatic human and qualitative evaluations on two benchmark persuasion dialogue datasets, including our InsureDial. Our evaluations consistently demonstrate that PersuaRL outperforms baseline, generating contextually appropriate and highly persuasive responses.
articles.titleCn: PersuaRL：用于保险领域说服性对话生成的强化学习驱动多专家选择
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正通过赋能客户服务、数字销售和保险等领域的对话代理，革新数字通信。这些基于LLMs构建的代理能够理解用户输入、检索相关信息并生成连贯的回复。然而，尽管它们在事实性沟通方面表现出色，但往往缺乏进行真正具有说服力、上下文敏感对话的能力，尤其是在保险等信任和清晰度至关重要的领域。针对保险领域的这一需求，我们的工作聚焦于提升数字代理（即LLMs）的说服力。为此，我们引入了InsureDial，一个旨在捕捉特定于汽车保险互动的说服性沟通细微之处的保险对话数据集。我们提出了PersuaRL，一个基于强化学习的框架，它使LLM驱动的对话代理能够在不断发展的对话上下文中，自适应地探索、选择和协调多个专家模块的策略，以实现更有效的说服。我们在包括我们的InsureDial在内的两个基准说服性对话数据集上进行了广泛的自动人类和定性评估。我们的评估结果一致表明，PersuaRL优于基线模型，能够生成上下文恰当且极具说服力的回复。

articles.title: LLMPEDIA: Browsing, Verifying, and Comparing the Parametric Encyclopedic Knowledge of LLMs
articles.abstract: Flagship language models appear saturated on benchmarks like MMLU (Hendrycks et al., 2021), scoring above 90% - yet benchmarks test only what the experimenter thought to ask, the availability bias of fixed question sets. LLMPEDIA makes this bias measurable and browsable. We recursively materialized ~1.3M articles from three model families' parametric memory (GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3.3-70B) without retrieval, then audited a stratified sample of atomic claims against Wikipedia and a curated web stack, coloring every claim supported, refuted, or insufficient (Saeed and Razniewski, 2026). On a uniform random sample the true rate is 68.4% - more than 21 pp below MMLU - with 30.5% of claims insufficient: assertions no benchmark probes and the world's largest encyclopedia cannot adjudicate - long-tail knowledge or plausible hallucination, the evidence cannot tell - extending to free text the coverage gap GPTKB established for triples (Hu et al., 2025). The resulting live, open encyclopedia lets visitors inspect this frontier one claim at a time through five one-click views - link-traversal exploration, claim-level factuality, cross-model and political-persona comparison, and a guided topic drill-down - each page, claim, and verdict at a stable URL. LLMPEDIA is live at https://llmpedia.net
articles.titleCn: LLMPEDIA：浏览、验证和比较大型语言模型的参数化知识百科全书
articles.abstractCn: 旗舰语言模型在MMLU等基准测试中表现饱和，得分超过90%——但基准测试仅测试实验者认为需要的内容，存在固定问题集的可得性偏差。LLMPEDIA使这种偏差可衡量和可浏览。我们通过无检索方式递归地从三个模型家族的参数化记忆中（GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3.3-70B）提取了约130万篇文章，然后对原子性声明进行分层抽样审计，对照维基百科和精选网络资源，对支持的、被驳斥的或不足的声明进行标注（Saeed and Razniewski, 2026）。在均匀随机样本中，真实率仅为68.4%——比MMLU低21个百分点以上，其中30.5%的声明不足：这些断言是基准测试未探测到的，连世界最大百科全书也无法裁决——无论是长尾知识还是合理幻觉，证据都无法分辨——这扩展了GPTKB为三元组建立的覆盖差距（Hu et al., 2025）。由此产生的动态开放百科全书允许访客逐条检查这一前沿，通过五种一键视图——链接遍历探索、声明级真实性、跨模型和政治角色比较、以及引导式主题深入——每一页、声明和裁决都有稳定的URL。LLMPEDIA已上线于https://llmpedia.net。

articles.title: Subword Segmental BabyLMs: Learning to Tokenise for Sample-Efficient Pretraining
articles.abstract: In the standard LM training pipeline, subword tokenisation is applied as a preprocessing step. Subword segmental language modelling is an alternative paradigm in which tokenisation is learned during training, allowing the model to discover subword units that optimise its training objective. In this paper, we present our submission to the 2026 BabyLM Challenge, for which we develop two new subword segmental LMs: SubSegGPT and SubSegDeBERTa. SubSegGPT is a decoder-only model that learns tokenisation during autoregressive pretraining. SubSegDeBERTa is an encoder-based model that jointly learns to generate and tokenise masked words. We train both for the Strict and Strict-small tracks. Our top submission to Strict is SubSegDeBERTa, which achieves notable gains in zero-shot evaluation. Our top submission to Strict-small is SubSegGPT, which outperforms tokenisation-based baselines. Our results show that learnable subword tokenisation can improve sample-efficiency for BabyLM pretraining. We analyse the subword learning dynamics of our models and find that tokenisation gradually converges on subword units that balance morphological alignment and fine-grained segmentation.
articles.titleCn: 子词分段BabyLM：学习用于样本高效预训练的标记化
articles.abstractCn: 在标准的语言模型训练流程中，子词分词被用作预处理步骤。子词分段语言模型是一种替代范式，其中分词在训练过程中被学习，使模型能够发现优化其训练目标的子词单元。在本文中，我们提交了2026年BabyLM挑战赛的作品，并开发了两种新的子词分段语言模型：SubSegGPT和SubSegDeBERTa。SubSegGPT是一种仅使用解码器的模型，在自回归预训练过程中学习分词。SubSegDeBERTa是一种基于编码器的模型，联合学习生成和分词掩码词。我们针对Strict和Strict-small赛道进行了训练。我们的Strict赛道的最佳提交是SubSegDeBERTa，在零样本评估中取得了显著提升。我们的Strict-small赛道的最佳提交是SubSegGPT，其性能优于基于分词的基线模型。我们的结果表明，可学习的子词分词可以提高BabyLM预训练的样本效率。我们分析了我们模型的子词学习动态，发现分词逐渐收敛于平衡形态对齐和细粒度分段的子词单元。

articles.title: On the Design Fundamentals of Pixel Text Representation Learning
articles.abstract: Text-rich visual inputs require models that can read, retrieve, and compress language directly in pixel space, yet existing pixel-text encoders struggle with fixed resolution pretraining, visual shortcut learning, weak visual grounding, and multilingual visual text understanding. In this work, we investigate the fundamental design principles required for robust visual text representation learning. Through systematic controlled ablations, we identify four critical components: variable image resolutions and rendered font sizes provide spatial proxies for high-resolution document generalization; natural image-text pairs are indispensable for grounding and prevent text-only collapse; layout-aware rendering helps prevent pixel-level shortcuts; and a two-stage multilingual curriculum enables effective cross-lingual alignment. By integrating these principles into a scalable training recipe, we train Pixel Linguist II, a native-resolution vision encoder trained with on-the-fly rendering, unified contrastive grounding, and a multilingual curriculum over 280M training examples. Pixel Linguist II sets new state-of-the-art results on English, cross-lingual, and multilingual Visual STS and ViDoRe, while also enabling better MLLM downstream evaluation. Notably, Pixel Linguist II remains robust under 80\% visual token compression, showing great promise for optical context compression. Our code and resources are available at https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II.
articles.titleCn: 像素文本表示学习的设计基础
articles.abstractCn: 文本丰富的视觉输入需要能够直接在像素空间中读取、检索和压缩语言的模型，然而现有的像素-文本编码器在固定分辨率预训练、视觉捷径学习、弱视觉基础和多语言视觉文本理解方面存在困难。在这项工作中，我们研究了实现鲁棒视觉文本表示学习所需的基本设计原则。通过系统的控制消融实验，我们确定了四个关键组件：可变图像分辨率和渲染字体大小为高分辨率文档泛化提供了空间代理；自然图像-文本对对于基础至关重要，可防止仅文本的崩溃；布局感知渲染有助于防止像素级捷径；两阶段多语言课程能够实现有效的跨语言对齐。通过将这些原则整合到可扩展的训练配方中，我们训练了 Pixel Linguist II，这是一个原生分辨率视觉编码器，通过即时渲染、统一对比基础和多语言课程（超过 2.8 亿个训练样本）进行训练。Pixel Linguist II 在英语、跨语言和多语言视觉 STS 和 ViDoRe 上取得了新的最先进结果，同时还实现了更好的 MLLM 下游评估。值得注意的是，Pixel Linguist II 在 80% 的视觉标记压缩下仍然保持鲁棒性，显示出在光学上下文压缩方面的巨大潜力。我们的代码和资源可在 https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II 获取。

articles.title: Does task decomposition improve automatic NLG evaluation?
articles.abstract: The LLM-as-a-judge (LLMaJ) framework has emerged as a promising solution for cheap, reproducible, reference-free Natural Language Generation (NLG) evaluation. Prior work seeks to improve LLMaJ by decomposing evaluation tasks into simpler sub-tasks. In this work, we systematically compare LLMaJ methods with and without decomposition on multiple NLG datasets. We find no evidence that LLMaJ with task decomposition leads to performance gains over a fair baseline that does not use decomposition. Instead, we find that previously reported performance gains in decomposition-based LLMaJ stem from using human labels as training data, and not task decomposition itself. Also, we find that, when human labels are available, LLMaJ without using task decomposition can perform comparably to human annotators.
articles.titleCn: 任务分解是否提高了自动NLG评估？
articles.abstractCn: LLM作为裁判（LLMaJ）框架已成为一种有前景的解决方案，用于低成本、可重复、无需参考的自然语言生成（NLG）评估。先前工作试图通过将评估任务分解为更简单的子任务来改进LLMaJ。在这项工作中，我们在多个NLG数据集上系统地比较了使用和不使用分解的LLMaJ方法。我们发现没有证据表明使用任务分解的LLMaJ在公平的、不使用分解的基线之上带来了性能提升。相反，我们发现先前报道的基于分解的LLMaJ性能提升源于使用人类标签作为训练数据，而非任务分解本身。此外，我们发现当人类标签可用时，不使用任务分解的LLMaJ可以与人类标注员表现相当。

articles.title: Overfitting Mitigation via Singular Value Decomposition in Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
articles.abstract: Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding enables high-quality text generation by selecting the hypothesis that maximizes a utility metric over sampled pseudo-references. However, it is highly susceptible to metric overfitting: it can irregularly inflate the chosen utility metric at the direct expense of other unoptimized evaluation metrics. To mitigate this, we introduce SVD-MBR, which frames the pairwise utility matrix as a noisy information signal. By computing a low-rank approximation via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and retaining only the top-$k$ components, we effectively decouple true consensus from metric noise. Experiments demonstrate that SVD-MBR successfully regularizes decoding, yielding substantial gains across a range of generalized metrics. Furthermore, we reveal that this denoising is metric-dependent: neural metrics encode a robust low-rank consensus ideal for SVD, whereas surface-level metrics struggle to separate signal from metric noise.
articles.titleCn: 通过奇异值分解在最小贝叶斯风险解码中缓解过拟合
articles.abstractCn: 最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）解码通过在采样伪参考上选择最大化效用指标的假设来生成高质量文本。然而，它极易受到指标过拟合的影响：在直接牺牲其他未优化的评估指标的情况下，不规则地抬高所选效用指标。为缓解这一问题，我们引入了SVD-MBR，将成对效用矩阵构建为含噪声的信息信号。通过采用奇异值分解（SVD）计算低秩近似并仅保留前k个分量，我们有效地将真实共识与指标噪声解耦。实验表明，SVD-MBR成功规范了解码过程，在多种泛化指标上均取得显著提升。此外，我们揭示了这种去噪过程与指标相关：神经指标编码了适合SVD的鲁棒低秩共识，而表层指标则难以区分信号与指标噪声。

articles.title: Latent Recurrent Thoughts: Recurrent Refinement of Proposed Latents for Reasoning with Frozen LLMs
articles.abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning unfolds in discrete token space: each step is committed as text, errors propagate, and eliciting good traces presupposes traces to imitate. Reasoning instead in a model's continuous representation space - where intermediate states are vectors rather than words - sidesteps these constraints, but leaves open how those latent states should be computed. We approach this along two axes. First, we keep a large language model (LLM) frozen and use it for what it is already good at - modeling and decoding sequences - while a small auxiliary network supplies continuous latent thoughts as input. Second, we produce those latents by recurrence: a tiny recurrent reasoner refines them over many steps, decoupling the depth of computation from the size of the model, so that the latents are a product of iterative processing rather than a single forward pass. We instantiate this as Latent Recurrent Thoughts (LRT): a task-dedicated proposer supplies base latents, a recurrent reasoner refines them through bounded residual corrections, and the frozen LLM decodes the answer. On symbolic reasoning with answer supervision but no reasoning traces (Countdown-4, Sudoku) and on natural-language reasoning (HumanEval, MBPP, StrategyQA), LRT substantially outperforms prior frozen-decoder continuous-space reasoning methods under an identical decoder, prompt, data, and training budget, and outperforms non-thinking-mode chain-of-thought prompting on the same backbone at a small fraction of its inference compute.
articles.titleCn: 潜在循环思维：针对冻结式大型语言模型的推理，对所提潜在变量进行循环优化
articles.abstractCn: 思维链推理在离散的标记空间中展开：每一步都作为文本提交，错误会传播，而要获得良好的推理轨迹，就必须先有可模仿的轨迹。相反，在模型的连续表示空间中进行推理——其中中间状态是向量而非单词——可以避开这些限制，但留下了如何计算这些潜在状态的问题。我们沿两个维度来解决这个问题。首先，我们冻结一个大型语言模型（LLM），利用它擅长的事情——建模和解码序列——同时一个小型辅助网络提供连续的潜在思维作为输入。其次，我们通过递归产生这些潜在状态：一个微小的循环推理器在许多步骤中逐步完善它们，将计算的深度与模型的大小解耦，使得这些潜在状态是迭代处理的结果而非单次前向传播的产物。我们将这种方法实例化为潜在循环思维（LRT）：一个任务专用的提议者提供基础潜在状态，一个循环推理器通过有界的残差修正来完善它们，而冻结的LLM负责解码答案。在需要符号推理但无推理轨迹（如Countdown-4、数独）以及自然语言推理（如HumanEval、MBPP、StrategyQA）任务上，LRT在相同的解码器、提示、数据和训练预算下，显著优于先前的冻结解码器连续空间推理方法，并且在相同的模型骨架上，只需其推理计算的一小部分，就优于非思考模式的思维链提示。

articles.title: EDRAC: Benchmarking Arabic Dialect Reading Comprehension
articles.abstract: Dialectal Arabic (DA) remains under-resourced compared to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), particularly for machine reading comprehension (MRC) and question answering (QA). Existing Arabic QA benchmarks primarily focus on formal written MSA or multiple-choice QA, with limited coverage of naturally spoken dialects. Here, we aim to bridge this gap. We introduce EDRAC, the first large-scale benchmark for dialectal Arabic machine reading comprehension (MRC) and generative QA, covering five major dialects: Egyptian, Moroccan, Emirati, Syrian, and Saudi Arabic. EDRAC contains 499 passages derived from naturally occurring spoken interactions and 4,977 corresponding QA pairs generated through a human--LLM collaborative pipeline combining iterative generation, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human verification. We benchmark Arabic-centric and multilingual LLMs on EDRAC using lexical and semantic metrics. Our results reveal substantial gaps between semantic answer quality and dialectal fidelity, highlighting the limitations of existing evaluation metrics for dialectal Arabic generation. EDRAC provides a realistic and challenging MRC benchmark for future research on dialectal Arabic NLP.
articles.titleCn: EDRAC：阿拉伯方言阅读理解基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 与现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）相比，方言阿拉伯语（DA）在资源方面仍然不足，尤其是在机器阅读理解（MRC）和问答（QA）方面。现有的阿拉伯语QA基准主要关注正式书面的MSA或选择题QA，对自然口语方言的覆盖有限。在此，我们旨在填补这一空白。我们介绍了EDRAC，这是首个大规模方言阿拉伯语机器阅读理解（MRC）和生成式QA基准，涵盖五种主要方言：埃及语、摩洛哥语、阿联酋语、叙利亚语和沙特阿拉伯语。EDRAC包含499段从自然口语交互中提取的文本以及4,977对相应的QA对，这些QA对通过人-大语言模型（LLM）协作流程生成，该流程结合了迭代生成、LLM作为评判者评估和人工验证。我们在EDRAC上使用词汇和语义指标对以阿拉伯语为中心和多语言的LLM进行基准测试。我们的结果表明，语义答案质量与方言保真度之间存在巨大差距，突出了现有方言阿拉伯语生成评估指标的限制。EDRAC为未来方言阿拉伯语NLP研究提供了一个真实且具有挑战性的MRC基准。

articles.title: ClinTraceBench: Source-Verifiable Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning over EHR-Derived Dialogues
articles.abstract: Clinical LLM assistants must reason over multi-visit patient trajectories, yet whether the compact history representations used to scale them---retrieval, structured timelines, LLM summaries, agentic memory---preserve the longitudinal signal clinical reasoning needs has not been measured. We introduce ClinTraceBench: 385 MIMIC-IV-derived verified dialogues with event-ID provenance, a nine-task taxonomy (T1--T9), and L0--L4 deterministic + L5 human-audit validation (98.92\% agreement). We evaluate eight history representation strategies---a no-context floor, \textit{last-visit-only}, \textit{full-context}, BGE-M3 \textit{dense-retrieval}, two compression schemes, and two agentic-memory systems (\textit{Mem0}, \textit{A-Mem})---across four backbones (DeepSeek-V3, GPT-4o-mini, Haiku~4.5, Sonnet~4.6) on 6{,}271 questions: 32 cells, 200{,}672 predictions. Four findings: (SP4) a controlled T3 injection probe isolates compression-induced \textit{relation} loss---with the attribution sentence present \textit{before} construction, \textit{Mem0}, \textit{A-Mem} and \textit{llm-summary} still recover only 0--5.3\% of the injected positives; (SP1) compressed strategies pay an aggregation tax on multi-visit trends and cross-patient comparisons; (SP2) the blind-to-full gap spans $+29.8$~pp (GPT-4o-mini) to $+62.7$~pp (Haiku); (SP3) abstention scales non-monotonically with context length. On the Pareto frontier Haiku dominates Sonnet under \textit{full-context} (\$25.76 vs.\ \$106.21), inverting the ``biggest backbone wins'' heuristic.
articles.titleCn: ClinTraceBench：基于电子病历衍生对话的可溯源纵向临床推理
articles.abstractCn: 临床LLM助手必须对多就诊患者轨迹进行推理，然而用于扩展它们的紧凑历史表示（检索、结构化时间线、LLM摘要、智能体记忆）是否保留了临床推理所需的纵向信号尚未得到测量。我们介绍了ClinTraceBench：包含385个MIMIC-IV衍生验证对话及事件ID来源的基准，一个包含九个任务的分类体系（T1--T9），以及L0--L4确定性+L5人工审核验证（98.92%一致性）。我们在四种主干网络（DeepSeek-V3、GPT-4o-mini、Haiku~4.5、Sonnet~4.6）上对6,271个问题（32个单元、200,672个预测）评估了八种历史表示策略：无上下文基准、仅最后一次就诊、完整上下文、BGE-M3密集检索、两种压缩方案、两种智能体记忆系统（Mem0、A-Mem）。四个发现：SP4：受控的T3注射探测隔离了压缩引起的关联损失——当归因句子在构建前存在时，Mem0、A-Mem和llm-summary仍仅恢复0--5.3%的注入阳性结果；SP1：压缩策略在多就诊趋势和跨患者比较上支付了聚合代价；SP2：盲全差距跨度从+29.8%（GPT-4o-mini）到+62.7%（Haiku）；SP3：拒绝回答随上下文长度非单调增长。在帕累托前沿下，Haiku在完整上下文下优于Sonnet（\$25.76 vs. \$106.21），颠覆了“最大主干网络获胜”的启发式原则。

articles.title: Hints Help But Do They Teach? Evaluating Skills Transfer in Code Generation
articles.abstract: When a hint turns a failing generated program into a passing one, does it provide missing information or merely steer the model toward a solution it could already produce? We test these hypotheses on HumanEval+ and MBPP+ using executable evaluation. For Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, adaptive relevant hints rescue 36 of 79 selected failures; an unrelated hint rescues 19, while eight unhinted samples solve 46 and recover 31 of the 36 relevant-hint rescues. Phi-3.5-mini shows the same pattern: relevant hints rescue 42 of 101 failures, an unrelated hint rescues 17, and unhinted sampling solves 57, including 36 of the 42 relevant-hint rescues. Because the hint conditions use different attempt budgets, these comparisons do not isolate a purely semantic effect. Mechanistic tests on Qwen identify a stable activation direction shared by relevant and unrelated hints. Persistently adding this direction yields 14 rescues and 18 regressions, with no detectable net accuracy gain; learned low-rank interventions have a positive but imprecise estimated effect. Full textual specifications solve 22 of 24 context-defined problems, versus 5-11 for tested virtual-KV prefixes. Post-generation hidden-state probes transfer across benchmarks, with pooled AUROC 0.806 and 0.780, but their top-one selection advantage over token confidence is statistically unresolved. Overall, relevant hints can rescue failures, but most rescued solutions are already reachable through ordinary sampling, and the internal interventions tested here do not establish task-general capability transfer.
articles.titleCn: 提示有帮助，但它们能教学吗？评估代码生成中的技能迁移
articles.abstractCn: 当一个提示将一个失败的生成程序转变为通过程序时，它是提供了缺失信息，还是仅仅引导模型走向它原本就能产生的解决方案？我们使用可执行评估在HumanEval+和MBPP+上测试这些假设。对于Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，自适应的相关提示挽救了79个选定失败中的36个；无关提示挽救了19个，而8个未提示样本解决了46个，并恢复了36个相关提示挽救中的31个。Phi-3.5-mini显示出相同的模式：相关提示挽救了101个失败中的42个，无关提示挽救了17个，未提示采样解决了57个，包括42个相关提示挽救中的36个。由于提示条件使用不同的尝试预算，这些比较并不能分离出纯粹语义效应。对Qwen的机制测试识别出相关和无关提示共享的稳定激活方向。持续添加这个方向产生了14个挽救和18个退化，没有检测到可感知的净准确度提升；学习的低秩干预具有正面但估计不精确的效果。完整的文本规范解决了24个上下文定义问题中的22个，而测试的虚拟-KV前缀仅解决了5-11个。生成后的隐藏状态探针跨基准迁移，合并AUROC为0.806和0.780，但它们在单选优势上与token置信度相比在统计上未解决。总体而言，相关提示可以挽救失败，但大多数挽救的解决方案可以通过普通采样到达，而这里测试的内部干预并未建立任务泛化能力迁移。

articles.title: When Modality Gap Reduction Fails: Prediction-Level Hubness in CLIP
articles.abstract: Reducing the modality gap between image and text representations in CLIP is widely expected to improve cross-modal alignment and downstream performance. However, a smaller average image-text gap does not necessarily lead to consistent accuracy gains. We analyze this mismatch from the perspective of the decision structure in zero-shot classification, i.e. selecting the most similar class-text prototype for an input image. Zero-shot accuracy depends not only on average image--text alignment, but also on class-wise decision margins. Using Linear correction as an analytically tractable case, we show that modality gap correction can alter the relative decision structure among classes and cause predictions to concentrate on a small subset of classes. We refer to this output-space failure mode as prediction-level hubness. Furthermore, experiments across multiple datasets show that accuracy degradation under gap correction is consistently associated with increased prediction concentration, both for Linear correction and for learning-based correction methods. This provides a systematic explanation of why modality gap reduction does not consistently improve CLIP zero-shot accuracy from the perspective of downstream decision structure. Our results suggest that gap correction should be evaluated not only by average alignment, but also by its impact on downstream prediction structure.
articles.titleCn: 当模态差距缩小失败时：CLIP中的预测级中心性
articles.abstractCn: 在CLIP中减少图像和文本表征之间的模态差距被广泛预期将提高跨模态对齐和下游性能。然而，更小的平均图像-文本差距并不一定会带来一致的准确率提升。我们从零样本分类中的决策结构角度分析了这种不匹配，即选择与输入图像最相似的类-文本原型。零样本准确率不仅取决于平均图像-文本对齐，还取决于类别的决策边界。以线性校正作为一个解析上易于处理的情况，我们表明模态差距校正可以改变类别之间的相对决策结构，并导致预测集中于一小部分类别。我们将这种输出空间失效模式称为预测级中心性。此外，跨多个数据集的实验表明，在差距校正下准确率的下降始终与预测集中度的增加相关，无论是对于线性校正还是基于学习的校正方法。这为从下游决策结构的角度解释为什么模态差距减少并不总是提高CLIP零样本准确率提供了系统性的解释。我们的结果表明，差距校正不仅应通过平均对齐来评估，还应通过其对下游预测结构的影响来评估。

articles.title: Beyond Magnitude: Contrastive Routing for Modular Mixture-of-Experts
articles.abstract: In current Mixture-of-Experts architectures, routing is performed based on representations dominated by structure shared across all tokens, limiting expert specialization. We show that contrasting each token against an Exponential Moving Average of the layer's hidden states, rather than routing on absolute magnitude, concentrates the routing signal onto a low-dimensional, highly separable subspace. Building on this, we propose the Contrastive Routing Mechanism (CoRM), which scores each expert by the gap between its affinity for the incoming token and its affinity for this shared reference state, interpreted through a distinct per-expert projection. The resulting experts have routing boundaries that align with linguistic structure significantly more than the Top-k baseline. Our experiments show that CoRM improves average zero-shot accuracy by +0.67 to +1.69 points (Top-1) and +1.38 to +1.77 points (Top-2) over standard Top-k MoE baselines on nine zero-shot reasoning benchmarks, at the minimal cost of 2.9% added parameters and 2.6% added FLOPs per token.
articles.titleCn: 超越规模：模块化专家混合的对比路由
articles.abstractCn: 在当前的专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts）架构中，路由操作基于所有标记共享的结构主导的表示进行，这限制了专家的专业化。我们证明，通过与层的隐藏状态的指数移动平均值进行对比，而不是基于绝对值进行路由，可以将路由信号集中到一个低维、高度可分离的子空间上。基于此，我们提出了对比路由机制（Contrastive Routing Mechanism，CoRM），该机制通过每个专家对其对输入标记的亲和度与其对该共享参考状态的亲和度之间的差距进行评分，并通过每个专家的独特投影进行解释。最终得到的专家的路由边界与语言结构比Top-k基线显著对齐。我们的实验表明，CoRM在九个零样本推理基准上，相较于标准的Top-k MoE基线，平均零样本准确率提高了+0.67至+1.69分（Top-1）和+1.38至+1.77分（Top-2），仅在参数上增加了2.9%，每标记的FLOPs增加了2.6%。

articles.title: StateSwap: Probing Support-Elimination Hidden States in Multiple-Choice Questions
articles.abstract: Large language models often answer the same multiple-choice question inconsistently when it is posed under support-oriented and elimination-oriented framings. We investigate whether these discrepancies arise from different internal representations induced by the two framings. We introduce a dual-framing protocol with minimally varied prompts that use either support- or elimination-oriented framing while keeping the evaluation target fixed. To probe the internal computation, we append an untrained special token, [STATE], and treat its residual-stream activation as an intervention interface. Across both models, the two framings induce separable [STATE] activations concentrated in intermediate layers. Swapping these activations between paired prompts systematically changes predictions and improves cross-framing agreement, providing intervention-based evidence that the activations are behaviorally relevant. Beyond instance-level substitution, mean-difference steering directions derived from the dual-framing contrast exhibit more bounded layer-wise responses than matched contrastive activation addition directions under the evaluated protocol.
articles.titleCn: StateSwap：探测选择题中支持消除隐藏状态
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在采用支持导向和排除导向两种框架提问相同的多项选择题时，往往给出不一致的答案。我们研究了这些差异是否源于两种框架诱导的不同内部表征。我们引入了一种双框架协议，该协议使用最小差异的提示，提示中采用支持导向或排除导向框架，同时保持评估目标不变。为了探究内部计算过程，我们在提示中附加了一个未训练的特殊标记[STATE]，并将其残差流激活视为干预接口。在两个模型中，两种框架诱导了可分离的[STATE]激活，这些激活集中在中间层。通过在配对提示之间交换这些激活，可以系统地改变预测并提高跨框架一致性，从而提供了基于干预的证据，证明这些激活在行为上具有相关性。除了实例级别的替换之外，双框架对比中推导出的均值差异引导方向，在评估协议下表现出比匹配对比激活相加方向更受约束的逐层响应。

articles.title: Post-hoc Alignment of LLM-judges to Human Judgment Distribution
articles.abstract: The LLM-as-a-judge (LLMaJ) framework offers a cost-effective and reproducible solution for automatic evaluation. However, current evaluation practices typically compare LLMaJ judgments against aggregated ground-truth labels, overlooking the valuable information contained in Human Label Variation (HLV). Inspired by an increasing line of work that proposes to leverage HLV, we systematically study LLMaJ performance on predicting both a single, aggregated ground truth hard-label and unaggregated soft-labels that represent Human Judgment Distributions (HJD). Our results across five diverse datasets reveal that while LLMs achieve near human-level performance at hard-label prediction on most tasks, they exhibit poor performance when predicting soft-labels. To address this limitation, we propose NAPHA (eNtropy-Aware Post-Hoc Alignment), a simple yet effective lightweight post-hoc alignment method that matches the LLM distribution to the HJD by first assigning an instance to a discrete entropy class and then routing it to specialized, trained alignment models. We find that NAPHA consistently improves soft-labels prediction across base LLM models and datasets, with particularly strong gains on high-entropy instances where capturing diverse human perspectives is most critical. We also show via oracle experiments that improving entropy class prediction can substantially enhance NAPHA's practical effectiveness.
articles.titleCn: 对LLM裁判进行事后与人类判断分布的校准
articles.abstractCn: LLMaJ（大型语言模型作为裁判）框架为自动评估提供了一种经济高效且可重复的解决方案。然而，当前的评估实践通常将LLMaJ的判断与聚合的真相标签进行比较，忽略了人类标签变异（HLV）中包含的宝贵信息。受越来越多研究提出利用HLV的启发，我们系统地研究了LLMaJ在预测单一聚合真相硬标签以及代表人类判断分布（HJD）的非聚合软标签方面的性能。我们在五个不同数据集上的结果表明，虽然LLM在大多数任务上的硬标签预测中达到了接近人类水平的性能，但在预测软标签时表现不佳。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了NAPHA（熵感知后处理对齐），这是一种简单而有效的轻量级后处理对齐方法，通过首先将实例分配到离散熵类，然后将其路由到专门训练的对齐模型，以匹配LLM分布与HJD。我们发现NAPHA在基础LLM模型和数据集上始终能显著提升软标签预测性能，特别是在高熵实例上，这些实例在捕捉多样化人类观点时最为关键，取得了显著提升。我们还通过神谕实验表明，提高熵类预测能力可以大幅增强NAPHA的实际有效性。

articles.title: OUTLETS: Output-Length Prediction from Speculative Decoding Backbones
articles.abstract: The heavy-tailed distribution of output lengths in Large Language Model (LLM) serving poses major challenges for resource provisioning and cluster scheduling. Although output-length prediction can mitigate these issues, existing approaches have key drawbacks: external proxy models add substantial latency and often have limited fidelity, whereas internal state-based methods are efficient but rely on shallow probes of current model states. We identify a structural connection between speculative decoding (SD) and length prediction: latent representations produced by the draft decoder in advanced frameworks (e.g., EAGLE-3) encode signals that are predictive of generation length. Building on this insight, we introduce OUTLETS (Output-Length Prediction from Speculative Decoding Backbones), which repurposes the speculative backbone as a trajectory-aware length predictor. When its draft representations are already computed for speculative decoding, OUTLETS adds only a lightweight regression head and achieves lower MAE than the evaluated methods. Under saturated disaggregated serving, OUTLETS predictions enable standard scheduling policies to prioritize shorter requests and distribute requests more evenly across decoding instances, reducing short-request P99 latency by 34.8%.
articles.titleCn: 输出长度预测：源自推测解码主干网络的输出长度预测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）服务中输出长度的重尾分布对资源分配和集群调度构成了重大挑战。尽管输出长度预测可以缓解这些问题，现有方法存在关键缺陷：外部代理模型会增加显著延迟且通常精度有限，而基于内部状态的内部方法虽然高效，但依赖于对当前模型状态的浅层探测。我们识别了推测解码（SD）与长度预测之间的结构联系：先进框架（例如EAGLE-3）中草稿解码器产生的潜在表示编码了可预测生成长度的信号。基于这一见解，我们引入了OUTLETS（基于推测解码主干输出的长度预测），将推测主干重新定义为具有轨迹感知能力的长度预测器。当草稿表示已为推测解码计算完毕时，OUTLETS仅添加一个轻量级回归头，并实现了低于评估方法的MAE。在饱和解耦服务下，OUTLETS的预测使标准调度策略能够优先处理较短的请求，并将请求更均匀地分配到解码实例中，将短请求P99延迟降低了34.8%。

articles.title: WorldBench: Culturally Grounded Benchmark for Multilingual Agents
articles.abstract: Despite the growing use of LLM-powered agents to solve multi-step tasks in complex environments, existing benchmarks rarely test state preservation, performance across languages, and application to realistic, grounded scenarios. To address these concerns, we present WorldBench: a comprehensive, multilingual benchmark of genuine, persona-grounded everyday workflows, where agents can act in a sandbox via structured actions. WorldBench comprises 1,600 tasks across seven languages and eight cultures, filtered and refined through feedback from human annotators with language- and culture-specific expertise. For evaluation, we extend metrics from previous works and introduce Constrained Task Success (CTS), which combines natural language instructions and testbeds to score task completion, minimal modification, and other complementary metrics through deterministic and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations. Our experiments show that frontier models reach only 49.2% CTS, with all models demonstrating large gaps between correctness and environment preservation. We thereby show that current agents remain brittle in multilingual, agentic scenarios, especially for long-horizon tasks and under state-preservation constraints
articles.titleCn: WorldBench：面向多语言智能体的文化基础评测基准
articles.abstractCn: 尽管基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体越来越多地用于解决复杂环境中的多步任务，但现有的基准测试很少测试状态保持、跨语言性能以及在实际、有根基场景中的应用。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了WorldBench：一个全面的、多语言的基准测试，包含真实的、以角色为根基的日常工作流程，智能体可以通过结构化动作在一个沙盒中行动。WorldBench包含1600个跨七种语言和八种文化的任务，这些任务经过具有特定语言和文化专业知识的标注人员提供的反馈进行筛选和细化。在评估方面，我们扩展了先前工作的指标，并引入了约束任务成功（CTS），它结合自然语言指令和测试平台，通过确定性评估和将LLM作为裁判的评估来评分任务完成、最小修改和其他补充指标。我们的实验表明，前沿模型的CTS得分仅为49.2%，所有模型在正确性和环境保持之间都存在巨大差距。因此，我们证明了当前的智能体在多语言、代理场景中仍然脆弱，尤其是在长时程任务和状态保持约束下。

articles.title: Lagged Coupling: Internal Representations Become Readable Before They Become Causal
articles.abstract: Across the full Pythia suite (160M-12B, eight checkpoints, four task families), a linear probe can read a target variable from the residual stream as early as step 1,000 at every scale -- yet steering along that same reading direction remains null-equivalent in 43 of 48 model-checkpoint cells. Internal readability systematically outruns causal efficacy, and the lag does not shrink with scale. We call this structure lagged coupling and decompose it into three dissociable tracks: (i) internal readability, saturated (AUROC >= 0.990) from the first checkpoint everywhere; (ii) behavioral readability, which develops gradually and progressively later at larger scales (12B reaches 0.909 only at the final checkpoint); (iii) causal efficacy, almost always null-equivalent, occasionally counterproductive early, with one isolated positive pulse (12B, step 8,000, z = +2.49) our grid cannot resolve. The ordering is dominantly read-before-write (11/11 units, no inversion). Representation headroom along the probe direction grows up to 57x with training and scale while causal write-in stays below 0.11% of headroom -- the variable is increasingly written into the representation and increasingly ignored by the readout. Under a fully pre-registered protocol, both single-onset hypotheses resolve INDETERMINATE (scale slope +0.24, 95% CI [-0.60, +0.87]; time vote 3:3) -- a disciplined negative explained by the three-track decomposition. A pre-registered OLMo-2 replication preserves the direction at attenuated magnitude. Our results caution against inferring steerability from probe accuracy and establish a developmental bottleneck: representation formation reliably outpaces causal readout consolidation.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Pre-registered developmental interpretability study on the full Pythia suite with an OLMo-2 replication
articles.titleCn: 滞后耦合：内部表征在被赋予因果性之前变得可读
articles.abstractCn: 在整个Pythia套件（160M-12B，八个检查点，四个任务族）中，线性探针最早在步骤1000时就能从残差流中读取目标变量，但在所有尺度上，沿着同一读取方向的引导在48个模型检查点单元中的43个上保持无效等价。内部可读性系统地超过因果效能，且滞后时间不随规模缩小。我们将这种结构称为滞后耦合，并将其分解为三个可分离的路径：(i) 内部可读性，从第一个检查点开始处处饱和（AUROC >= 0.990）；(ii) 行为可读性，逐渐发展并在更大规模上更晚完成（12B仅在最终检查点达到0.909）；(iii) 因果效能，几乎总是无效等价，早期偶尔具有反作用，有一个孤立的正向脉冲（12B，步骤8000，z = +2.49）是我们网格无法解析的。顺序主要是先读后写（11/11单元，无反转）。沿着探针方向的表征空间随着训练和规模增长高达57倍，而因果写入始终保持在表征空间的0.11%以下——变量被越来越多地写入表征，同时被读取操作越来越忽视。在完全预先注册的协议下，单触发假设均解析为INDETERMINATE（规模斜率+0.24，95% CI [-0.60, +0.87]；时间投票3:3），这一严谨的负结果可由三路径分解解释。预先注册的OLMo-2复现保留了方向但幅度减弱。我们的结果表明，不应从探针精度推断引导能力，并确立了发展瓶颈：表征形成可靠地快于因果读取巩固。

articles.title: PCoMoE: Shifting MoE Inference from Monolithic Expert Selection to Fine-Grained Path Composition
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale Large Language Model (LLM) capacity efficiently by activating a sparse subset of experts per token. However, modern MoE inference remains heavily constrained by the rigid, whole-expert abstraction. Existing frameworks manage, schedule, or prune experts as atomic execution units, which fixes the optimization boundary too early and leaves fine-grained intra-expert computational redundancy underexplored. In this work, we present PCoMoE, a path-compositional execution framework that shifts MoE inference from coarse-grained expert selection to fine-grained path composition. PCoMoE incorporates a path-level formulation of expert computation, a compatibility-aware layer-wise pruning strategy to suppress low-value path combinations, and a hardware-friendly execution engine to exploit reusable sub-expert structures under strictly bounded overheads. Experimental results demonstrate that PCoMoE achieves up to a 1.31x end-to-end inference speedup while enhancing model accuracy by 10%. The code is available at https://github.com/gzyyy0/PCoMoE
articles.titleCn: PCoMoE：将MoE推理从整体专家选择转移到细粒度路径组合
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）架构通过为每个标记激活稀疏的专家子集，有效地扩展了大型语言模型（LLM）的容量。然而，现代MoE推理仍然受到僵化、整体专家抽象的严重限制。现有框架将专家作为原子执行单元进行管理、调度或剪枝，这过早地固定了优化边界，并且未能充分探索专家内部的细粒度计算冗余。在这项工作中，我们提出了PCoMoE，一个路径组合执行框架，将MoE推理从粗粒度的专家选择转移到细粒度的路径组合。PCoMoE结合了专家计算的路径级公式、一种兼容性感知的逐层剪枝策略来抑制低价值路径组合，以及一个硬件友好的执行引擎来在严格限制的开销下利用可重用的子专家结构。实验结果表明，PCoMoE实现了高达1.31倍的端到端推理速度提升，同时将模型精度提高了10%。代码可在https://github.com/gzyyy0/PCoMoE获取。

articles.title: Phrase-Localized Language-Contrastive Guidance: Training-Free Localized Accent Control for Code-Switching Text-to-Speech
articles.abstract: Current speech synthesis struggles with code-switching, which mixes a foreign language phrase into a primary language utterance, causing the phrase to be spoken with the primary language's accent rather than its native one. We propose Phrase-Localized Language-Contrastive Guidance (LCG), a training-free inference framework that restores a native accent to code-switched phrases in cross-lingual text-to-speech. LCG replaces the single language guidance applied across the whole utterance with a separate guidance for each region, so each part is guided by its own language. To choose where to apply this localized guidance, we propose a self-attention probing technique that finds the phrase boundaries without external alignments. Together, these components generate speech in which each region carries the accent of its own language, requiring no fine-tuning or auxiliary models. Across diverse language pairs, LCG robustly increases the nativeness of the code-switched phrase while suppressing accent leakage, and preserving overall speaker identity and naturalness.
articles.titleCn: 短语定位语言对比引导：针对代码转换文本语音的无监督本地化口音控制
articles.abstractCn: 当前的语音合成技术在处理代码转换（即在一个主要语言的语句中混合外语短语）时存在困难，导致这些短语被用主要语言的口音而非其母语口音来朗读。我们提出了短语局部语言对比引导（LCG），这是一个无需训练的推理框架，用于在跨语言文本到语音合成中恢复代码转换短语的母语口音。LCG用针对每个区域的独立引导替代了在整个语句中应用的单语言引导，使每个部分都由其自身的语言进行引导。为了选择应用这种局部引导的位置，我们提出了一种自注意力探测技术，该技术能够在无需外部对齐的情况下找到短语边界。这些组件共同生成语音，其中每个区域都带有其自身语言的口音，无需微调或辅助模型。在多种语言对中，LCG能够稳健地提高代码转换短语的母语化程度，同时抑制口音泄漏，并保持整体说话人的身份和自然度。

articles.title: SinkPruner: Sink-Free Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Despite their strong multimodal understanding ability, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial computational overhead when processing long visual token sequences. To reduce inference costs, recent studies have explored visual token pruning through vision-centric or text-guided strategies. However, these methods often overlook high-norm outlier tokens, i.e., tokens with abnormally large feature norms, leading to suboptimal pruning decisions. In this work, we show that such high-norm outlier tokens are highly redundant in both feature and spatial dimensions, yet are often mistakenly preserved as informative cues by existing methods. Motivated by this observation, we propose SinkPruner, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient MLLM inference. SinkPruner follows a coarse-to-fine design with two key modules: a visual sanitizer that filters high-norm redundancies and alleviates attention sink and attention dispersion, and a text-guided pruner that further retains tokens semantically aligned with the text query. Extensive experiments on twelve image-language and four video-language benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and generalizability of our framework. Notably, SinkPruner preserves 96.5% (91.8%) of the original performance of LLaVA-1.5 (Qwen2.5-VL) under an 89% token reduction. Experiments further indicate that our visual sanitizer exhibits promising transferability in enhancing the performance of existing pruning methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/LaVi-Lab/SinkPruner.
articles.titleCn: SinkPruner：适用于多模态大型语言模型的免Sink可视化标记剪枝
articles.abstractCn: 尽管多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）具有强大的多模态理解能力，但在处理长视觉token序列时，它们会产生巨大的计算开销。为了降低推理成本，近期研究通过以视觉为中心或文本引导的策略探索视觉token剪枝。然而，这些方法通常忽略了高范数异常token，即特征范数异常大的token，导致剪枝决策不理想。在这项工作中，我们表明这类高范数异常token在特征和空间维度上都具有高度冗余性，但现有方法却常错误地将其保留为信息提示。基于这一观察，我们提出了SinkPruner，一个无需训练的视觉token剪枝框架，用于高效MLLM推理。SinkPruner采用由粗到细的设计，包含两个关键模块：一个视觉净化器用于过滤高范数冗余并缓解注意力陷阱和注意力分散，以及一个文本引导剪枝器用于进一步保留与文本查询语义对齐的token。在十二个图像-语言和四个视频-语言基准上的大量实验证明了我们框架的有效性、效率和泛化能力。值得注意的是，在减少89%的token的情况下，SinkPruner保留了LLaVA-1.5（Qwen2.5-VL）原始性能的96.5%（91.8%）。实验进一步表明，我们的视觉净化器在提升现有剪枝方法性能方面展现出良好的可迁移性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/LaVi-Lab/SinkPruner获取。

articles.title: Right Frame, Wrong Rule: Cultural Cues Expose the Financial Knowledge Gap They Were Meant to Close
articles.abstract: When a question has valid answers under different normative frameworks, a language model must decide which framework to use and whether it can answer correctly within it. We call this setting normative pluralism and study it in Islamic finance using a four-choice taxonomy that separates framework selection from within-framework correctness. This separation reveals the stereotype trap: a cultural cue steers a model toward one framework, but the model selects an incorrect answer within that framework. Across twelve models, two languages, and fifty demographic signals, cultural cues change framework selection and reveal substantial differences in accuracy, especially among non-frontier models. Under the strongest signal, large open-weight models select the Islamic framework 97% of the time. A two-choice evaluation would report near-perfect alignment, although 57--66% of those selections are incorrect. These findings motivate, but do not directly test, the competence-conditioned routing hypothesis: models may favor frameworks where they are more accurate, while cultural cues may expose framework-specific competence gaps.
articles.titleCn: 正确的框架，错误的规则：文化线索暴露了它们本意要弥补的金融知识差距
articles.abstractCn: 当一个问题的答案在不同规范框架下都有效时，语言模型必须决定使用哪个框架，并判断是否能在该框架内正确回答。我们将这种情境称为规范多元性，并使用一个包含四个选择的分类法在伊斯兰金融领域进行研究，该分类法将框架选择与框架内正确性分离开来。这种分离揭示了刻板印象陷阱：一个文化线索会引导模型选择某个框架，但模型在该框架内选择了错误答案。在十二个模型、两种语言和五十个人口统计信号中，文化线索改变了框架选择，并揭示了准确率上的显著差异，尤其是在非前沿模型中。在最强的信号下，大型开放式加权模型97%的时间选择了伊斯兰框架。在两选择评估中，虽然57%至66%的选择是错误的，但评估会报告接近完美的符合度。这些发现支持但不直接检验了能力条件路由假设：模型可能更倾向于它们更准确的框架，而文化线索可能会暴露特定框架的能力差距。

articles.title: Inspicio: Open-Vocabulary, LLM-Based Sense Retrieval for Historical Languages
articles.abstract: Word Sense Disambiguation has advanced rapidly for English and a handful of well-resourced modern languages, but it continues to assume the existence of a sense inventory and a word-to-sense mapping in the source language (Navigli, 2026). These assumptions break down for most historical and low-resource languages, whose dedicated WordNets are either incomplete or still under construction. We present Inspicio, an open-vocabulary retrieval pipeline that links tokens in context to synsets of the Open English WordNet (McCrae et al., 2020) without requiring any source-language inventory or mapping. For each occurrence, an instruction-tuned LLM produces two English translations of the surrounding sentence, a small set of candidate dictionary-style definitions, and a few candidate English lemmas. These outputs drive a hybrid retrieval step that combines dense definition-synset similarity, sparse lemma matching, and Maximal Marginal Relevance re-ranking. We evaluate the pipeline across a 6x6 grid of LLMs and sentence-embedding models on a new bilingual set of manually annotated Latin and Ancient Greek perception verbs, on a subset of PREMOVE dataset (Farina, 2025), and on a diachronic sample of Italian. The best configuration reaches 96% Recall@50 on the perception-verb test set, with each component contributing measurable gains, and remains competitive in the out-of-domain and cross-lingual settings.
articles.titleCn: Inspicio：面向历史语言的开词汇、基于大型语言模型的语义检索
articles.abstractCn: 词义消歧在英语和一些资源丰富的现代语言中取得了迅速进展，但它仍然假设源语言存在一个词义库和词到词义的映射（Navigli，2026）。这些假设对于大多数历史语言和低资源语言并不适用，因为它们的专用WordNet要么不完整，要么仍在建设中。我们提出了Inspicio，这是一个开放词汇检索流程，它将上下文中的词元链接到开放英语WordNet（McCrae等人，2020）的synsets，而无需任何源语言词义库或映射。对于每个出现，一个指令微调的大型语言模型生成两个英语翻译的句子片段、一组候选的词典式定义以及几个候选的英语词元。这些输出驱动了一个混合检索步骤，该步骤结合了密集定义-synset相似度、稀疏词元匹配和最大边际相关性重新排序。我们在一个新构建的双语拉丁语和古希腊感知动词手动标注数据集上，在PREMOVE数据集（Farina，2025）的一个子集上，以及在一个意大利语的历时样本上评估了该流程。最佳配置在感知动词测试集上达到了96%的Recall@50，每个组件都贡献了可衡量的提升，并在领域外和跨语言环境中保持竞争力。

articles.title: Disclosure-Gated User Simulation for Companion-Agent Evaluation
articles.abstract: Using a large language model to play the user is now standard in scalable evaluation. It has a repeatedly diagnosed failure: the simulated user is excessively cooperative, so a system under test can score by the sheer number of questions it asks rather than by making the user willing to speak. We answer with a disclosure gate conditioning information release on the companion agent's behaviour: its state is a ladder of five ordered gates, merged onto three observable depth layers. We specify, ablate, and audit it, and train a user simulator against that specification. Gating behaviour is learned from the training corpus's synthetic branch, while the real branch supplies how people speak and react; after training, the simulator need not be told at runtime which gate each item sits behind. The gate is a load-bearing component of the environment: on the English corpus of a published companion-agent benchmark (CompanionBench), once training no longer states per example which gate each item sits behind, the largest rank displacement across 12 systems under test exceeds the noise band set by re-running that environment under a new seed, while per-system scores show no detectable change. We state two acceptance criteria: a ranking must be order-preserving, and absolute scores must be scale-stable. Of the candidates we examine, only one passes both -- the simulator we release -- and its leaderboard correlates at 0.993 with the benchmark's original simulator. By contrast, prompting a frontier model as the simulator barely moves the ranking while shifting every score upward -- a shift invisible to anyone checking the ranking alone. The environment we specify is the one that benchmark already used. That publication describes the mechanism in about four hundred words, and we supply what it lacked: specification, ablations, human studies, negative controls, and downstream sensitivity analysis.
articles.titleCn: 用于伴侣代理评估的披露门控用户模拟
articles.abstractCn: 使用大型语言模型来模拟用户现在是可扩展评估的标准做法。它存在一个反复被诊断出的缺陷：模拟用户过于配合，导致被测试系统可以通过询问问题的数量来获得高分，而不是让用户愿意说话。我们通过在伴随代理的行为上实施信息释放的披露门控条件来解决这一问题：其状态是一个由五个有序门级联而成的梯子，合并到三个可观察的深度层上。我们对其进行了指定、消融和审计，并针对该规范训练了一个用户模拟器。门控行为从训练语料库的合成分支中学习，而真实分支则提供人们的实际语言和反应方式；训练完成后，模拟器无需在运行时被告知每个项目背后是哪个门。门是环境中的承重组件：在一个已发布的伴随代理基准（CompanionBench）的英语语料库中，一旦训练不再为每个示例声明每个项目背后的门，12个被测试系统中的最大排名位移超过了在新种子下重新运行该环境时设定的噪声带，而每个系统的分数没有出现可检测到的变化。我们提出了两个验收标准：排名必须保持顺序，绝对分数必须具有尺度稳定性。在我们考察的候选者中，只有一个是通过这两个标准的——我们发布的模拟器——并且它的排行榜与基准的原始模拟器相关系数为0.993。相比之下，将前沿模型作为模拟器几乎不会改变排名，但会使所有分数向上移动——这种移动对于仅检查排名的人来说是看不见的。我们指定的环境是基准已经使用的那个。该出版物用大约四百字描述了该机制，而我们提供了它所缺乏的内容：规范、消融、人类研究、负控制措施和下游敏感性分析。

articles.title: PersianAnonymizer: Evaluating LLM-Labeled Training for Efficient NER-based Anonymization in Persian
articles.abstract: We target practical anonymization of Persian customer chats by training a compact NER model from LLM-labeled supervision and selecting the best labeler for deployment. We compare three instruction-tuned LLMs: DeepSeek-V3-0324, GPT-OSS-120B, and Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507, to produce span annotations under a shared JSON protocol, yielding four corpora (OSS_ZeroShot, Qwen_ZeroShot, Qwen_FewShot, DeepSeek_FewShot). A MatinaRoberta-based token-classifier is trained per corpus and evaluated with token-level Precision/Recall/F1 (overall and per-class). We also report Label Coverage Recall (LCR), the proportion of gold non-O tokens predicted as non-O, and quantify cross-labeler behavior via a token-level Venn on test annotations. Finally, we contrast test-set annotation latency of the LLMs on H200 nodes with the trained NER's test-time labeling on a single RTX 3090. Results show that supervision from OSS_ZeroShot yields the strongest macro-F1 and LCR, while the resulting NER labels an entire 40K-message test set in approximately 2 minutes on one consumer GPU. This establishes a practical path to high-quality, low-cost anonymization for Persian industrial data.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Published at LREC 2026
articles.titleCn: 波斯语匿名化器：评估基于LLM标注的训练，以实现高效的波斯语命名实体匿名化
articles.abstractCn: 我们通过从LLM标注的监督数据中训练紧凑型NER模型，并选择最佳标注器进行部署，旨在实现波斯语客户聊天的实用匿名化。我们比较了三种指令微调的LLM：DeepSeek-V3-0324、GPT-OSS-120B和Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507，以在共享的JSON协议下生成跨度标注，从而产生四个语料库（OSS_ZeroShot、Qwen_ZeroShot、Qwen_FewShot、DeepSeek_FewShot）。基于MatinaRoberta的token分类器针对每个语料库进行训练，并使用token级别的Precision/Recall/F1（总体和按类别）进行评估。我们还报告了标签覆盖率召回率（LCR），即预测为非O的金非O标签的比例，并通过在测试标注上使用token级别的维恩图量化跨标注器的行为。最后，我们对比了LLM在H200节点上的测试集标注延迟与训练的NER在单个RTX 3090上的测试时标注速度。结果表明，OSS_ZeroShot的监督产生了最强的宏观F1和LCR，而生成的NER模型在一个消费级GPU上大约需要2分钟来标注整个40K条消息的测试集。这为波斯语工业数据的高质量、低成本匿名化提供了一条实用路径。

articles.title: Calibration is the Bottleneck: An Action-Class Diagnostic of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling
articles.abstract: Multi-turn tool calling is a core evaluation scenario for large language model (LLM) agents. On public tool-calling benchmarks, open-weight models now approach or even surpass closed-source frontier models in aggregate accuracy. However, this metric averages over many different multi-turn situations and obscures whether progress is balanced across them. We propose an action-class-oriented diagnostic framework that decomposes multi-turn failures into two orthogonal modes: action-class miscalibration and action-execution failure. The framework operates over a four-class action space (TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM) and introduces a self-revealing upper bound Acc <= GAR (Gold Action Recall); the two modes show up as bound violation (Acc > GAR, exposing state-grader masking of miscalibration) and large bound slack (GAR >> Acc, localizing execution failure within TOOL_CALL). We validate it on a panel of tool-calling models across multiple multi-turn benchmarks. Across our panel, the diagnostic reveals action-class miscalibration as a substantial failure mode the state grader cannot see. This gap inflates standing for heavily tool-trained families, which our diagnostic separates from families with context-appropriate action choice. Calibration is reshapable through context-only perturbations, but the reshape is heterogeneous: a single perturbation moves accuracy in opposite directions across families (up to +11.5 vs -21.0 pp on the same scenario), and its effect further depends on the perturbation mechanism. We argue that multi-turn tool-calling evaluations should supplement aggregate accuracy with action-class diagnostics that expose what the model actually does in each scenario.

articles.titleCn: 校准是瓶颈：多轮工具调用的动作类诊断
articles.abstractCn: 多轮工具调用是大语言模型（LLM）代理的核心评估场景。在公开的工具调用基准测试中，开放权重模型现在在总体准确率上已经接近甚至超越了闭源前沿模型。然而，这一指标是在许多不同的多轮情境下取平均的，模糊了这些情境之间进展是否均衡的问题。我们提出了一种面向动作类别的诊断框架，将多轮失败分解为两种正交模式：动作类别误校准和动作执行失败。该框架作用于一个包含四个类别的动作空间（TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM），并引入了一个自我揭示的上限Acc <= GAR（黄金动作召回率）；这两种模式表现为界限违规（Acc > GAR，揭示了状态评分器对误校准的遮蔽）和较大的界限松弛（GAR >> Acc，将执行失败定位在TOOL_CALL内）。我们在多个多轮基准测试中的多个工具调用模型集合上验证了该框架。在我们的模型集合中，诊断揭示了动作类别误校准作为一种状态评分器无法察觉的重大失败模式。这种差距使得经过重度工具训练的模型家族表现被夸大，而我们的诊断能够将这些家族与选择情境适宜动作的家族区分开来。校准可以通过仅对上下文进行扰动来重塑，但这种重塑是异质的：单个扰动会在不同家族中使准确率朝相反方向变化（在相同场景下，最高提升11.5个基点，最高下降21.0个基点），并且其效果还取决于扰动机制。我们主张，多轮工具调用评估应补充总体准确率，采用动作类别诊断来揭示模型在每个情境中的实际行为。

articles.title: From Terminology to Diagrams: Visual-Instruction Generation for Scientific Diagram Understanding
articles.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in visual question answering with natural images. However, they continue to struggle with scientific diagrams, which are designed to convey functional or relational meaning rather than literal scenes. We therefore introduce a framework for generating large-scale diagram-grounded instruction data by leveraging terminology derived from scientific curricula. Our approach systematically extracts domain concepts, synthesizes atomic facts, retrieves relevant diagrams from the web, and generates multimodal supervision in the form of diagram captions and multiple-choice questions. Using this pipeline, we construct SciGram, a dataset of over 194K diagrams and 1.4M visual instructions across life, earth, and physical sciences. Despite relying on noisy web data and synthetic annotations, models fine-tuned on SciGram achieve substantial improvements on diagram-centric benchmarks, including TQA, ScienceQA, and AI2D, outperforming or matching state-of-the-art VLMs while using fewer training instances. Furthermore, augmenting existing models such as LLaVA OneVision with SciGram establishes new state-of-the-art performance on diagram question answering. Our results highlight the effectiveness of terminology-grounded instruction generation as a general strategy for improving vision-language reasoning in scientific domains. To support future research in scientific diagram understanding, we release both the SciGram dataset and models.
