articles.titleCn: 从术语到图表：科学图表理解的视觉指令生成
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在利用自然图像进行视觉问答方面表现出色，但它们在处理科学图表时仍面临挑战，因为科学图表旨在传达功能或关系意义，而非字面场景。为此，我们提出了一种框架，通过利用科学课程中的术语来生成大规模图表指令数据。我们的方法系统性地提取领域概念，合成原子事实，从网络上检索相关图表，并生成以图表说明和选择题形式呈现的多模态监督数据。借助该流程，我们构建了SciGram数据集，包含生命科学、地球科学和物理科学中超过19.4万个图表和140万个视觉指令。尽管依赖于嘈杂的网络数据和合成标注，但在SciGram上微调的模型在以图表为中心的基准测试（包括TQA、ScienceQA和AI2D）上取得了显著提升，超越了或匹敌了最先进的VLMs，同时训练实例更少。此外，通过将SciGram与现有模型（如LLaVA OneVision）结合，在图表问答任务上实现了新的最先进性能。我们的结果表明，基于术语的指令生成是一种通用的策略，可有效提升科学领域的视觉语言推理能力。为支持未来科学图表理解研究，我们发布了SciGram数据集和模型。

articles.title: A Dataset for Modeling Iterative Problem-Solving
articles.abstract: Solving problems through repeated attempts is a sequential modeling task: at each step, the solver receives feedback and decides how to revise their solutions. Predicting whether performance improves, plateaus, or regresses across attempts is central to understanding any iterative problem-solving process in both human learners and autonomous agents. Beyond outcomes, modeling what errors persist and how strategies shift across attempts provides deeper insight into the mechanics of sequential learning. Studying these dynamics requires observing many solvers as they attempt, receive feedback, and revise. Programming courses with automated grading provide this setting, as students iteratively submit code to test suites and receive feedback on every attempt. We therefore curate CodeInsight, a large-scale dataset of over 3 million submissions from 3,286 undergraduates across 2 introductory C++ courses in 2 academic years, with test-case-level outcomes, timestamps, and source code. On this dataset, we build a benchmark that evaluates models spanning parametric, sequential, and generative traditions under a shared calibration-and-scoring protocol, including a Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) adapted to track solver characteristics through discrete latent variables and an LLM-based predictor that generates explicit solutions. The adapted RSSM achieves the strongest predictive accuracy on three of the four courses. The LLM predictor is less accurate but produces full submissions at each attempt, enabling direct analysis of failure modes. We find that the model's coding proficiency is inversely related to predictive performance in this setting, with the LLM better understood as a generative solver conditioned on context rather than a faithful predictor of solver behavior. We publicly release our code and the dataset on request to facilitate future research.
articles.titleCn: 用于建模迭代问题解决的数据库
articles.abstractCn: 通过反复尝试解决问题是一种序列建模任务：在每个步骤中，求解者会收到反馈并决定如何修改他们的解决方案。预测性能在尝试过程中是提升、停滞还是退步，对于理解人类学习者和自主代理的任何迭代问题解决过程至关重要。除了结果之外，建模哪些错误持续存在以及策略如何随尝试变化，能更深入地洞察序列学习的机制。研究这些动态需要观察许多求解者在尝试、接收反馈和修改过程中的行为。编程课程中带有自动评分功能提供了这种环境，学生迭代提交代码到测试套件并接收每次尝试的反馈。因此，我们整理了CodeInsight，这是一个包含超过300万次提交的大型数据集，来自两年内两门入门级C++课程中的3286名本科生，具有测试用例级别的结果、时间戳和源代码。在这个数据集上，我们构建了一个基准，评估了参数化、序列和生成传统下的模型，采用统一的校准和评分协议，包括一个通过离散潜变量跟踪求解者特征的循环状态空间模型（RSSM）和一个基于LLM的预测器，该预测器生成显式解决方案。适配的RSSM在四门课程中的三门上实现了最强的预测精度。LLM预测器的精度较低，但在每次尝试中都会生成完整的提交，从而能够直接分析失败模式。我们发现，在这种情况下，模型的编码能力与预测性能呈负相关，LLM被更好地理解为在上下文中进行条件生成的求解器，而不是忠实预测求解者行为的预测器。我们公开发布我们的代码和数据集，以促进未来的研究。

articles.title: DualStake: Dual-Path Confidence Calibration in Deep Research Agents
articles.abstract: Deep Research agents tackle knowledge-intensive tasks through multi-round retrieval and decision-oriented generation. However, these agents suffer from severe overconfidence, making their expressed confidence unreliable for user trust and downstream abstention. To address this, we augment the Deep Research pipeline with step confidence elicitation after each retrieval, building on the commonly used post-answer verbalized confidence. Interestingly, we find that Evidence Confidence (E-Conf), elicited after the final retrieval step, provides a stronger uncertainty signal than Answer Confidence (A-Conf), elicited after answer generation, and that A-Conf is largely shaped by E-Conf. Based on these findings, we propose DualStake, a dual-path calibration method that applies margin-clipped, confidence-dependent stake rewards to jointly align E-Conf and A-Conf with answer correctness while limiting extreme confidence optimization. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Qwen3-4B across 8 QA benchmarks demonstrate that DualStake consistently improves calibration without sacrificing answer accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/FloXXXt/DualStake.
articles.titleCn: 双路径置信度校准深度研究智能体：DualStake
articles.abstractCn: 深度研究代理通过多轮检索和面向决策的生成来处理知识密集型任务。然而，这些代理存在严重的过度自信问题，导致其表达的置信度对用户信任和下游拒绝回答不可靠。为解决这一问题，我们通过在每次检索后增加步骤置信度获取，增强了深度研究流程，并基于常用的回答后口头表达的置信度。有趣的是，我们发现最终检索步骤后获取的证据置信度（E-Conf）比回答生成后获取的答案置信度（A-Conf）提供了更强的不确定性信号，并且A-Conf很大程度上受到E-Conf的影响。基于这些发现，我们提出了DualStake，这是一种双路径校准方法，通过应用边际裁剪、置信度相关的利益奖励，将E-Conf和A-Conf与答案正确性联合校准，同时限制极端置信度优化。在Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B上的8个问答基准测试中，实验表明DualStake始终如一地提高了校准效果，同时未牺牲答案准确度。代码可在https://github.com/FloXXXt/DualStake获取。

articles.title: Context-Grounding Gains Are Mediated by Pre-existing Machinery: Auditing GRPO, SFT, and DPO
articles.abstract: Language models can ignore prompt evidence when it conflicts with memorized knowledge. Post-training can make models follow such evidence more reliably, but it is unclear whether these gains require new machinery or strengthen machinery already present. We compare nine post-training arms spanning GRPO, SFT, and DPO from one starting checkpoint, with key comparisons extended across scales and families. We estimate a grounding direction from that checkpoint before training. Across five tested GRPO variants, grounding gains are small. For the two variants replicated across seeds, equivalence tests bound their effects below the conflict-SFT gain even as the rewarded metric improves. Conflict-SFT improves grounding moderately, while DPO drives grounding near ceiling on its matched distribution. Conflict-SFT and DPO largely use the same causal attention-head set as the starting model. Subtracting the starting-model direction suppresses both gains, while adding it to the starting model recovers 35% of DPO's gain at a dose passing all stated side-effect checks. After a supervised warm start makes the context answer appear in more rollouts, the same GRPO recipe adds essentially no further grounding gain. In our setting, grounding gains largely depend on machinery already present in the starting model.
articles.titleCn: 上下文基础增益由现有机制介导：审计GRPO、SFT和DPO
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型在提示证据与其记忆知识冲突时可以忽略提示证据。在训练后，模型可以更可靠地遵循此类证据，但尚不清楚这些收益是否需要新的机制，还是增强了模型中已有的机制。我们比较了从同一初始检查点开始的九个训练后策略分支，涵盖了GRPO、SFT和DPO，关键的比较在多个尺度和家族中展开。我们在训练前从该检查点估计了一个基础方向。在五个测试的GRPO变体中，基础收益很小。对于在多个种子中复制的两个变体，等价性测试将它们的效果界限在冲突-SFT收益之下，即使奖励指标得到改善。冲突-SFT适度提高了基础能力，而DPO在其匹配分布上使基础能力接近上限。冲突-SFT和DPO几乎使用了与起始模型相同的因果注意力头集。减去起始模型方向会抑制这两种收益，而将其添加到起始模型中则能恢复DPO收益的35%，且该剂量通过所有声明的副作用检查。在监督预热启动使上下文答案在更多 rollout 中出现后，相同的GRPO配方几乎不再带来额外的基础收益。在我们的设置中，基础收益很大程度上取决于起始模型中已有的机制。

articles.title: VIBE-Bench: Evaluating Personalized Large Language Models When Profiles Don't Mean Preferences
articles.abstract: Personalized Large Language Models (PLLMs) aim to tailor responses to individual users, where a central challenge is preference reasoning: inferring query-relevant preferences from user-related history. Existing benchmarks, however, largely assume that such preference can be retrieved from semantically related history. We study an underexplored but practically important regime, profile-preference conceptual misalignment (PRCM), where observable profile cues and query-specific preferences lie in different concept spaces, making semantic retrieval inconsistent for personalization. We introduce VIBE-Bench, a benchmark with two psychology-grounded tasks, 3,504 personas and 12,239 dialogues, including a manually verified gold test set, and requires cross-concept preference reasoning beyond surface semantic overlap. Experiments with several personalization methods show that current PLLMs largely rely on shallow semantic correlations and fail to acquire robust cross-concept mappings. These findings establish PRCM as a distinct failure regime in PLLMs and position VIBE-Bench as a focused testbed for advancing preference reasoning beyond semantic matching.
articles.titleCn: VIBE-Bench：当个人资料不代表偏好时评估个性化大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 个性化大型语言模型（PLLMs）旨在根据个体用户定制响应，其中核心挑战是偏好推理：从用户相关历史中推断与查询相关的偏好。然而，现有基准主要假设这种偏好可以从语义相关的历史中检索。我们研究了一个尚未充分探索但实践中非常重要的领域——个人资料偏好概念错位（PRCM），其中可观察的个人资料线索和特定查询的偏好位于不同的概念空间，导致语义检索在个性化中不一致。我们引入了VIBE-Bench，这是一个包含两个基于心理学任务的基准，涵盖3,504个角色和12,239个对话，包括经过人工验证的金标准测试集，并要求跨概念偏好推理，超越表面语义重叠。使用多种个性化方法的实验表明，当前的PLLMs在很大程度上依赖于浅层语义关联，并且无法获取稳健的跨概念映射。这些发现将PRCM确立为PLLMs中的一个独特失效模式，并将VIBE-Bench定位为推进超越语义匹配的偏好推理的专注测试平台。

articles.title: RPCBench: A Benchmark for Proactive Premise Critique in LLM-based Recommendation
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as interactive recommender assistants. Their evaluation should therefore go beyond plausible item recommendation and test whether they can recognize flawed recommendation requests. Existing recommender benchmarks mainly assess ranking, generation, or preference satisfaction, while existing error-detection benchmarks are usually not grounded in recommendation-specific user and candidate evidence. To address this gap, we introduce RPCBench, a benchmark for evaluating Recommender-Premise Critique: the ability to detect, diagnose, and properly handle faulty premises in natural-language recommendation requests. RPCBench contains evidence-grounded test instances from five recommendation domains and covers ten types of premise failures. Each instance provides a visible recommendation context and a corrupted user query. We further design a fine-grained evaluation framework that measures proactive detection, error localization, post-detection handling strategy, and evidence faithfulness. Through a systematic evaluation of 11 LLMs, we find that proactive detection is the main bottleneck in Recommender-Premise Critique, and models perform worst on underspecified-premise errors. We also observe that target-critical information density matters more than redundant evidence, and that longer reasoning does not monotonically improve critique quality: performance peaks at intermediate reasoning length, while overly long reasoning is accompanied by an overthinking penalty. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhongruChen/RPCBench.
articles.comment: 45 pages, 8 figures. Code available at https://github.com/ZhongruChen/RPCBench
articles.titleCn: RPCBench：一个用于基于LLM的推荐中主动前提批判的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用作交互式推荐助手。因此，对其评估应超越合理的物品推荐，并测试它们能否识别有缺陷的推荐请求。现有的推荐基准主要评估排序、生成或偏好满足，而现有的错误检测基准通常不是基于推荐特定的用户和候选证据。为填补这一空白，我们引入了RPCBench，一个用于评估推荐前提批判的基准：识别、诊断和正确处理自然语言推荐请求中错误前提的能力。RPCBench包含来自五个推荐领域的基于证据的测试实例，涵盖了十种前提错误类型。每个实例提供一个可见的推荐上下文和一个损坏的用户查询。我们进一步设计了一个细粒度评估框架，用于衡量主动检测、错误定位、检测后处理策略和证据忠实度。通过对11个LLM的系统评估，我们发现主动检测是推荐前提批判的主要瓶颈，模型在未指定前提错误上表现最差。我们还观察到，目标关键信息密度比冗余证据更重要，且推理时间并非越长越好：性能在中等推理长度时达到峰值，而过度冗长的推理伴随着过度思考的惩罚。代码可在https://github.com/ZhongruChen/RPCBench获取。

articles.title: Membership Inference in Fine-tuned Diffusion Language Models via Token-level Memorization Asymmetry
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as an alternative modeling paradigm to autoregressive LMs, offering advantages such as parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling. Despite growing interest in their generative capabilities, the privacy risks of DLMs remain underexplored. We identify a phenomenon termed token-level memorization asymmetry through theoretical analysis of diffusion training dynamics. Building on this finding, we propose Q-Skew, a quantile-weighted skewness-based indicator for membership inference on finetuned DLMs. Experiments across multiple fine-tuning datasets and models show that our method outperforms existing baselines. Moreover, we show that Q-Skew can also facilitate other privacy violations, such as PII extraction. Our findings reveal a previously underexplored privacy attack surface and highlight the need for systematic privacy evaluation of DLMs.
articles.titleCn: 基于标记级记忆不对称性对微调扩散语言模型的成员推理
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）近来作为一种自回归语言模型（LMs）的替代建模范式出现，提供了并行生成和双向上下文建模等优势。尽管其生成能力引起了越来越多的兴趣，但DLMs的隐私风险仍未被充分探索。通过扩散训练动态的理论分析，我们识别出一种称为token级记忆不对称的现象。基于这一发现，我们提出了Q-Skew，这是一种基于分位数加权偏度的成员推理指标，用于对微调后的DLMs进行评估。在多个微调数据集和模型上的实验表明，我们的方法优于现有基线。此外，我们还展示了Q-Skew也能促进其他隐私侵犯行为，例如个人身份信息（PII）提取。我们的研究揭示了一个先前未被充分探索的隐私攻击面，并强调了系统评估DLMs隐私需求的必要性。

articles.title: The Visual Insensitivity Gap: Diagnosing When Vision-Language Models Fail to Use Visual Evidence
articles.abstract: Vision-language models are evaluated by aggregate accuracy on multimodal benchmarks, a practice that implicitly assumes the model uses its visual input. We show this assumption fails on 40%--97% of samples across six VLMs and three perceptual benchmarks: blurring the question-relevant visual region leaves the next-token distribution nearly unchanged. We name this phenomenon the Visual Insensitivity Gap and quantify it with a per-sample Visual Sensitivity Index (VSI). The gap is a property of samples, not of models: VSI ranks correlate across models (grand-mean Spearman rho=+0.40, permutation p<10^-3), so the same samples are flagged insensitive by VLMs sharing no architectural detail beyond a contrastively pretrained vision tower. The mechanism is concrete: on the insensitive samples, a linear probe on each model's own vision tower distinguishes perturbed from clean images at 0.72--0.79 accuracy, yet the model's argmax token changes on only 2%--11% of the same samples, an encoder--LLM gap above 0.65 on every model. Mapping VSI's diagnostic utility cell by cell surfaces a strong regime (multi-choice reasoning on capable VLMs: AUROC=0.85--0.87) and a weak regime (well-calibrated factuality, where softmax confidence already leads). VSI is not a universal best abstention signal; it is a sample-intrinsic indicator of vision-ignoring failure, best used as a conditional ensemble component.

articles.titleCn: 视觉不敏感性差距：诊断视觉-语言模型何时未能使用视觉证据
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型通过多模态基准测试的综合准确率进行评估，这种做法隐含地假设模型使用了其视觉输入。我们表明这一假设在六个视觉语言模型和三个感知基准测试的40%--97%的样本上失效：模糊与问题相关的视觉区域几乎不影响下一个词的分布。我们将这种现象命名为视觉不敏感性差距，并使用每一样本的视觉敏感性指数（VSI）对其进行量化。这个差距是样本的特性，而非模型的特性：VSI排名在模型之间具有相关性（总体Spearman rho=+0.40，置换p<10^-3），因此相同的样本会被那些除了对比预训练的视觉塔之外没有其他架构细节共享的视觉语言模型标记为不敏感。该机制是具体的：在不敏感样本上，对每个模型的视觉塔进行的线性探测在区分扰动图像和干净图像时准确率可达0.72--0.79，但模型的argmax词只在2%--11%的相同样本上发生变化，每个模型上的编码器--大语言模型差距都超过0.65。逐个单元格映射VSI的诊断效用揭示了一个强域（在功能强大的视觉语言模型上进行多选推理：AUROC=0.85--0.87）和一个弱域（经过良好校准的真实性，其中softmax置信度已经领先）。VSI不是一个通用的最佳放弃信号；它是一个视觉忽略失败的样本内指示器，最佳用途是作为条件集成组件。

articles.title: MemoryWalker: Stop Training Agents on Contexts They Never Saw
articles.abstract: Production agent harnesses such as Claude Code and Qwen-Agent compress context during rollout, but training under compression creates a conditioning problem: every eviction branches the effective history, so the learning object is a tree rather than a sequence. Existing linearizations either retain the rightmost path, causing time-travel leakage, or replay a depth-first traversal, causing train-inference mismatch. We introduce two exact, gradient-equivalent corrections: LogitTree, a segmented K-forward traversal, and a packed 4D attention mask. LogitTree requires K+1 backward passes; the 4D mask requires a custom kernel and white-box eviction records. We also propose SDCC (Self-Distillation for Conditioning Consistency), a single-backward-pass variational relaxation. At each eviction, it minimizes forward KL between the compressed student and a stop-gradient teacher on the reconstructed pre-eviction prefix. A residual per-junction KL of epsilon_KL gives an O(sqrt(epsilon_KL)) bound on the train-deployment total-variation gap. SDCC also applies to black-box harnesses. On seven web-search benchmarks with TC-RAG, AgentFold, MemexRL, Claude Code, and OpenCode, naive training inflates the train-rollout log-probability gap, especially on eviction-heavy batches. The exact methods stay at the no-compression floor, and SDCC substantially closes the gap, with lower logit drift and higher rollout rewards.

articles.titleCn: MemoryWalker：停止在它们从未见过的上下文中训练智能体
articles.abstractCn: 在推理过程中，Claude Code和Qwen-Agent等生产代理利用压缩上下文，但在压缩条件下训练会产生一个条件问题：每次驱逐都会分支有效历史，因此学习对象是树而非序列。现有的线性化方法要么保留最右路径导致时间旅行泄漏，要么重放深度优先遍历导致训练-推理不匹配。我们引入两种精确且梯度等价的修正方法：LogitTree（分段K前向遍历）和紧凑的4D注意力掩码。LogitTree需要K+1次反向传播；4D掩码需要自定义核函数和透明的驱逐记录。我们还提出了SDCC（自蒸馏用于条件一致性），这是一种单反向传播的变分松弛方法。在每次驱逐时，它通过在重建的前驱逐前缀上最小化压缩学生与停止梯度的教师之间的正向KL散度来最小化KL散度。每个节点的残差KL散度ε_KL为训练-部署总变差差距提供了O(sqrt(ε_KL))界限。SDCC也适用于黑盒代理。在TC-RAG、AgentFold、MemexRL、Claude Code和OpenCode七个网络搜索基准上，朴素训练会放大训练-推理对数概率差距，尤其是在驱逐密集批次上。精确方法停留在无压缩基准，而SDCC显著缩小了差距，具有更低的 logits漂移和更高的推理奖励。

articles.title: Verifiable Disaster Storylines and Causal Knowledge Graphs: A Citation-Grounded Pipeline from Heterogeneous Humanitarian Sources
articles.abstract: Effective humanitarian response depends on the rapid synthesis of heterogeneous, high-volume information sources - a task that routinely exceeds human analytical capacity in the critical early hours of a crisis. We present a pipeline that combines structured disaster records from EM-DAT with unstructured documents from ReliefWeb and the European Media Monitor (EMM) to produce source-grounded disaster storylines and causal knowledge graphs supporting situational awareness for responders and analysts. Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation, the pipeline extracts structured storylines - tabular event profiles covering 17 fields, from severity and key drivers to child-sensitive impact indicators - and constructs causal knowledge graphs where each node and edge is enriched with citation-grounded explanatory narratives, enabling full traceability back to primary sources. We evaluate the system on three diverse crisis use cases through a human evaluation involving 9 domain expert and 9 non-expert evaluators. Results confirm high retrieval precision, strong faithfulness of extracted causal relations, and a clear expert preference for citation-grounded components over ungrounded alternatives. The pipeline is designed to scale to the full EM-DAT catalogue, with the goal of publicly releasing a narrative-enriched version of the database.
articles.titleCn: 可验证灾难故事线和因果知识图谱：基于引文的多源人道主义信息处理流程
articles.abstractCn: 有效的人道主义响应依赖于对异构、高容量信息源的快速整合——这一任务在危机关键初期通常超出人类分析能力。我们提出一个整合系统，将EM-DAT的结构化灾害记录与ReliefWeb和欧洲媒体监测器（EMM）的非结构化文档相结合，生成基于来源的灾害叙事线和因果知识图谱，为响应人员和分析师提供态势感知支持。通过检索增强生成技术，该系统提取结构化叙事线——涵盖17个字段的表格式事件概况，从严重程度和关键驱动因素到儿童敏感影响指标——并构建因果知识图谱，其中每个节点和边都通过引文支撑的解释性叙事进行丰富，实现完全可追溯性至原始来源。我们通过涉及9名领域专家和9名非专家评估员的综合评估，在三个多样化的危机应用案例中对系统进行了评估。结果证实了高检索精度、提取因果关系的强可靠性，以及专家对引文支撑组件的明确偏好超过无支撑替代方案。该系统设计旨在扩展至完整的EM-DAT目录，目标是将叙事增强版数据库公开发布。

articles.title: Staged Linguistic Seeding: Grounded Query Expansion for Verified-Unit QA in AI Contact Centers
articles.abstract: Customer-service QA in an AI contact center (AICC) runs under deployment constraints that benchmark QA misses: tight voice-hotline latency and a high cost for unsupported or wrong automatic answers. We deploy a system that answers only from a closed set of verified QA units: it returns a retrieved unit verbatim, or routes to clarify, abstain, or handoff. The index is enriched offline by staged linguistic seeding (SLS): a human authors a per-unit world-grounded slot recipe, gpt-4.1-mini renders it into variants, and a light human gate filters them. One methodology is reused across both domains, so inference stays a single retrieval pass with no query-time generation. On held-out query variants from two industrial domains, SLS lifts hybrid R@1 to 0.881/0.930 (+0.27/+0.34), with gains across all five retrievers tested. At the same gpt-4.1-mini generation budget, SLS beats doc2query by +0.20/+0.32, while cross-provenance evaluation provides additional evidence of transfer across generated-query distributions. Verified-unit answering also removes free-form generation's unsupported-content surface (7-13% versus approximately 0%). We report this as an application study, including negative results.

articles.titleCn: 分阶段语言播种：为AI客服中心验证单元问答的接地查询扩展
articles.abstractCn: 在AI客服中心（AICC）中，客户服务问答（QA）系统在部署时面临基准问答系统所忽略的约束条件：严格的语音热线延迟和对于不支持或错误自动回答的高成本。我们部署了一个仅从一组经过验证的问答单元中回答的系统：它要么直接返回检索到的单元，要么路由到澄清、回避或转接。索引通过离线的分阶段语言播种（SLS）进行丰富：人类为每个单元编写基于现实世界的槽位配方，gpt-4.1-mini将其渲染为多种变体，并由轻量级人工过滤器进行筛选。两种方法在两个领域都得到复用，因此推理保持为单次检索，无需查询时生成。在两个工业领域的保留查询变体上，SLS将混合R@1提升至0.881/0.930（+0.27/+0.34），在所有五个测试的检索器中均观察到提升。在相同的gpt-4.1-mini生成预算下，SLS比doc2query高出+0.20/+0.32，而跨来源评估提供了额外的证据，证明在生成查询分布之间存在迁移。经过验证的单元回答还消除了自由形式生成的不支持内容表面（7-13%与约0%相比）。我们将其报告为一项应用研究，包括负面结果。

articles.title: Replacing Training with Memory: Listwise Selection for Text-to-SQL
articles.abstract: Modern Text-to-SQL systems often follow generate-execute-select pipelines, generating multiple candidate queries then selecting the best one. Listwise selection, by jointly comparing multiple candidates, has been widely adopted, but fine-tuning listwise selectors is costly. We thus propose a fine-tuning-free listwise selector. We replace two major fine-tuning objectives with inference-time strategies: (1) learning selection criteria as ordering and (2) mitigating positional bias. First, we build reusable structured memories instead of learning selection behavior as model parameters. Given a question, MaP-SQL retrieves memories distilled from training data that encode how natural language maps to schema elements, SQL operations, and expected outputs. These memories serve as explicit decision criteria for evaluating candidates in a listwise manner. Second, to mitigate ordering bias of listwise selectors, we aggregate rankings across multiple input permutations, with inference cost optimized by execution results and pointwise scoring. Our approach improves selection accuracy while maintaining efficiency and compatibility with existing large language models. Across Text-to-SQL benchmarks, it produces more stable selection without fine-tuning and fewer unnecessary comparisons than existing methods. On BIRD-dev, it outperforms the previous state-of-the-art selector-based method R^3-SQL by 2.02 execution accuracy points on average using the same candidate sets, with 2.92x fewer tokens.
articles.titleCn: 用记忆替换训练：文本到SQL的列表式选择
articles.abstractCn: 现代文本到SQL系统通常采用生成-执行-选择流水线，生成多个候选查询然后选择最佳一个。联合比较多个候选的列表选择法已被广泛采用，但微调列表选择器成本高昂。因此，我们提出一种无需微调的列表选择器。我们将两个主要的微调目标替换为推理时策略：(1) 将选择标准学习为排序，(2) 减轻位置偏差。首先，我们构建可复用的结构化记忆，而不是将选择行为作为模型参数学习。给定一个问题，MaP-SQL检索从训练数据中提炼的记忆，这些记忆编码自然语言如何映射到模式元素、SQL操作和预期输出。这些记忆作为显式的决策标准，以列表方式评估候选。其次，为减轻列表选择器的排序偏差，我们聚合多个输入排列的排名，推理成本通过执行结果和逐点评分优化。我们的方法在提高选择准确性的同时保持了效率和与现有大型语言模型的兼容性。在文本到SQL基准测试中，它在不进行微调的情况下产生更稳定的选型，且比现有方法进行更少的冗余比较。在BIRD-dev上，使用相同的候选集，它平均比基于选择器的最先进方法R^3-SQL高2.02个执行准确度点，且token使用量减少2.92倍。

articles.title: Dense Process Supervision for Search Agents via Fact Utility Estimation
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for search agents typically relies on outcome rewards. However, it often fails to achieve effective credit assignment, due to the unclear value of intermediate steps. It is hard to separate their contributions from the final result. In this paper, we propose a dense process supervision method based on fact utility estimation, which models the reasoning process as the accumulation of discrete evidence facts. We first extract structured facts from raw observations and organize them into an explicit fact store. To support credit assignment, we then cluster semantically equivalent facts and infer the posterior utility of each fact cluster using Bayesian estimation over group rollouts. Finally, we convert the estimated fact utilities into dense step-level rewards to guide RL training. Experiments on seven single-hop and multi-hop QA benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms existing baselines. Ablation studies validate clear relative improvements on multi-hop QA compared to outcome reward-only training.
articles.comment: Accepted in the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
articles.titleCn: 通过事实效用估计实现搜索代理的密集过程监督
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）在搜索代理中的应用通常依赖于结果奖励。然而，由于中间步骤的价值不明确，它往往无法实现有效的信用分配，难以将它们的贡献与最终结果区分开来。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于事实效用估计的密集过程监督方法，该方法将推理过程建模为离散证据事实的累积。我们首先从原始观测中提取结构化事实，并将它们组织到一个明确的事实存储中。为了支持信用分配，我们随后对语义等价的事实进行聚类，并使用组滚动推演中的贝叶斯估计推断每个事实聚类的后验效用。最后，我们将估计的事实效用转换为密集的步骤级奖励，以指导RL训练。在七个单跳和多跳问答基准上的实验表明，我们的方法始终优于现有基线。消融研究验证了与仅使用结果奖励训练相比，在多跳问答方面具有明确的相对改进。

articles.title: TWIX: a Two-Stage Approach for End-To-End Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction
articles.abstract: The exponential growth of scientific publications calls for automatic Information Extraction (IE) systems to support knowledge discovery. In this context, the GutBrainIE benchmark evaluates Named Entity Recognition (NER), Named Entity Recognition and Disambiguation (NERD), and Relation Extraction (RE) systems in the gut-brain axis domain. We propose Two-stage Workflow for Information eXtraction (TWIX), an end-to-end IE pipeline featuring three interconnected modules, each leveraging a two-stage framework to solve all four GutBrainIE subtasks. Evaluation on the development and test sets shows that our method substantially outperforms the baseline by a wide margin, while also ranking first among all participant submissions across all subtasks. These results indicate that the proposed two-stage pipeline effectively improves both precision and recall in practical settings.
articles.comment: Accepted at CLEF 2026: the 17th Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum
articles.titleCn: TWIX：一种用于端到端命名实体识别和关系抽取的两阶段方法
articles.abstractCn: 科学文献的指数增长要求自动信息提取（IE）系统支持知识发现。在此背景下，GutBrainIE基准评估了肠道-大脑轴领域的命名实体识别（NER）、命名实体识别与消歧（NERD）和关系提取（RE）系统。我们提出了信息提取两阶段工作流（TWIX），这是一个端到端的IE管道，包含三个相互关联的模块，每个模块都利用两阶段框架来解决所有四个GutBrainIE子任务。在开发和测试集上的评估表明，我们的方法在基线上有显著优势，同时在所有子任务中均排名第一。这些结果表明，所提出的两阶段管道在实践环境中有效提高了精确率和召回率。

articles.title: Polished but Unresolved: Identifying Late-Stage Pressure States in Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
articles.abstract: Long-horizon tool-use agents need not only to search and plan, but also to decide when to finalize. We study late-stage pressure states, in which an agent is biased toward submitting a final answer that appears complete and polished while key constraints remain unresolved. We first train a linear probe to show that this pressure state is identifiable from the agent's hidden states. Then, we use activation interventions along this pressure direction and find that shifting the hidden states changes both the pressure score and whether the agent continues tool use or submits early. Through controlled context manipulations, we further see that the pressure is mitigated by constraint clarity and action mapping. Based on these findings, we propose Probe-Sensed Pressure Relief (PSPR), a plugin that applies lightweight pressure relief direction under moderate pressure and moves to structured organization under high pressure risk. Experiments on multiple long-horizon benchmarks show that our method consistently strengthens existing agent methods.
articles.comment: Accepted in the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
articles.titleCn: 抛光但未解决：识别长期工具使用代理中的晚期压力状态
articles.abstractCn: 长时程工具使用代理不仅需要搜索和规划，还需要决定何时最终确定。我们研究了后期压力状态，在这种状态下，代理倾向于提交一个看似完整且精致的最终答案，而关键约束仍然未解决。我们首先训练一个线性探针，证明这种压力状态可以从代理的隐藏状态中识别出来。然后，我们沿着这种压力方向进行激活干预，发现改变隐藏状态会改变压力分数，以及代理是否继续使用工具或提前提交。通过控制上下文操作，我们进一步发现，约束清晰度和行动映射可以缓解压力。基于这些发现，我们提出了探测感知压力缓解（PSPR），这是一个插件，在中等压力下应用轻量级压力缓解方向，在高风险压力下转向结构化组织。在多个长时程基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法始终加强了现有的代理方法。

articles.title: Ctrl-F-Resist. Practices, Challenges, and Technical Needs of Civil Society Organizations Monitoring the Far-Right Online
articles.abstract: As far-right actors increasingly exploit online platforms to disseminate ideology and mobilize supporters, civil society organizations (CSOs) play a vital yet underrecognized role in monitoring antidemocratic dynamics online. Unlike fact-checkers or content moderators, CSOs engage in long-term, contextualized analysis, often in resource-constrained settings and under precarious conditions. Despite their critical societal role, CSOs face significant barriers to adopting or co-developing technical solutions, including legal uncertainty, limited platform access, and chronic underfunding. Existing research and tool development efforts have largely overlooked these actors in favor of more institutionally embedded stakeholders. This paper addresses this gap through a qualitative study with 15 practitioners from 12 Germany-based CSOs engaged in online monitoring, positioning them as key yet overlooked stakeholders in the governance of digital spaces. We explore their current practices, challenges, and expectations regarding technological support. Our findings show that monitoring remains largely manual due to the lack of tailored tools, with enhanced search capabilities emerging as the most pressing technical need. While participants express openness to AI-supported features such as media processing and content discovery, many remain skeptical of automated classification, citing concerns around trust, legal usability, and professional credibility. Grounded in these findings, we introduce a conceptual monitoring workflow and describe its implementation in an open-source Telegram monitoring prototype designed to flexibly support diverse monitoring goals. We outline concrete design, policy, and research recommendatios, and introduce the manual labor trap as an empirically grounded concept that explains why monitoring CSOs tend to remain locked into labor-intensive, low-capacity arrangements.
articles.comment: Accepted for the 29th ACM Conference on Computer-Supported Cooperative Work and Social Computing (CSCW 2026)
articles.titleCn: Ctrl-F-抵制。公民社会组织监测极右翼网络活动的实践、挑战和技术需求
articles.abstractCn: 随着极右翼行动者越来越多地利用在线平台传播意识形态和动员支持者，公民社会组织（CSO）在监测网络反民主动态方面发挥着至关重要但未被充分认识的作用。与事实核查员或内容审核员不同，CSO从事长期、情境化的分析，通常在资源受限的环境和危险条件下进行。尽管在社会中扮演着关键角色，CSO在采用或共同开发技术解决方案方面面临重大障碍，包括法律不确定性、平台访问受限以及长期资金不足。现有的研究和工具开发工作在很大程度上忽视了这些行动者，而更倾向于机构嵌入度更高的利益相关者。本文通过一项对12家德国基于的公民社会组织中15名从事在线监测的从业者的定性研究，填补了这一空白，将他们定位为数字空间治理中关键但被忽视的利益相关者。我们探讨了他们的当前实践、挑战以及对技术支持的期望。我们的研究结果表明，由于缺乏定制工具，监测仍然主要依赖人工操作，增强搜索能力成为最紧迫的技术需求。虽然参与者表示对AI支持的功能（如媒体处理和内容发现）持开放态度，但许多人仍然对自动分类持怀疑态度，并指出信任、法律可用性和专业信誉等方面的担忧。基于这些发现，我们介绍了一个概念监测工作流程，并描述了其在开源Telegram监测原型中的实现，该原型旨在灵活支持多样化的监测目标。我们概述了具体的设计、政策和研究建议，并引入了“人工劳动陷阱”这一基于实证的概念，解释了为何监测CSO往往倾向于停留在劳动密集型、低能力配置的安排中。

articles.title: TEIDAN: A Multilingual Multiparty Dialogue Corpus
articles.abstract: Multi-party interaction is a central setting for human communication and a necessary target for human-agent interaction systems that must participate in group conversation. Yet available corpora often focus on meetings, task-oriented interaction, text-based interaction, or acted scenarios, and fewer resources support cross-linguistic comparison of spontaneous face-to-face triadic discussion. This paper presents TEIDAN, a multilingual multimodal corpus that currently consists of Japanese and English three-party conversations. TEIDAN records groups of three participants discussing open-ended topics with individual pin microphones, a microphone array, and participant-facing cameras, and provides IPU-based transcripts for both language portions. Earlier studies used subsets of the Japanese portion for task-specific benchmarks in multi-party dialogue modeling; in contrast, this paper presents TEIDAN as a corpus resource spanning both Japanese and English, with planned expansion to additional languages. We describe the collection design, participants, recording setup, transcription format, and corpus statistics, and provide preliminary analyses to illustrate how TEIDAN can support research on turn-taking, addressee recognition, and multimodal grounding in human-human and human-agent interaction.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. To appear in the Companion Proceedings of the 28th ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction (ICMI Companion '26)
articles.titleCn: TEIDAN：一个多语言多方对话语料库
articles.abstractCn: 多方交互是人类沟通的核心场景，也是必须参与群体对话的人机交互系统的必要目标。然而，现有的语料库往往侧重于会议、任务导向的交互、基于文本的交互或表演场景，支持跨语言对比自发面对面三人讨论的资源较少。本文介绍了TEIDAN，一个多语言多模态语料库，目前包含日语和英语的三人对话。TEIDAN使用个人领夹麦克风、麦克风阵列和面向参与者的摄像头记录三组参与者讨论开放式话题，并为两种语言部分提供基于IPU的文本转录。早期研究使用日语部分子集进行多方对话建模的任务特定基准测试；相比之下，本文将TEIDAN作为一个跨越日语和英语的语料库资源呈现，并计划扩展到其他语言。我们描述了收集设计、参与者、录音设置、转录格式和语料库统计数据，并提供了初步分析，以说明TEIDAN如何支持关于轮流发言、指代识别和多模态基础的人类-人类和人类-交互研究。

articles.title: SFAD: Speculative Factuality-Aware Decoding
articles.abstract: As one of the most critical challenges in large language models, contextual faithfulness directly determines their reliability in knowledge-intensive applications. This task is particularly challenging as it requires balancing factual consistency with generation efficiency. Contrastive decoding methods require dual forward passes (with and without context) to compare model outputs, doubling inference computational overhead, while post-training alignment demands extensive reinforcement learning with substantial computational overhead. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{SFAD}, a speculative decoding framework that enhances contextual faithfulness without inference degradation. We first construct \textbf{ConFide}, a preference dataset with fine-grained atomic perturbations, to train a context-faithful draft model via Direct Preference Optimization. During inference, Epistemic Friction detects potential hallucinations by quantifying distributional tension weighted by specialist certainty. When friction exceeds the threshold, Asymmetric Logit Steering refines the target distribution through residual-based logit injection; otherwise, standard speculation proceeds. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SFAD substantially improves faithfulness while achieving $2.48\times$ speedup, offering a practical solution for efficient LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 基于推测性事实性感知解码
articles.abstractCn: 作为大型语言模型中最关键的挑战之一，上下文忠实度直接决定了它们在知识密集型应用中的可靠性。这项任务尤其具有挑战性，因为它需要在事实一致性与生成效率之间取得平衡。对比解码方法需要双重前向传递（带上下文和不带上下文）来比较模型输出，从而将推理计算开销翻倍，而训练后对齐则需要大量强化学习，同样伴随着巨大的计算开销。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了\textbf{SFAD}，一种推测解码框架，在不降低推理性能的前提下增强了上下文忠实度。我们首先构建了\textbf{ConFide}，一个具有细粒度原子扰动的偏好数据集，通过直接偏好优化来训练一个上下文忠实的草稿模型。在推理过程中，Epistemic Friction通过加权专家确定性来量化分布紧张度，从而检测潜在的幻觉。当摩擦超过阈值时，Asymmetric Logit Steering通过基于残差的logit注入来细化目标分布；否则，则进行标准推测。大量实验表明，SFAD在显著提高忠实度的同时实现了$2.48\times$的加速，为高效LLM提供了一种实用解决方案。

articles.title: Instella-MoE Technical Report
articles.abstract: In this work, we introduce Instella-MoE, a fully open Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 16 billion total parameters and 2.8 billion active parameters per token, trained entirely from scratch on AMD Instinct MI300X and MI325X GPUs. Instella-MoE combines a sparsely activated MoE design with architectural and system-level innovations, including Gated Multi-head Latent Attention (Gated MLA) and FarSkip-Collective connectivity, enabling efficient large-scale training and inference. The model is developed through a multi-stage pipeline comprising pre-training, mid-training, long-context extension, supervised fine-tuning with feedback-driven data curation, direct preference optimization, and reinforcement learning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Instella-MoE achieves an average score of 76.7 across standard pre-training benchmarks, outperforming prior fully open models including OLMo-3-7B, SmolLM3-3B, and OLMoE-1B-7B, while remaining competitive with open-weight MoE and dense baselines at comparable active-parameter scales, including Moonlight-16B-A3B and Qwen3.5-4B. After post-training, our final Think checkpoint achieves an average score of 73.2 across instruction-following, reasoning, math, coding, and chat benchmarks, outperforming both fully open and open-weight models with comparable or larger active parameter counts in our evaluation. To support transparent and reproducible research, we release the complete Instella-MoE model flow, including model weights, training configurations, data mixtures, and training code. Together, these contributions establish Instella-MoE a strong, fully open foundation for efficient, high-performing MoE models and reproducible research.
articles.titleCn: Instella-MoE 技术报告
articles.abstractCn: 在这项工作中，我们介绍了Instella-MoE，一个完全开放的专家混合（MoE）语言模型，总参数量为160亿，每个token的激活参数量为28亿，完全在AMD Instinct MI300X和MI325X GPU上从头训练。Instella-MoE结合了稀疏激活的MoE设计与架构和系统级创新，包括门控多头潜在注意力（Gated MLA）和FarSkip-Collective连接，实现了高效的超大规模训练和推理。该模型通过一个多阶段流程开发，包括预训练、中训练、长上下文扩展、基于反馈驱动的数据策展的监督微调、直接偏好优化以及多教师策略蒸馏的强化学习。Instella-MoE在标准预训练基准上的平均得分为76.7，优于之前的完全开放模型，包括OLMo-3-7B、SmolLM3-3B和OLMoE-1B-7B，同时在同等激活参数规模下，与开放权重MoE和密集基线模型（如Moonlight-16B-A3B和Qwen3.5-4B）保持竞争力。在训练后，我们的最终Think检查点在指令遵循、推理、数学、编码和聊天基准上的平均得分为73.2，优于我们评估中具有同等或更大激活参数数量的完全开放和开放权重模型。为了支持透明和可复现的研究，我们发布了完整的Instella-MoE模型流程，包括模型权重、训练配置、数据混合和训练代码。这些贡献共同建立了Instella-MoE作为一个强大、完全开放的MoE模型高效、高性能和可复现研究的基础。

articles.title: When Features Become Instances: Inverted Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Feature Selection
articles.abstract: Unsupervised feature selection seeks a compact subset of informative features without access to class labels, making feature utility difficult to define. Existing UFS methods therefore rely on indirect structural criteria, such as similarity preservation, locality, sparsity, cluster geometry, or reconstruction quality. In this paper, we instead study UFS through representation consistency and propose Inverted Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Feature Selection (ICLFS), a feature-wise contrastive framework that reformulates UFS as a representation learning problem over features rather than samples. ICLFS first inverts the data matrix so that each feature is represented by its sample-profile vector, then constructs multiple masked positive views together with a shuffled negative view, and learns projector-space representations that remain consistent across these structured perturbations under an InfoNCE-based objective. Motivated by recent findings that cosine-based and InfoNCE-based training affect embedding norms, we use projector-space embedding magnitude as the saliency signal for ranking features. The resulting norm-based ranking is subsequently refined through Laplacian-Gated Ranking Correction, which suppresses locally redundant candidates while preserving salient ones. Extensive experiments on 12 benchmark datasets show that ICLFS achieves the best clustering accuracy on 10 datasets against both classical and neural baselines under the standard clustering-based UFS evaluation protocol, while remaining competitive on the other two. These results show that feature-wise contrastive representation consistency provides a strong and effective alternative to neighborhood, cluster, and reconstruction-based UFS formulations.
articles.titleCn: 特征成为实例时：用于无监督特征选择的反向对比学习
articles.abstractCn: 无监督特征选择在不获取类别标签的情况下寻求信息丰富的特征紧凑子集，使得特征效用难以定义。因此，现有的无监督特征选择（UFS）方法依赖于间接的结构性标准，例如相似性保持、局部性、稀疏性、聚类几何形状或重建质量。在本文中，我们通过表征一致性来研究UFS，并提出了一种基于特征对比的无监督特征选择（ICLFS）框架，该框架将UFS重新定义为特征而非样本上的表征学习问题。ICLFS首先对数据矩阵进行反转，以便每个特征由其样本轮廓向量表示，然后构建多个带掩码的正视图，并添加一个打乱顺序的负视图，并在基于InfoNCE的目标下学习在结构化扰动下保持一致的投影空间表征。受最近发现的基于余弦和InfoNCE的训练会影响嵌入范数的启发，我们使用投影空间嵌入幅度作为特征排序的显著性信号。得到的基于范数的排序随后通过拉普拉斯门控排序校正进行细化，该校正抑制局部冗余候选者，同时保留显著候选者。在12个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，在标准的基于聚类的UFS评估协议下，ICLFS在10个数据集上相对于经典和神经基线实现了最佳的聚类精度，同时在另外两个数据集上保持竞争力。这些结果表明，基于特征的对比表征一致性为基于邻域、聚类和重建的UFS公式提供了一个强大而有效的替代方案。

articles.title: A Unified Mechanistic Analysis of Knowledge- and Safety-Based Refusals
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained to decline queries that fall outside their knowledge (knowledge-based refusal, KR) or violate safety policies (safety-based refusal, SR). Although KR and SR result in superficially similar responses, they have largely been studied in isolation, leaving open whether they share an underlying mechanism. We address this gap with a systematic study on a new dataset of 213 contrastive quadruples that jointly probe both refusal types. We find that KR and SR are governed by overlapping yet distinguishable mechanisms. Both share a refusal direction, yet the overlap is asymmetric: SR signals transfer more strongly to KR than the reverse. Type-specific specialization emerges mainly in upper layers, with KR aligning with uncertainty- and knowledge-related representations and SR with safety- and policy-related ones. We thus characterize refusal as a commit-then-specify process: a shared initial mechanism commits to refusing, then type-specific features in later layers specify whether the grounds are epistemic or normative.
articles.titleCn: 基于知识与安全拒绝的统一机制分析
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被训练以拒绝超出其知识范围（基于知识的拒绝，KR）或违反安全政策（基于安全的拒绝，SR）的查询。尽管KR和SR会导致表面上相似的响应，但它们基本上是独立研究的，留下了它们是否共享潜在机制的问题悬而未决。我们通过在一个包含213个对比四元组的新数据集上进行系统研究来填补这一空白，这些数据集共同探测了两种拒绝类型。我们发现KR和SR受重叠但可区分的机制所支配。两者共享拒绝方向，但重叠是不对称的：SR向KR的信号传递比反向更强。类型特定的专业化主要在上层出现，KR与不确定性和知识相关的表示对齐，而SR与安全性和政策相关的表示对齐。因此，我们将拒绝描述为一个“先承诺后具体化”的过程：一个共享的初始机制承诺拒绝，然后在后续层中的类型特定特征指定理由是认知性的还是规范性的。

articles.title: Compile, Don't Memorize: A Context Compilation Architecture (CCA) for In-Context Learning
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly handle in-context learning (ICL) tasks where a long, novel context defines the rules, knowledge, and output schema for a series of questions. On benchmarks that grade against every detail of the context, even strong open-weights models pass only 12-16% of tasks: a single overlooked rule fails the whole response. We argue this brittleness is structural: the dominant "read-and-reason" paradigm asks the model to extract, plan, generate, and self-verify in one forward pass. We therefore ask whether explicit context compilation can fix it, how it compares to existing long-context strategies (gist retrieval, multi-agent self-play), and where the resulting harness benefit holds across task structure and model scale. We propose the Context Compilation Architecture (CCA), whose central novelty is a typed intermediate representation (IR) with fixed slots (rules.{must_do, must_not, conditional}, output_spec, available_tools, data_profile) into which any prose context is compiled once; executable verifiers and a violation-gated correction loop follow as downstream consequences. On CL-bench (1,899 tasks across 4 open base models), CCA outperforms vanilla prompting and two long-context baselines (ReadAgent-P, Ctx2Skill) on every base model, lifting Kimi K2.5 from 15.4% to 21.4% with gains concentrated on rule-dense sub-categories. Code and cached completions are available at https://github.com/TonyQJH/cca-emnlp2026.
articles.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Findings). Code, data, and cached completions available at https://github.com/TonyQJH/cca-emnlp2026
articles.titleCn: 编译而非记忆：面向情境学习的上下文编译架构（CCA）
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地处理情境学习（ICL）任务，其中长而新颖的上下文定义了一系列问题的规则、知识和输出模式。在针对上下文每个细节进行评分的基准测试中，即使是强大的开放权重模型也仅通过12-16%的任务：单个被忽视的规则就会导致整个响应失败。我们认为这种脆弱性是结构性的：主导的“读取和推理”范式要求模型在一次前向传递中提取、规划、生成和自我验证。因此，我们探究显式上下文编译是否能解决这个问题，它如何与现有的长上下文策略（摘要检索、多智能体自我博弈）进行比较，以及由此产生的 harness 好处是否能在任务结构和模型规模上保持一致。我们提出了上下文编译架构（CCA），其核心创新是一个带固定槽位的类型化中间表示（IR）（规则.{必须做、必须不做、条件性}、输出规范、可用工具、数据概况），任何散文式上下文都可以一次性编译到其中；可执行的验证器和违规门控的修正循环作为下游结果随之而来。在CL-bench（跨越4个开放基础模型的1,899个任务）上，CCA在所有基础模型上都优于纯提示和两个长上下文基线（ReadAgent-P、Ctx2Skill），将Kimi K2.5的成绩从15.4%提升到21.4%，且收益集中在规则密集的子类别上。代码和缓存完成结果可在https://github.com/TonyQJH/cca-emnlp2026获取。

articles.title: Joint Training Is Not Enough: Conditioned Cross-Granularity Training for Multimodal Document Understanding
articles.abstract: The Mutual Reinforcement Effect (MRE) asks whether a fine, span-level and a coarse, document-level task help each other when one model handles both. We test it in multimodal document understanding on three corpora, two of receipts and one of scanned business forms, comparing single-task, joint and conditioned training, which puts one granularity's gold output in the other's prompt during training only. We build Doc-MRE, an annotation layer pairing gold field extraction (point) with four document-level facets (line), from a three-judge LLM committee under a pre-registration, validated by blind re-annotation. One predicate, fixed in advance: at a shared recipe, a regime reinforces if it beats the matched single-task model on both granularities. Mixed joint training, the arrangement prior MRE work assumes, reinforces on no corpus at the main scale: it is below both single-task models on CORD and trades one granularity for the other on the two others, as single-task tuning does. Conditioned training reinforces on two of the three, CORD (+0.5 point, +4.8 line) and the forms corpus (+7.2 point, +11.0 line), resolvably on the coarse side and directionally on the fine one, and trades on WildReceipt; at that recipe no alternative measurably beats it on either side anywhere. Two byte-identical-prompt controls separate content from format: shuffled conditioning destroys the coarse-side skill but costs the fine side far less, and a neutral-content control reproduces the whole fine-side gain on WildReceipt, which is therefore prompt structure but buys nothing resolvable on the other two. On the forms corpus conditioning buys collapse avoidance: mixed training and the neutral control both assign the majority semantic label to all 50 test documents; only conditioning recovers the gold distribution. Probes find the information decodable under every regime with no resolvable increase under conditioning.
articles.titleCn: 联合训练并不足够：用于多模态文档理解的带条件跨粒度训练
articles.abstractCn: 互惠强化效应（MRE）探究在单个模型处理细粒度（字段级）和粗粒度（文档级）任务时，这两种任务是否能够相互促进。我们在三个语料库上进行了多模态文档理解的测试，其中两个是收据语料库，一个是扫描的商务表单语料库，比较了单任务、联合训练和条件训练，条件训练在训练过程中将一种粒度的金标准输出放入另一种粒度的提示中。我们构建了Doc-MRE，这是一个标注层，将金标准字段提取（点）与四个文档级方面（行）配对，由一个三法官的大型语言模型委员会在预先注册下进行标注，并通过盲法重新标注进行验证。一个谓词，预先固定：在共享的配方下，如果它在两种粒度上都能击败匹配的单任务模型，则该体系会强化。混合联合训练，MRE工作之前所假设的安排，在主要规模上没有语料库得到强化：它在CORD上低于两个单任务模型，并在其他两个语料库上用一种粒度换取另一种粒度，就像单任务微调一样。条件训练在三个语料库中的两个上得到强化，CORD（+0.5点，+4.8行）和表单语料库（+7.2点，+11.0行），在粗粒度上可解决，在细粒度上具有方向性，并在WildReceipt上有所权衡；在那个配方下，没有其他替代方案在任何方面都显著优于它。两个字节相同的提示控制将内容与格式分开：打乱条件训练破坏了粗粒度技能，但对细粒度的影响要小得多，而一个中性内容控制复制了WildReceipt上整个细粒度的收益，因此是提示结构，但在其他两个语料库上没有可解决的收益。在表单语料库上，条件训练避免了崩溃：混合训练和中性控制都将多数语义标签分配给所有50个测试文档；只有条件训练恢复了金标准分布。探针发现，在每种制度下信息都是可解码的，在条件训练下没有可解决的增加。

articles.title: How Do Language Models Choose Between Context and Memory?
articles.abstract: When contextual information conflicts with the knowledge stored in model parameters, activation directions can be used to decode and steer which source the model follows. However, steering along a direction does not establish causality: whether the unedited model would naturally use that direction or whether the direction is reusable across tasks. We test these distinctions through counterfactual experiments in unambiguous settings. First, we estimate authority directions from agreement prompts, in which the context and parametric knowledge support the same answer. We then interchange naturally occurring coordinates along these directions between matched prompts that direct the model to prioritize either the supplied context or its parametric knowledge. Across Qwen, Llama, and OLMo models, this intervention reproduces 30-68% of the authority-induced shift in source choice, whereas matched controls reproduce almost none. To test cross-task reuse, we learn authority directions on two tasks separately and see that cross-task transferability closes only 9% of the authority gap while the local direction learned on the given task closes 57%. These results distinguish authority representation, causal use, and cross-task causal reuse, and suggest that authority computations may be task-dependent, rather than reusable across tasks.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型如何选择上下文与记忆？
articles.abstractCn: 当情境信息与模型参数中存储的知识发生冲突时，激活方向可用于解码和引导模型遵循哪个信息来源。然而，沿着某个方向进行引导并不能建立因果关系：未编辑的模型是否自然地会使用该方向，或者该方向是否能在不同任务中重复使用。我们通过在明确情境下的反事实实验来检验这些区别。首先，我们从协议提示中估计权威方向，在这些提示中，情境和参数化知识支持相同的答案。然后，我们在这些方向上交换自然坐标，这些方向分别对应于引导模型优先考虑提供情境或其参数化知识的匹配提示。在Qwen、Llama和OLMo模型中，这种干预重现了30-68%的权威引起的来源选择变化，而匹配对照几乎未重现任何变化。为了测试跨任务重复使用性，我们在两个任务上分别学习权威方向，发现跨任务可迁移性仅缩小了9%的权威差距，而给定任务上学习的局部方向缩小了57%。这些结果区分了权威表示、因果使用和跨任务因果重复使用，并表明权威计算可能是任务依赖的，而不是跨任务可重复使用的。

articles.title: Measuring Optimal Transport in Transformer Depth
articles.abstract: A transformer carries each token's state from layer to layer, and the whole vocabulary carried together forms a cloud that moves with depth. We ask whether a trained network moves this cloud the way optimal transport would: at the cheapest cost, and along the map that pairs each token with its optimal destination. We measure both on Pythia-160m and Pythia-410m, with an exact assignment between consecutive layer clouds, a measured sampling floor, calibration on couplings known to be optimal, and a split of the cost into the common shift of the cloud and the token-specific moves. At the last layer, both models move their tokens where the optimal-transport map sends them, at the optimal cost for Pythia-410m and slightly above it for Pythia-160m. At the first layer they do not. In between, single layers can be judged on cost at only two of ten transitions, and blocks of several layers move the cloud at close to the optimal cost. The agreement at the last layer is much weaker at initialisation (0.64 against 0.86) and grows with training.
articles.titleCn: 在Transformer深度中测量最优传输
articles.abstractCn: 一个transformer将每个token的状态从一层传递到另一层，整个词汇一起携带形成的云随着深度移动。我们探究训练好的网络是否像最优传输那样移动这个云：以最低成本，并沿着将每个token与其最优目的地配对的映射。我们在Pythia-160m和Pythia-410m上进行了测量，包括连续层云之间的精确分配、测量的采样下限、对已知最优的耦合进行校准，并将成本分为云的公共移动和特定token的移动。在最后一层，两个模型都将它们的token移动到最优传输映射指示的位置，Pythia-410m以最优成本移动，而Pythia-160m略高于最优成本。在第一层则没有。在中间层，单个层只在十个转换中的两个上根据成本进行评判，而多层块以接近最优成本移动云。最后一层的吻合度在初始化时较弱（0.64对比0.86），并随着训练而增强。

articles.title: Can Large Language Models Forecast What Researchers Study Next?
articles.abstract: Large language models increasingly generate research ideas, yet judging their novelty or feasibility at generation time does not establish whether they anticipate subsequent work. We introduce IdeaForecastBench to evaluate research idea forecasting. Given a community's literature up to a cutoff, a system produces up to five ranked ideas, which are evaluated against later papers. The benchmark comprises 624 rolling episodes across 52 topics, with a fixed retrieve-then-judge protocol and separately reported results from two judges. We compare five history-compression strategies across GPT-4.1, Qwen2.5-7B/14B, and Qwen3.5-9B, together with a learned Mode-Decomposition Forecaster (MDF). Under the primary GPT-4.1-mini judge, Summary improves on Direct in Hit@5 and Precision@5 across all four backbones. Qwen2.5 scores above GPT-4.1, whereas Qwen3.5 scores below it. An outcome-blind assessment finds that Qwen2.5 produces broader forecasts, but does not identify how much breadth contributes to its advantage. Threshold and judge diagnostics further clarify the limits of interpreting realization as precise anticipation. IdeaForecastBench provides a common task for studying which research ideas a community subsequently pursues and how reliably this outcome can be measured.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型能否预测研究人员接下来会研究什么？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地生成研究想法，然而在生成时判断其新颖性或可行性并不能确定它们是否预见了后续工作。我们引入IdeaForecastBench来评估研究想法预测。给定一个社区截止日期前的文献，系统会生成最多五个排序后的想法，这些想法随后被与后续论文进行评估。该基准包含52个主题下的624个滚动场景，采用固定的检索后判断协议，并分别报告了两位评委的结果。我们在GPT-4.1、Qwen2.5-7B/14B和Qwen3.5-9B上比较了五种历史压缩策略，以及一个学习型模式分解预测器（MDF）。在主要的GPT-4.1-mini评委下，Summary在所有四种主干架构的Hit@5和Precision@5上均优于Direct。Qwen2.5得分高于GPT-4.1，而Qwen3.5得分低于它。结果无偏评估发现，Qwen2.5生成的预测范围更广，但并未确定其优势有多少归因于这种广度。阈值和评委诊断进一步阐明了将实现解读为精确预见的局限性。IdeaForecastBench为研究社区随后会追求哪些研究想法以及如何可靠地衡量这一结果提供了一个共同任务。

articles.title: ChatDev 2.0: A No-Code Multi-Agent Platform for Developing Everything
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, yet their development forces a tradeoff: code frameworks are expressive but engineering-intensive, while no-code builders simplify authoring but constrain agent interactions to author-defined workflows. We present ChatDev 2.0: DevAll (hereafter DevAll), a no-code platform for building, executing, and inspecting heterogeneous MAS that delivers both high expressiveness and ease of use. In terms of expressiveness, DevAll pairs a declarative executable graph abstraction with a cycle-aware execution engine, so that heterogeneous agents and dynamic and cyclic interactions can be represented and executed within a single framework. For ease of use, an integrated visual interface lets users author, run, monitor, and inspect MAS, including human-in-the-loop steps, entirely without writing code. Experiments demonstrate that DevAll reproduces state-of-the-art MAS across three representative tasks at competitive performance and without task-specific orchestration code, highlighting its effectiveness as a general-purpose platform for LLM-based MAS. DevAll is available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev.
articles.titleCn: ChatDev 2.0：一个用于开发一切的无代码多智能体平台
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）在解决复杂任务方面展现出巨大潜力，但其发展迫使一种权衡：代码框架表达能力强但工程复杂度高，而无代码构建工具简化了创作但将智能体交互限制在作者定义的工作流程中。我们提出了ChatDev 2.0：DevAll（以下简称DevAll），一个用于构建、执行和检查异构MAS的无代码平台，兼具高表达性和易用性。在表达性方面，DevAll将声明式可执行图抽象与循环感知执行引擎相结合，使得异构智能体和动态及循环交互可以在单一框架内表示和执行。在易用性方面，一个集成的可视化界面允许用户完全无需编写代码即可创作、运行、监控和检查MAS，包括人机交互步骤。实验表明，DevAll在三个代表性任务中复现了当前最先进的MAS，性能具有竞争力且无需任务特定的编排代码，突显了其作为通用LLM基MAS平台的有效性。DevAll可在https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev获取。

articles.title: Controllable Image Captioning with Prompt-Conditioned Scene Rewards
articles.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models produce fluent image descriptions but offer limited semantic control: users cannot reliably specify whether captions should emphasize attributes, relations, or particular image regions. We present Fine-grained Captioning Control Using Scene Rewards (FoCUS), a controllable image captioning method that lets users steer captions toward specific semantic emphases through natural-language control prompts. The core idea is a prompt-conditioned control objective based on scene-graph-aligned component scores. Generated captions are parsed and aligned to scene-graph components such as objects, attributes, and relations. These components are differentially weighted, including negative weights, according to the requested emphasis. We optimize this objective with GRPO and further improve its reliability through a stricter object validity threshold and reasoning-based verification for attribute and relation scoring. To evaluate controllability, we introduce Semantic Control and Precision Evaluation (SCoPE), a benchmark with contrastive Include/Avoid constraints for measuring both target content coverage and out-of-scope suppression. Experiments on two VLM backbones show that FoCUS consistently improves controllability and fine-grained caption quality without degrading general caption performance.
articles.comment: EMNLP 2026 Main (26 pages); Project website: https://focus-emnlp2026.github.io/
articles.titleCn: 基于提示条件场景奖励的可控图像描述
articles.abstractCn: 大型视觉语言模型能够生成流畅的图像描述，但语义控制能力有限：用户无法可靠地指定标题应强调属性、关系还是特定图像区域。我们提出了基于场景奖励的细粒度标题控制（FoCUS），这是一种可控的图像标题生成方法，允许用户通过自然语言控制提示引导标题朝向特定的语义强调方向。其核心思想是基于场景图对齐组件分数的提示条件控制目标。生成的标题将被解析并与场景图组件（如对象、属性和关系）对齐。这些组件根据请求的强调程度进行差异化加权，包括负权重。我们使用GRPO优化此目标，并通过更严格的物体有效性阈值以及基于推理的属性和关系评分验证来进一步提高其可靠性。为评估可控性，我们引入了语义控制和精确度评估（SCoPE）基准，该基准具有对比性的包含/排除约束，用于测量目标内容覆盖范围和范围外抑制。在两个VLM主干网络上的实验表明，FoCUS始终如一地提高了可控性和细粒度标题质量，同时未降低一般标题性能。

articles.title: A Certificate-Producing Cascade for Equational Implication: The SAIR EQT2 Stage 2 Solver
articles.abstract: The SAIR Mathematics Distillation Challenge on Equational Theories asks a solver to classify whether one magma identity implies another and, for either verdict, to return a certificate accepted by a deterministic Lean judge. We present a single-file solver organized as a cheapest-first cascade. Its false branch combines coefficient tests over structured algebra families, bounded finite-model search, an explicit central-groupoid witness, and several infinite-carrier witnesses. Its true branch is a proof-producing ordered unit superposition procedure with Knuth-Bendix ordering, bidirectional demodulation, indexing, memoised substitution, and anytime size deepening. Search results remain outside the trusted base: successful derivations are replayed as small Lean terms, and countermodels are rechecked by the competition judge. The frozen solver is a 189,504-byte Python file with SHA-256 f2392533c9f4c03b.... In local runs through official judge revision 2848228, it produced accepted certificates for all 1,889 rows of the six public sets with no language-model calls. Separate measurements recorded full agreement on the 800 published Stage 1 evaluation-distribution problems, 100 accepted rows in the canonical Marathon manifest without tokens, and 200 accepted rows in the hosted playground. These are regression and playground measurements, not a leaderboard result and not evidence about a hidden set. All quantitative claims are tied to immutable result ledgers; the paper makes no completeness or comparative-superiority claim.
articles.titleCn: 一个用于等式蕴涵的证书生成级联：SAIR EQT2 阶段 2 求解器
articles.abstractCn: SAIR数学精炼挑战（等式理论）要求求解者判断一个代数结构中的等式是否蕴含另一个等式，并对任何判断结果提供由确定性Lean裁判器接受的证明。我们提出了一种单文件求解器，采用最低成本级联结构。其错误分支结合了结构化代数家族的系数测试、有界有限模型搜索、显式的中心群系证明以及多个无限载体证明。其正确分支是一个使用Knuth-Bendix排序、双向去模化、索引、记忆化替换和随时深度扩展的证明生成有序单元叠加过程。搜索结果保留在可信基础之外：成功的推导被重播为小的Lean术语，反例由竞赛裁判器重新检查。冻结的求解器是一个189,504字节的Python文件，SHA-256哈希值为f2392533c9f4c03b....在官方裁判器版本2848228的本地运行中，它为六个公开数据集的1,889行全部生成了接受的证明，且未调用语言模型。单独的测量记录了与800个已发布的Stage 1评估分发问题完全一致的结果，在标准Marathon清单中无令牌的情况下接受了100行，在托管游乐场中接受了200行。这些是回归和游乐场测量结果，不是排行榜结果，也不是关于隐藏集的证据。所有定量声明都与不可变结果账本相关联；论文未提出完备性或比较优越性的声明。

articles.title: Value Over Language Model: Detecting Original Contribution in Writing
articles.abstract: LLMs have been rapidly adopted across writing tasks, prompting the development of tools for detecting LLM-generated text. Yet, these tools largely measure how much of a document's surface text was written by an LLM and aren't fundamentally designed to measure how much of the information content or ideas originated from the LLM itself rather than being supplied by the user in the prompt. In this work, we design a framework that measures how much value a person adds on top of what a language model could have easily produced by itself. The method requires no training or labeled data and never scores the document's surface text, insulating it from stylistic confounders. Instead, it extracts the document's content at increasing levels of granularity, uses an LLM to reconstruct the document from each partial representation, and compares these reconstructions with those produced from the task description alone. We call this framework Value Over Language Model (VOLM), which measures a document's contribution relative to a replacement-level document that an LLM could produce from the task description alone. We evaluate VOLM with a specific instantiation of this framework across three domains: news articles, ICLR peer reviews, and argumentative essays. VOLM separates human-authored documents from matched LLM-generated documents produced from generic task descriptions, while remaining substantially invariant to content-preserving transformations, including LLM-based reconstruction and round-trip translation. We further find that increasingly constrained content extractors reduce residual differences between LLM-generated and humanized text, demonstrating the importance of disentangling informational content from stylistic variation. We hope these results encourage further work on specialized instantiations of the framework and on assessing human contributions in LLM-assisted writing more generally.
articles.titleCn: 超越语言模型的价值：在写作中检测原创贡献
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型已迅速应用于各类写作任务，促使人们开发用于检测大型语言模型生成文本的工具。然而，这些工具主要衡量文档表面文本中有多少是由大型语言模型撰写的，并未从根本上设计用于衡量信息内容或观点中有多少源自大型语言模型本身，而非用户在提示中提供的内容。在本工作中，我们设计了一个框架，用于衡量个人在语言模型自身轻易就能生成的内容基础上增加了多少价值。该方法无需训练或标记数据，也从未对文档的表面文本进行评分，从而避免了风格上的混杂因素。相反，它以逐步增加的粒度提取文档内容，使用大型语言模型从每个部分表示中重建文档，并将这些重建结果与仅从任务描述中产生的重建结果进行比较。我们称这个框架为“超越语言模型的价值”（Value Over Language Model，VOLM），它衡量文档相对于大型语言模型仅从任务描述中就能生成的替代级文档的贡献。我们使用该框架的一个具体实例，在三个领域——新闻文章、ICLR同行评审和论证性文章——评估VOLM。VOLM能够区分人类撰写的文档与从通用任务描述中生成的匹配的大型语言模型生成文档，同时在内容保持转换（包括基于大型语言模型的重建和往返翻译）方面保持显著不变。我们进一步发现，越来越受约束的内容提取器减少了大型语言模型生成文本与人性化文本之间的残余差异，这证明了将信息内容与风格变化分离的重要性。我们希望这些结果能鼓励人们进一步研究框架的专门实例，以及更广泛地评估在大型语言模型辅助写作中的人类贡献。

articles.title: SCoNE: Selective Context-aware Neuron Editing for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is highly sensitive to retrieval noise: when retrieved documents mix informative and irrelevant context, LLMs are easily distracted, leading to hallucinations. To overcome this, we propose SCoNE (Selective Context-aware Neuron Editing), a training-free model editing approach that improves retrieval noise robustness by selectively strengthening context-aware FFN neurons that are identified by both high attribution and high cross-input variability. SCoNE requires only a small number of mining samples, no fine-tuning, and no inference-time overhead. Across various knowledge-intensive question-answering benchmarks and two LLM backbones, SCoNE consistently outperforms competitive baseline methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/HYU-ARK-Lab/SCoNE.
articles.titleCn: SCoNE：用于鲁棒检索增强生成的选择性上下文感知神经元编辑
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）对检索噪声非常敏感：当检索到的文档混合了信息和无关的上下文时，大型语言模型（LLMs）容易被干扰，导致产生幻觉。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了SCoNE（选择性上下文感知神经元编辑），这是一种无需训练的模型编辑方法，通过选择性地增强那些同时具有高归因度和高跨输入变异性的上下文感知FFN神经元，从而提高检索噪声的鲁棒性。SCoNE只需要少量挖掘样本，无需微调，也不会增加推理时的开销。在各种知识密集型问答基准测试和两种LLM主干网络上，SCoNE始终优于有竞争力的基线方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/HYU-ARK-Lab/SCoNE获取。

articles.title: Visual Framing for News Stance Detection via Image Generation
articles.abstract: Article-level news stance detection aims to identify the perspective of news articles toward social issues. Despite advances in stance detection and its importance for trustworthy media environments, news articles pose distinct challenges because their stances are often implicit, subtly conveyed through journalistic framing, and embedded in long, structurally complex texts. To address these challenges, we introduce VFStance, which leverages visual framing to make implicit stance cues more explicit via image generation. In evaluation experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of VFStance over existing methods and the contribution of visual framing to its performance. Finally, a controlled user study (N=200) in a snippet-based news consumption setting further demonstrates that VFStance can make stance signals visually salient and highlights its potential use beyond automated stance detection.
articles.titleCn: 基于图像生成的新闻立场检测中的视觉框架
articles.abstractCn: 文章级新闻立场检测旨在识别新闻报道对社会问题的立场。尽管立场检测技术取得了进步，并且对于可信赖的媒体环境至关重要，但新闻报道提出了独特的挑战，因为它们的立场通常隐含，通过新闻框架微妙传达，并嵌入在长而结构复杂的文本中。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了VFStance，该技术利用视觉框架通过图像生成使隐含的立场线索更加明确。在评估实验中，我们证明了VFStance相对于现有方法的有效性，以及视觉框架对其性能的贡献。最后，在一个基于片段的新闻消费环境中的受控用户研究（N=200）进一步证明，VFStance可以使立场信号在视觉上更加显著，并突出了其超越自动化立场检测的潜在应用价值。

articles.title: Creative Generation via Multi-Agent Debate: Does Debate Suppress Diversity?
articles.abstract: Creative generation tasks, such as narrative writing and scientific ideation, demand both high-quality outputs and distinct responses across independent runs to maximize exploration. Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) has shown strong quality gains on factual and reasoning tasks, making it a natural candidate for creative generation. However, we find its convergence-driven design actively suppresses output diversity across independent runs, creating an inherent trade-off with creative tasks. We theoretically show that preserving diversity among agents within each debate session is a necessary condition for achieving diverse outputs across independent runs. Building on this finding, we propose Creative-MAD, which introduces two synergistic interventions to sustain agent divergence. Specifically, Cognitive Lens Assignment counters identity drift by anchoring each agent to a distinct and persistent cognitive mode, while Embedding-based Peer Selection counters majority pull by limiting each agent's context to its most semantically distant peers. Experiments across four creative benchmarks demonstrate that Creative-MAD significantly enhances both lexical and semantic diversity while maintaining MAD's output quality.
articles.titleCn: 多智能体辩论生成创意：辩论是否抑制多样性？
articles.abstractCn: 创意生成任务，如叙事写作和科学构思，既要求高质量的输出，又需要在独立运行中产生不同的响应以最大化探索。多智能体辩论（MAD）在事实和推理任务上表现出显著的质量提升，使其成为创意生成的理想选择。然而，我们发现其基于收敛的设计会主动抑制独立运行中的输出多样性，与创意任务之间形成固有的权衡。我们通过理论分析表明，在每个辩论会话中保持智能体之间的多样性是实现独立运行中多样化输出的必要条件。基于这一发现，我们提出了Creative-MAD，该模型引入了两种协同干预措施以维持智能体分叉。具体而言，认知镜头分配通过将每个智能体锚定到独特且持续的认知模式来抵消身份漂移，而基于嵌入的同伴选择通过限制每个智能体的上下文仅限于其语义上最遥远的同伴来抵消多数人的拉扯。在四个创意基准测试中的实验表明，Creative-MAD显著提升了词汇和语义多样性，同时保持了MAD的输出质量。

articles.title: SciTrue: Reliable Scientific Claim Validation with Frontier and Open Language Models at the NTCIR SciClaimEval Task
articles.abstract: We describe the SciTrue team's participation in both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval task~\cite{sciclaimeval}, which asks systems to verify scientific claims against the tables and figures of a paper. Rather than tuning a single model, we benchmark eleven frontier and open multimodal models under one honest, per-sample protocol and combine them with light, transparent post-processing. On the official, blind test leaderboard (Section~\ref{sec:results}), SciTrue placed first by a clear margin in three of the four evidence-category/subtask combinations, and tied for first on the primary metric in the fourth. Three findings explain the result. First, strong instruction-tuned models are already competitive: Claude Opus~4.8 and Gemma-4-31B each exceed the strongest public baseline (o4-mini), and GPT-5.5 and Claude Fable~5 lead both subtasks (97.7 on Subtask~2). Second, the task's pairing structure is the largest lever: a \emph{leak-free pair prior} that recovers the Supported/Refuted pairing from the claim text alone (a visible field) and assigns Supported to the higher-confidence evidence raises Subtask-1 pair-accuracy from 72.2 to 93.5, far more than any model swap or ensemble weighting. Third, a case-by-case audit finds that most residual errors are visually-undetectable label-mapping swaps or dataset label noise, so measured accuracy understates the true ability and the fixable-by-modeling headroom is small. Controlled fine-tuning, distillation, and agentic consistency-checking support the same conclusions, and we document throughout a measurement leak---label information reaching a system through the packaging of the data rather than its content---in which the released file ordering encodes the label, including one instance that briefly misled our own pipeline.

articles.titleCn: SciTrue：在NTCIR SciClaimEval任务中使用前沿和开放语言模型进行可靠科学声明验证
articles.abstractCn: 我们描述了SciTrue团队参与NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval任务~\cite{sciclaimeval}的情况，该任务要求系统根据论文的表格和图表验证科学声明。我们没有调整单个模型，而是在一个诚实、按样本计算的协议下基准测试了十一个前沿和开源的多模态模型，并将它们与轻量级、透明的后处理相结合。在官方的盲测排行榜（第~\ref{sec:results}节）上，SciTrue在四个证据类别/子任务组合中的三个中均以显著优势位居第一，在第四个中与第一并列。三个发现解释了这一结果。首先，强大的指令微调模型已经具有竞争力：Claude Opus~4.8和Gemma-4-31B均超过了最强的公开基线（o4-mini），而GPT-5.5和Claude Fable~5在两个子任务中均领先（子任务2的得分为97.7）。其次，任务的对齐结构是最大的杠杆：一个无泄漏的对齐先验，它仅从声明文本（一个可见字段）中恢复支持/反驳的对齐，并将支持分配给更高置信度的证据，将子任务1的对齐准确率从72.2提高到93.5，这远超任何模型交换或集成权重。第三，逐个案例的审计发现，大多数残余错误都是视觉上无法检测的标签映射交换或数据集标签噪声，因此测量的准确率低估了真实能力，并且可以通过建模解决的余量很小。受控的微调、蒸馏和代理一致性检查支持相同的结论，我们在整个文档中记录了一个测量泄漏——标签信息通过数据包装而非内容到达系统——其中发布的文件顺序编码了标签，包括一个短暂误导了我们自己的管道的案例。

articles.title: It Takes Two to Match: Co-Evolving Generative Retriever with Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Retrieval is the first stage of modern search and advertising systems, selecting a candidate set from a large item universe for downstream ranking and auction. Recent work increasingly leverages LLMs to improve retrieval through query expansion, data synthesis, and retrieval-feedback training. However, the generative component is typically used for query-side augmentation, while final matching is still delegated to a downstream retriever. We introduce CoGR, a retrieval framework that instead trains LLMs to directly construct retrieval representations on both query and item sides. Each generator produces a compact set of keywords, which are matched directly through an inverted index, preserving compatibility with existing keyword-based retrieval infrastructure. CoGR uses a two-stage training pipeline. Supervised fine-tuning first establishes an aligned keyword space, after which co-evolving reinforcement learning alternately optimizes the query- and item-side generators with GRPO against the opposite side's frozen index. Both sides optimize the same query-to-item retrieval $F_1$ objective: the query side receives retrieval $F_1$ directly, while the item side receives a counterfactual marginal reward measuring the change in query-side $F_1$ caused by its generated keywords. Across 10 representative sparse, dense, and generative baselines, CoGR achieves the best performance on both an internal APP Marketplace dataset and the public WANDS benchmark, improving $F_1$ over the strongest baseline by $10.9\%$ and $36.1\%$, respectively. Further analysis shows stable co-evolution and increasingly aligned query--item keyword spaces over training.
articles.titleCn: 匹配需要两人：协同进化的生成式检索器与强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 检索是现代搜索和广告系统中的第一个阶段，它从庞大的物品宇宙中选择候选集，用于下游排序和竞价。近期的研究越来越多地利用大型语言模型（LLMs）通过查询扩展、数据合成和检索反馈训练来改进检索。然而，生成组件通常用于查询端的增强，而最终匹配仍然委托给下游检索器。我们介绍了CoGR，这是一个检索框架，它训练LLMs直接在查询端和物品端构建检索表示。每个生成器产生一组紧凑的关键词，这些关键词通过倒排索引直接匹配，从而保持与现有的基于关键词的检索基础设施的兼容性。CoGR使用两阶段训练流程。监督微调首先建立对齐的关键词空间，然后共进化强化学习交替地使用GRPO优化查询端和物品端的生成器，同时冻结另一端的索引。双方都优化相同的查询到物品检索$F_1$目标：查询端直接接收检索$F_1$，而物品端接收一个反事实边际奖励，该奖励衡量其生成关键词引起的查询端$F_1$的变化。在10个代表性的稀疏、密集和生成基线中，CoGR在内部APP Marketplace数据集和公开的WANDS基准上均取得了最佳性能，分别比最强的基线提高了$10.9\%$和$36.1\%$。进一步分析显示，在训练过程中存在稳定的共进化，并且查询-物品关键词空间越来越对齐。

articles.title: ExpArt-KG: Artwork Image Description Generation through Iterative Exploration of Knowledge Graphs
articles.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance on image-grounded text generation and visual question answering. However, it remains difficult for them to comprehensively and accurately describe the factual relations among the entities and concepts associated with the objects depicted in an image. In this work, we propose a framework that efficiently exploits factual information from a knowledge graph via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), with the goal of enabling LVLMs to generate detailed and accurate image explanations. Specifically, our method alternates between answer generation and knowledge-graph retrieval, and controls the search using a correctness judgment, thereby acquiring the necessary and sufficient factual information efficiently. We also construct a knowledge graph for the artwork domain (ExpArt-KG), in which the correspondence between images and entities is unambiguous. Applying the proposed method to this knowledge graph, we show experimentally that it improves the level of detail of artwork explanations and reduces the retrieval cost of external knowledge while maintaining generation quality comparable to that of iterating a fixed number of times.
articles.titleCn: ExpArt-KG：基于知识图谱迭代探索的艺术品图像描述生成
articles.abstractCn: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在基于图像的文本生成和视觉问答方面表现出色。然而，它们在全面准确地描述图像中描绘的对象相关实体和概念之间的事实关系方面仍存在困难。在这项工作中，我们提出一个框架，通过检索增强生成（RAG）高效地利用知识图谱中的事实信息，旨在使LVLMs能够生成详细准确的图像解释。具体而言，我们的方法在答案生成和知识图谱检索之间交替进行，并使用正确性判断来控制搜索，从而高效地获取必要且充分的事实信息。我们还构建了一个艺术作品领域的知识图谱（ExpArt-KG），其中图像与实体之间的对应关系是明确的。将所提出的方法应用于该知识图谱，我们通过实验表明，它提高了艺术作品解释的详细程度，同时降低了外部知识检索成本，同时保持了与固定迭代次数相当的生成质量。

articles.title: Trust Your Guide Only When Certain: Uncertainty-Aware Sparse Alignment at Inference Time
articles.abstract: A prominent paradigm in inference-time alignment employs lightweight supervisors to steer Large Language Models (LLMs). Through empirical analysis, we identify a structural mismatch in this paradigm: weak supervisors exhibit pervasive high entropy across the vast majority of tokens, yet prevailing dense intervention approaches mandate supervision at every decoding step. This leads to frequent low-confidence interventions that can disrupt valid base-model reasoning and incur substantial utility costs. To resolve this, we propose TUSA (Trust-based Uncertainty Sparse Alignment). Moving away from continuous oversight, TUSA reframes alignment as a dynamic arbitration process, introducing an uncertainty-aware arbiter that authorizes intervention only when two conditions are met: the supervisor is confident and the token is semantically salient. This mechanism effectively filters out uncertainty-driven noise and redundant supervision. Extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks show that TUSA consistently improves both safety alignment and general helpfulness. By bypassing approximately 50% of alignment steps, it not only enhances safety preference by up to 15.6%, but also boosts general preference rates by up to 12.0% compared to the dense baseline, demonstrating that selective, high-precision alignment can outperform continuous supervision.
articles.titleCn: 仅在确定时信任你的向导：推理时的不确定性感知稀疏对齐
articles.abstractCn: 推理时对齐的一个突出范例是采用轻量级监督器来引导大型语言模型（LLM）。通过实证分析，我们识别出该范例中存在结构性不匹配问题：弱监督器在整个大多数token上表现出普遍的高熵，而主流的密集干预方法却要求在每个解码步骤中进行监督。这导致频繁的低置信度干预，可能破坏有效的基础模型推理并产生巨大的效用成本。为解决这一问题，我们提出了基于信任的不确定性稀疏对齐（TUSA）。TUSA摒弃了持续监督，将对齐重新定义为动态仲裁过程，引入一个不确定性感知仲裁器，仅在满足两个条件时才授权干预：监督器具有置信度且token在语义上显著。该机制有效过滤了由不确定性驱动的噪声和冗余监督。在多个模型和基准测试中的大量实验表明，TUSA始终能提升安全对齐和通用有用性。通过绕过约50%的对齐步骤，它不仅将安全偏好提升了高达15.6%，而且相较于密集基线将通用偏好率提高了高达12.0%，证明选择性、高精度的对齐可以优于持续监督。

articles.title: Control-Data Flow Separation: Stable Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent LLMs
articles.abstract: Prompt optimization can improve multi-agent LLM systems, but the prompts being optimized often serve two entangled roles: generating task-relevant content and specifying execution-critical protocols, such as message routing, output formatting, and termination signals, on which the underlying code relies. As a result, a prompt edit intended to improve content generation can inadvertently corrupt the protocol and cause the entire agent pipeline to fail. Our key observation is that these two roles have different representations: execution protocols are typically structured, while task-relevant content is usually expressed in unstructured language. Based on this, we propose control-data flow separation, where execution-critical control is represented as typed, validated program objects, while task-relevant language remains the optimizable data flow for agent communication. This design allows optimizers to improve multi-agent behavior without exposing the routing or formatting interface to prompt drift. Across synthetic reasoning, collaborative review generation, and insurance rating workflows, our framework empirically achieves 100% eventual protocol validity while consistently improving task performance.
articles.titleCn: 控制-数据流分离：多智能体LLM中的稳定提示优化
articles.abstractCn: 提示优化可以改进多智能体大语言模型系统，但被优化的提示通常扮演着两个相互交织的角色：生成与任务相关的内容，以及指定执行关键协议，如消息路由、输出格式和终止信号，这些协议依赖于底层代码。因此，一个旨在改进内容生成的提示编辑可能会无意中破坏协议，导致整个智能体流程失败。我们的关键观察是，这两个角色具有不同的表示形式：执行协议通常是结构化的，而与任务相关的內容则通常以非结构化语言表达。基于这一点，我们提出了控制数据流分离方案，其中执行关键控制被表示为带类型的、经过验证的程序对象，而与任务相关的语言则作为智能体通信的可优化数据流。这种设计允许优化器在不暴露路由或格式接口给提示漂移的情况下，改进多智能体行为。在合成推理、协作评审生成和保险评级工作流程中，我们的框架在实证中实现了100%最终协议有效性，同时持续提升任务性能。

articles.title: Investigating Assistant Bias in LLM User Simulators Using a Role Vector
articles.abstract: LLM-based user simulators are increasingly used to evaluate autonomous agents at scale, in place of costly human evaluations. Despite this promise, these simulators exhibit "assistant bias," a tendency to cooperate and pursue task goals. They rarely reproduce the frustration or disengagement that real users exhibit, compromising evaluation validity. Prior work outlines that this bias is baked in during model training, which role-playing prompts fail to override. We analyze this bias from model activations, extracting a user role vector by contrasting how the model represents user versus assistant perspectives on the same dialogue. We observe two findings: (i) the user direction is identifiable in activations, elicits user-like behaviors, and captures characteristics distinct from assistant traits; and (ii) although user-role activation associates with simulation realism and steering strengthens it, it can exaggerate user behaviors and override individual user profiles. Together, our findings provide a representation-level analysis of LLM user simulators, confirming that assistant bias is structurally identifiable and that user behavior can be directionally analyzed.
articles.titleCn: 使用角色向量调查LLM用户模拟器中的助手偏差
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型的用户模拟器越来越多地被用于大规模评估自主代理，以替代昂贵的人工评估。尽管有此前景，但这些模拟器表现出“助手偏差”，即倾向于合作和追求任务目标。它们很少再现真实用户所表现出的挫败感或脱离状态，从而损害了评估的有效性。先前的研究表明，这种偏差在模型训练过程中就已嵌入，而角色扮演提示无法改变这一点。我们从模型激活中分析这种偏差，通过对比模型在相同对话中如何代表用户和助手视角来提取用户角色向量。我们观察到两个发现：(i) 用户方向在激活中可识别，能引发类似用户的行为，并捕捉到与助手特征不同的特性；(ii) 虽然用户角色激活与模拟真实性相关，且引导会加强它，但它可能夸大用户行为并覆盖个体用户特征。综合来看，我们的研究为基于大型语言模型的用户模拟器提供了表示层面的分析，证实了助手偏差在结构上是可识别的，并且用户行为可以进行方向性分析。

articles.title: Confess What You Know: Forget-Set Misalignment with Model Knowledge in LLM Unlearning
articles.abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) often assumes that a pre-defined forget set matches what the model has memorized, but this frequently breaks in realistic privacy settings where the original training data is inaccessible. We term this gap forget-set misalignment and identify two cases. In Under Unlearning, the forget set omits memorized information and leakage persists. In Out-of-Knowledge Unlearning, the algorithm is driven to "forget" knowledge the model never learned, perturbing parameters and degrading utility. Using gradient-level analysis, we show these behaviors arise from misaligned unlearning targets rather than specific optimization choices. We then propose CONfession-to-Forget-Set (CONFS), a data-blind framework that constructs model-aligned forget sets by eliciting and formalizing the model's memorized knowledge. Across synthetic, multimodal, and real-world benchmarks, CONFS approaches Gold-standard performance on several metrics and achieves a competitive forgetting-utility balance, while preserving utility better than other data-blind forget-set constructions.
