articles.titleCn: 承认你所知道的：LLM去学习中的模型知识与遗忘-设置不匹配
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的机器卸载通常假设预定义的遗忘集与模型记忆的内容相匹配，但在原始训练数据无法获取的现实隐私环境下，这种情况经常失效。我们将这种差距称为遗忘集不匹配，并识别出两种情况。在“卸载下”情况中，遗忘集遗漏了记忆信息，泄露依然存在；在“知识外卸载”情况中，算法被驱动去“遗忘”模型从未学习过的知识，导致参数扰动和效用下降。通过梯度级分析，我们表明这些行为源于不匹配的卸载目标，而非特定的优化选择。随后，我们提出了“向遗忘集坦白”（CONFS）框架，这是一个数据无关的框架，通过引出和形式化模型记忆的知识来构建模型匹配的遗忘集。在合成、多模态和真实世界基准测试中，CONFS在多个指标上接近黄金标准性能，实现了遗忘-效用之间的竞争性平衡，同时比其他数据无关的遗忘集构建方法更好地保留了效用。

articles.title: Quit While You're Ahead: Quit for Efficient Candidate Generation in Machine Translation Reranking
articles.abstract: Reranking methods, such as Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding and Quality Estimation (QE) reranking, are widely used in modern neural machine translation (NMT) to select an output from a set of candidate hypotheses. However, the performance gains come at the cost of high inference latency. Existing acceleration methods target MBR decoding and reduce only reranking computation, leaving QE reranking unaddressed and candidate generation---which can be the larger computational bottleneck---largely untouched. In this work, we propose Quit (Quantifying Uncertainty for Incremental Termination), a novel early-stopping strategy for the entire generation--reranking pipeline. Viewing candidate generation as a sequential decision under uncertainty, Quit incrementally generates and reranks candidates, stopping when the highest estimated quality in the candidate set stabilizes. Comprehensive experiments on three NMT models across 19 language pairs show that Quit yields end-to-end speedups of $1.47$--$2.66\times$ for MBR and $3.43$--$4.12\times$ for QE reranking while preserving translation quality within prespecified equivalence margins.
articles.titleCn: 领先时退出：用于机器翻译重排序的高效候选生成
articles.abstractCn: 重排序方法，如最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）解码和质量估计（QE）重排序，在现代神经机器翻译（NMT）中被广泛用于从一组候选假设中选择输出。然而，性能提升是以高推理延迟为代价的。现有的加速方法针对MBR解码，仅减少重排序计算，未解决QE重排序问题，且对候选生成——这可能是更大的计算瓶颈——基本未做处理。在这项工作中，我们提出了Quit（用于增量终止的不确定性量化），一种针对整个生成-重排序流程的新型提前停止策略。将候选生成视为在不确定性下的序列决策，Quit逐级生成和重排序候选，当候选集中的最高估计质量稳定时停止。在19种语言对上的三个NMT模型上的综合实验表明，Quit在保持翻译质量在预设等价范围内的同时，为MBR重排序带来了1.47--2.66倍的端到端加速，为QE重排序带来了3.43--4.12倍的端到端加速。

articles.title: Enoki: Efficient Multi-Level Hallucination Detection
articles.abstract: Ensuring factuality remains a critical challenge for deploying LLMs in high-stakes settings. Existing hallucination detectors usually operate at a single level: claim-level methods provide interpretable factual units, while span-level methods localize unsupported text. Bridging these views is costly, as LLM-heavy pipelines require multiple decomposition and verification calls, and modular systems need additional claim-to-span alignment. We propose Enoki, an Open Information Extraction framework for multi-level hallucination detection. Enoki extracts text-anchored relational facts, verifies them against evidence, and projects unsupported facts back to hallucinated spans. This shared representation enables claim-level verification and span-level localization without requiring separate alignment. Enoki supports LLM-based, encoder-based, and rule-based extraction regimes, balancing accuracy and inference cost through a common interface. Experiments show that Enoki remains competitive with strong claim-level systems while using fewer resources and achieves superior performance on fine-grained span- and entity-level localization. We also release EnokiQA, a dual-granularity dataset with aligned claim-level verification and span-level localization annotations.
articles.titleCn: Enoki：高效多级幻觉检测
articles.abstractCn: 确保事实准确性仍然是部署大型语言模型（LLMs）在高风险环境中的关键挑战。现有的幻觉检测器通常在单一层面运行：声明级方法提供可解释的事实单元，而跨度级方法定位不支持文本。弥合这些观点的成本很高，因为LLM密集型管道需要多次分解和验证调用，而模块化系统需要额外的声明到跨度对齐。我们提出了Enoki，一个用于多级幻觉检测的开源信息抽取框架。Enoki提取文本锚定的关系事实，将其与证据进行验证，并将不受支持的事实投影回幻觉跨度。这种共享表示使得无需单独对齐即可进行声明级验证和跨度级定位。Enoki支持基于LLM、基于编码器和基于规则的抽取模式，通过统一接口平衡准确性和推理成本。实验表明，Enoki在使用更少资源的同时，与强大的声明级系统保持竞争力，并在细粒度的跨度和实体级定位上实现了优越性能。我们还发布了EnokiQA，这是一个具有对齐的声明级验证和跨度级定位标注的双粒度数据集。

articles.title: Predicting Program Exit Code with LLMs and Programming Language Semantics
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown proficiency in various software engineering tasks, such as code generation and translation. However, a key limitation in their performance may be their (lack of) understanding of programming-language semantics. Even when explicit semantics are given, it remains unclear whether LLMs apply those rules or lean on priors learned during pre-training instead. We study if LLMs lean on priors or given semantics with a novel task--Program Executability Prediction (PrEx)--that asks models to predict whether a program is semantically valid or invalid (and, if invalid, which formal rule it violates) given the program's syntax and operational semantics. Because PrEx requires both valid and invalid programs, we build a dataset with systematically generated invalid transformations derived from valid programs. We evaluate open-source coding LLMs under two semantic formalisms and two semantic shifts across Human-Written, LLM-Translated, and Fuzzer-Generated program splits. Our findings show that LLMs lean on pre-training priors rather than systematically applying the given rules, performing especially poorly on modified semantics and degrading further as program complexity increases. PrEx is available at https://github.com/EngineeringSoftware/prex.
articles.titleCn: 使用大型语言模型和编程语言语义预测程序退出代码
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在代码生成和翻译等多种软件工程任务中表现出色，但它们性能的关键限制可能在于对编程语言语义的理解（或缺乏理解）。即使提供了明确的语义，仍不清楚LLMs是应用这些规则还是依赖预训练期间学到的先验知识。我们通过一项新任务——程序可执行性预测（PrEx）——来研究LLMs是依赖先验知识还是给定语义，该任务要求模型根据程序的语法和操作语义预测程序在语义上是否有效（以及，如果无效，违反了哪个形式规则）。由于PrEx需要有效和无效的程序，我们构建了一个数据集，其中包含从有效程序系统生成的无效转换。我们在两种语义形式化和两种语义转换下，对开源编码LLMs在人类编写、LLM翻译和模糊器生成的程序分割中进行了评估。我们的研究发现，LLMs依赖预训练的先验知识而非系统地应用给定规则，在修改后的语义上表现尤其差，并且随着程序复杂性的增加性能进一步下降。PrEx可在https://github.com/EngineeringSoftware/prex获取。

articles.title: Consistency Without Alignment: Item-Sensitive Language Models Indistinguishable From Random
articles.abstract: Item-sensitivity, defined as whether a model's choice depends on the specific input rather than on its own output prior, is widely reported as evidence of task competence. We show this evidence is necessary but not sufficient using a forced-choice signalling task abstracted from the board game Deception: Murder in Hong Kong. In this environment, the reference points against which a coordinate should be judged (a fit-maximising strategy, a posterior-maximising strategy, and uniform random selection) are all computable in closed form. Across seven language models, two model families, a post-training ablation, and three independent scoring rules, every one of 21 model-by-rule cells is reliably item-sensitive. Yet 8 of those 21 cells are not statistically distinguishable from a chooser that ignores the item and selects at random, and 5 score worse than random at describing the target. Item-sensitivity and distance from random correlate at only r = 0.30. We call this consistency without alignment and argue it generalises to any evaluation that relies on item-sensitivity, permutation consistency, or self-consistency without an independent reference for the measured quantity. We further find that a literal-similarity baseline with no pragmatics outperforms most tested language models, that adding a pragmatic layer over two baseline similarity sources moves choosers toward random rather than toward the Bayesian reference, and that a standard labelled multiple-choice format carries no measurable content signal here. All results represent the model side of a pre-registered instrument; a matched human condition is designed and piloted but not yet collected.
articles.titleCn: 无对齐的一致性：与随机无法区分的项敏感语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 项目敏感性，定义为模型的选择是否取决于特定输入而非其自身的先验输出，被广泛报道为任务能力的证据。我们使用源自桌游《香港谋杀：欺骗》中的强制选择信号任务，证明这一证据是必要的但不充分。在这个环境中，用于判断坐标的参考点（即最大化拟合策略、最大化后验策略和均匀随机选择）均可解析计算。在七个语言模型、两个模型家族、一个后训练消融实验和三种独立评分规则中，21个模型-规则单元中的每一个都表现出可靠的项目敏感性。然而，其中的21个单元中有8个在统计上无法与忽略项目并随机选择的决策者区分开来，还有5个在描述目标时得分低于随机水平。项目敏感性与随机距离的相关系数仅为r=0.30。我们称之为一致性而无对齐，并认为它适用于任何依赖项目敏感性、排列一致性或自我一致性但缺乏独立测量参考量的评估。我们进一步发现，一个没有语用学的字面相似度基线优于大多数测试的语言模型，在两个基线相似度来源上添加语用层会使决策者更倾向于随机而非贝叶斯参考，而标准的标记多项选择题格式在此处不携带可测量的内容信号。所有结果代表了一个预先注册工具的模型方面；一个匹配的人类条件已被设计和试点，但尚未收集。

articles.title: Aligned but Flattened: Analyzing the Trade-off between Cultural Alignment and Diversity in LLMs
articles.abstract: Cultural fine-tuning has become the de facto paradigm for building culture-aware large language models (LLMs), yet existing optimization exclusively for alignment scores provides an incomplete portrait of cultural fidelity by systematically obscuring inherent cultural diversity. This unidimensional evaluation lens prompts a fundamental question: do models genuinely perceive distinct cultural nuances, or do they merely memorize dominant cultural values? To address this, we propose a synergistic evaluation framework that jointly formalizes cultural alignment and diversity. Through extensive benchmarking of six mainstream LLMs on the World Values Survey, this framework uncovers a systematic and critical trade-off: the pursuit of cultural alignment consistently incurs an acute expense of diversity, leading to severe "cultural flattening." Investigating this behavioral shift, we demonstrate that these superficial alignment gains stem from models artificially anchoring to dominant majorities, converging onto a monolithic response pattern that wipes out the heterogeneous distributions inherent to human groups. Crucially, our mechanistic analysis suggests that this diversity collapse is not merely a behavioral anomaly but more likely a structural consequence of the low-rank bias inherent in neural network optimization. Therefore, our findings expose the limitations of current post-training paradigms and call for a shift toward alignment objectives that preserve cross-cultural pluralism.
articles.titleCn: 对齐但扁平化：分析大型语言模型中文化对齐与多样性之间的权衡
articles.abstractCn: 文化微调已成为构建文化感知型大型语言模型（LLMs）的默认范式，然而现有的优化方法仅针对对齐分数进行优化，通过系统性地掩盖内在的文化多样性，无法全面展现文化保真度。这种单维度的评估视角引发了一个根本性问题：模型是否真正感知到不同的文化细微差别，还是仅仅在记忆主导的文化价值观？为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种协同评估框架，将文化对齐和文化多样性联合形式化。通过对六种主流LLMs在世界价值观调查中的广泛基准测试，该框架揭示了一个系统且关键的交易：追求文化对齐始终伴随着文化多样性的急剧损失，导致严重的“文化扁平化”。通过研究这种行为转变，我们证明这些表面的对齐收益源于模型人为地锚定于主导多数群体，最终收敛于单一化的响应模式，抹去了人类群体固有的异质性分布。关键的是，我们的机制分析表明，这种多样性崩溃不仅仅是行为异常，更有可能是神经网络优化中固有低秩偏差的结构性后果。因此，我们的发现揭示了当前训练后范式（post-training paradigms）的局限性，并呼吁转向能够保留跨文化多元主义的对齐目标。

articles.title: EM^2Mem: Event-Centric Multimodal Memory for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Multimodal memory offers a scalable interface for long-video question answering, but existing methods often retrieve captions, frames, transcripts, summaries, or graph facts as isolated fragments. Although searchable, such fragments are not generation-ready: language models must reconstruct cross-modal and temporal alignments at inference time, when context is limited and attribution is difficult. We propose EM^2Mem, an event-centric multimodal memory framework that binds heterogeneous evidence to event anchors during memory construction. Each event-indexed memory cell aligns multimodal records, temporal context, graph-linked relations, semantic facts, and provenance, enabling compact evidence readout over grounded multimodal events rather than modality-specific fragments. Across three long-video QA benchmarks, EM^2Mem improves average accuracy over the strongest memory baseline by 2.0, 2.4, and 3.7 points, improves strict event-level Top-5 evidence recall by 7.0 points, and reduces per-query latency by 4.67 times and total inference tokens by 63.66% (The code will be integrated into https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem).
articles.titleCn: EM^2Mem：面向大型语言模型的事件中心多模态记忆
articles.abstractCn: 多模态记忆为长视频问答提供了一个可扩展的接口，但现有方法通常将字幕、帧、文本、摘要或图事实作为独立的片段进行检索。尽管这些片段可搜索，但它们并非生成就绪：语言模型必须在推理时重建跨模态和时间对齐，此时上下文有限且归因困难。我们提出了EM^2Mem，一个以事件为中心的多模态记忆框架，在记忆构建过程中将异构证据绑定到事件锚点。每个事件索引的记忆单元对齐多模态记录、时间上下文、图链接关系、语义事实和来源，从而能够通过基于多模态事件的紧凑证据读取，而不是特定模态的片段。在三个长视频问答基准测试中，EM^2Mem比最强的记忆基线平均准确率提高了2.0、2.4和3.7分，严格的事件级Top-5证据召回率提高了7.0分，并将每查询延迟降低了4.67倍，总推理token减少了63.66%（代码将集成到https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem）。

articles.title: Same Semantics, Different Outcome: On the Modality Robustness of Multimodal LLMs under Knowledge Conflict
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly provided with contextual evidence in heterogeneous forms: as a text passage, as a rendered image of the same passage, or as both together. However, it remains unclear how consistently these surface forms are processed, especially when the evidence conflicts with the model's parametric knowledge. We study modality robustness under knowledge conflict across 13 MLLMs and two datasets, and find them far from robust. (1) Contrary to common belief, models favor a context that contradicts parametric knowledge more readily in image form than in text form; (2) when a contradicting text and image are presented together, the preferred modality is essentially arbitrary, varying with input order, model, and dataset. We further demonstrate that this instability has practical consequences: it degrades performance in multimodal RAG and can be exploited by adversarial attacks. To alleviate this brittleness, we examine several simple techniques---prompting, steering, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and direct preference optimization; the majority prove ineffective, whereas SFT achieves moderate success. We therefore call for greater awareness of this inconsistency and argue that it is fundamental, demanding attention at multiple training stages.
articles.titleCn: 相同语义，不同结果：关于知识冲突下多模态大语言模型的模态鲁棒性研究
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）越来越多地被提供以异构形式呈现的上下文证据：作为文本段落、作为同一段落的渲染图像，或两者同时提供。然而，这些表面形式是否被一致处理仍然不清楚，尤其是在证据与模型的参数化知识冲突时。我们在13个MLLM和两个数据集上研究了知识冲突下的模态鲁棒性，发现它们远非鲁棒。(1) 与普遍认知相反，模型在图像形式下比在文本形式下更倾向于选择与参数化知识相矛盾的上下文；(2) 当呈现相互矛盾的文本和图像时，首选模态基本上是任意的，随输入顺序、模型和数据集的变化而变化。我们进一步证明，这种不稳定性具有实际后果：它会降低多模态RAG的性能，并可能被对抗性攻击利用。为缓解这种脆弱性，我们考察了几种简单技术——提示、引导、监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化；多数技术被证明无效，而SFT取得了中等程度的成功。因此，我们呼吁提高对此不一致性的认识，并认为这是根本性的，需要在多个训练阶段加以关注。

articles.title: Skill Following: Evaluating Actual Skill Use in Retrieval-Enabled LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external skills, yet standard evaluations obscure whether retrieving these skills actually helps. Aggregate metrics often compare retrieved versus non-retrieved tasks, introducing severe selection bias and failing to isolate the true effect of skill use. To measure this actual-use capability-which we formalize as Skill Following (SF)-we introduce the Retrieval-Invoked Actual-Use Effect (RAE). RAE computes the same-task outcome difference between matched skill-enabled and skill-disabled executions, conditioned exclusively on tasks where the agent actively retrieved a skill. Evaluating 17 LLMs across coding and mathematical domains, we uncover a stark evaluation paradox: models frequently show positive aggregate retrieval lift but negative RAE. On MBPP+, multiple models that appear to benefit system-wide actually harm their own performance on the exact tasks where retrieval occurred. These findings demonstrate that aggregate averages can create a misleading illusion of tool-use proficiency, whereas RAE directly measures whether the retrieval-to-answer pipeline genuinely rescues more outcomes than it harms.
articles.titleCn: 技能跟随：评估检索式大语言模型代理中的实际技能使用
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地依赖外部技能，但标准评估却模糊了检索这些技能是否真正有帮助。聚合指标通常比较检索与非检索任务，引入了严重的选择偏差，且未能分离技能使用的真实效果。为了衡量这种实际使用能力——我们将其形式化为技能遵循（SF）——我们引入了检索触发实际使用效应（RAE）。RAE计算匹配的技能启用与技能禁用执行之间的相同任务结果差异，且仅基于代理主动检索技能的任务。在编码和数学领域评估17个LLM后，我们发现了一个严峻的评估悖论：模型频繁显示出正的聚合检索提升，但负的RAE。在MBPP+上，多个看似能提升系统整体性能的模型，实际上损害了检索发生时其自身在这些任务上的表现。这些发现表明，聚合平均值可能造成对工具使用能力的误导性印象，而RAE直接衡量检索到回答的流程是否真正比其损害的结果更多。

articles.title: The Interlingua Hypothesis: LLMs Translate via a Latent Task-agnostic Feature Space
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated improved machine translation performance over strong supervised baselines. This raises questions as to what mechanisms underlie how LLMs perform machine translation between languages. Motivated by recent interpretability findings--namely, that LLMs use massively multilingual latent feature representations to perform language modeling--we propose the interlingua hypothesis. The hypothesis holds that language models translate by reading a source sentence into a latent feature space, and generate a target sentence by reading from the latent feature space. We show three lines of evidence in support of this hypothesis: (1) variance in BLEU across language pairs is largely predictable from language-specific competences with no language pair-specific interaction terms; (2) many model components are causally influential in both monolingual tasks and translation tasks; and (3) fine-tuning on monolingual data recovers a large proportion of translation improvements relative to fine-tuning on aligned documents. Together, these provide convergent evidence in support of the interlingua hypothesis, and suggest new ways of understanding and improving how LLMs can be leveraged to perform translation tasks.
articles.titleCn: 互语言假说：大型语言模型通过潜在任务无关的特征空间进行翻译
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）最近在机器翻译方面表现出比强监督基线更好的性能，这引发了关于LLMs如何在不同语言间进行机器翻译的机制问题。受近期可解释性研究——即LLMs使用大规模多语言潜在特征表示进行语言建模——的启发，我们提出了中介语假说。该假说认为，语言模型通过将源句读入潜在特征空间来进行翻译，并通过从潜在特征空间生成目标句。我们提供了三条证据支持这一假说：（1）不同语言对之间的BLEU值差异很大程度上可以由特定语言的竞争力预测，且没有特定语言对的交互项；（2）许多模型组件在单语任务和翻译任务中都具有因果影响力；（3）在单语数据上进行微调相比于在对齐文档上进行微调，能够恢复大部分翻译改进。这些证据共同为中介语假说提供了支持，并提出了理解和改进LLMs如何用于翻译任务的新途径。
